title: Operations Executive
description:
About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

A Hybrid working model
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

What does a Operations Executive do at WPP?
The Operations Executive reports into the Client Operations Lead. They will facilitate the smooth running of project planning, resourcing and reporting as well as managing logistics and ad-hoc operational support for special projects. This role will work closely with all teams across the client account, including a large network of freelance talents & various global contacts.

The Operations Executive needs to be confident communicating and negotiating priorities / deadlines with all stakeholders to best manage expectations. Fostering meaningful connections and maintaining an approachable, helpful demeanour is key to the success of this role.

Someone who has worked in an EA / PA role previously would be well suited to this role.

Resource Management

  • Oversee onboarding for all new starters with tech and HR (FTE / FTC / Freelance)
  • Check freelance availability where required & process freelance bookings
  • Maintain our resource management tools / trackers
  • Execute, track and manage bookings for 150+ people during client’s on-site projects
  • Setup new vendors in systems as required
  • Ensure client invoice/payment queries are resolved or escalated where needed
  • Sensitively manage the storage and comms of confidential information (eg. day rates, employee info)

Communications & Logistics

  • Owner of all generic team comms – everything from business updates to social events
  • Manage all queries sent to the Ops chat groups / inbox, responding to all messages within the agreed timeframe, escalating if/where required
  • Work with dedicated tech team to oversee any IT logistics, arranging and tracking kit deployment

Reporting

  • Assist with ad-hoc reporting and data analysis requests – should be comfortable manipulating large datasets in excel
  • Run regular global audits of the timesheet tool, resolving incorrect / incomplete data with the team

Project Planning

  • Work with the Client Operations Director to plan, arrange and launch the client’s confidential projects
  • Develop a thorough understanding of the various teams’ ways of working to be able to support ad-hoc special projects effectively
  • Arrange ad-hoc team meetings and team events
  • Maintain the Ops training materials & templates
  • Validate and record employee expense claims before assigning to Operations Director for approval
  • Understand and work under the client’s confidentiality policy

Requirements

  • Fluent written and spoken English
  • Strong inter-personal skills
  • Understanding of GDPR / experience handling sensitive data beneficial
  • Project management / PA / operational background
  • Excel proficient
  • Self-driven and organised with a strong attention to detail and proactive approach to problem-solving
  • Ability to work effectively and collaboratively in high-pressure situations and tight timeframes

#LI-SF1

Why work here:
At WPP Production, you’ll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You’ll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP’s unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.

Inclusion and Impact
WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

Data
We rely on legitimate interest as a legal basis for processing personal information under the GDPR for purposes of recruitment and applications for employment. When you click the "Submit Application" button at the bottom of this page, this will send all the information you have added to WPP Production. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Privacy statement. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

title: Manager- Respiratory Therapy Rcp
description:
At UC Health, we're proud to have the best and brightest teams and clinicians collaborating toward our common purpose: to advance healing and reduce suffering.

As the region's adult academic health system, we strive for innovation and provide world-class care for not only our community, but patients from all over the world. Join our team and you'll be able to develop your skills, grow your career, build relationships with your peers and patients, and help us be a source of hope for our friends and neighbors.

UC Health is committed to providing an inclusive, equitable and diverse place of employment.

The Clinical Manager Oversees Respiratory Care clinical operations and assists with education of students/new employees. Coordinates activities in the Respiratory Care Department and with other departments to assure a unified approach to quality care delivery.

Clinical Operations:

Oversees daily activity to assure appropriate cost-effective care delivery. Develop and enforce department and hospital Policy and Procedure. Monitor and enforce utilization of infection control guidelines. Coordinates department activities to assure a unified approach to quality care delivery. Provide on-call coverage for consultation. Member of several hospital committees.

Personnel Management:

Provides guidance, psychological support and clinical precepting and mentoring of staff. Prepare and present appraisals of staff; initiate corrective action and assist in conflict resolution to maintain personal and professional growth of staff. Participates in recruitment, hiring, payroll and benefit issues. Facilitate Core team meetings.

PI:

Develop Performance Improvement projects and collect and analyze data to validate effectiveness and appropriateness. (Projects include departmental programs, productivity, clinical practice, equipment, policy and procedure, infection control, multidisciplinary programs, clinical pathways, clinical practice standards, etc.) Monitor compliance with JCAHO standards and educate staff regarding opportunities for improvement.

Education:

Precepts and mentors new employees. Provide ongoing education and competency evaluation/review. Educate and mentor students, both on site and at schools (Respiratory Care, paramedic, physician, nursing and other Allied Health). Act as a liaison for internal and external resources to assure a unified approach to patient care delivery. Communicate information about profession to high school and allied health programs to increase awareness and support for future growth of the respiratory care field.

Communication:

Demonstrates open, inclusive, respectful communication. Participates in problem resolution. Uses chain of command appropriately to exchange information and communication issues. Collaborates with physicians, nurses, and others as need to provide the highest quality of care to patients and caregivers.

Resource management:

Aid in preparation for the budget and charging/billing for the system. Evaluates supplies, capital equipment and assures proper inventory maintained. Performs equipment repairs and ordering of rental equipment. Conduct research on equipment, supplies and clinical care to assure excellence. Assists in personnel scheduling to optimize staffing resources. Develop productivity standards to appropriately allocate staff and effectively manage personnel budget. Acts in absence of System Director.

Minimum Required: Bachelor's degree. Preferred: Master’s degree. Other: Graduate of an AMA-approved Respiratory Therapy program. | Current license to practice respiratory care issued by the Ohio Respiratory Care Board. Must possess the RRT credential issued by the National Board for Respiratory Care, BLS and ACLS certification. | Minimum Required: 3 - 5 Years equivalent experience.

title: Lighting Designer 2
description:

We are looking for an Lighting Designer 2 to join our team in our Philadelphia or Wayne office.

This role applies advanced lighting design knowledge to develop concepts, perform and review calculations, and coordinate lighting systems across all phases of a project. The Lighting Designer 2 contributes to client deliverables, participates in presentations, and provides guidance and mentorship to junior staff.


Essential Functions:

  • Documentation: Creates drawings and models used to accurately deliver projects, including lighting plans, details, and coordinated drawing sets, and coordinates key project decisions with the Project Engineer
  • Software: Determines implementation strategies for unique tasks
  • Building Technology: Capable of coordinating and integrating building systems
  • Project Delivery: Demonstrates experience in all phases from concept to construction administration, ensuring design intent and technical quality are maintained
  • Codes: References applicable codes in the development of projects and correctly designs to the code provisions.
  • Quality Standards: Applies standards in project delivery and checks work for issues
  • Sustainability: Considers engineering optimization in the development of projects, including energy performance of lighting systems and controls

title: Senior / Principal Computational Biologist, AI Safety
location: Cambridge, MA USA; London, UK; San Francisco, CA USA
description:
Your Impact at LILA

We're building a talent-dense, high-agency AI safety team at Lila that will engage all core teams within the organization (science, model training, lab integration, etc.), to identify and mitigate risks from scientific superintelligence while retaining the core scientific discovery capabilities of the stack. The initial focus of this team will be to build and implement a bespoke safety strategy for Lila, tailored to its specific goals and deployment strategies. This will involve technical safety strategy development, broader ecosystem engagement, safety-focused evaluations, safety systems to mitigate risks, and a research agenda that explores longer-term needs such as oversight of superintelligent scientific systems.

You will conduct original computational biology research for AI safety and build an integrated understanding of biological risks. You will investigate how capabilities across large language models, specialized biological models, agents and automated laboratories combine to change what is biologically feasible. Our work spans protein and nucleic-acid design, cellular systems and biological delivery; we welcome other specialisms that bring relevant scientific depth and risk judgment.

What You'll Be Building

  • Formulate and pursue original computational biology research questions relevant to safety, developing computational approaches and designing and running studies that generate new evidence about biological capabilities, risks and safeguards.
  • Build and update an integrated picture of risks, examining how capabilities across LLMs, specialized biological models, agents and automated laboratories interact within scientific workflows and change practical constraints.
  • Combine your research with literature, model assessments, experimental findings and expert input to judge biological feasibility, uncertainty and the significance of emerging capabilities for misuse.
  • Identify gaps in expertise, frame questions for external specialists and critically integrate their findings with support from the expert-program team.
  • Translate scientific risk judgments into dual-use policy boundaries, evaluation priorities and mitigation requirements that preserve beneficial biological research.
  • Work with threat modelers, automated-safety researchers, experimental scientists and mitigation engineers to design informative evaluations and red-teaming studies, test assumptions and assess safeguards.

What You'll Need to Succeed

  • Deep expertise (a PhD, or comparable experience) in computational biology or a related quantitative biological discipline, with a record of original research from question formulation and computational study design through to defensible findings.
  • Substantive experience assessing biological dual-use risks, with a strong understanding of relevant harmful applications, including pathogen- or toxin-related risks or other consequential biological misuse.
  • Prior experience applying biological expertise to AI safety through analysis informing threat models, evaluation or red-teaming work, or mitigation design.
  • Sound judgment about the relationship between computational predictions, biological function and experimental evidence, including uncertainty and the limits of your expertise.
  • Strong quantitative analysis and scientific programming skills, with the ability to develop computational approaches, run reproducible studies and critically investigate model outputs and biological data.
  • The ability to investigate unfamiliar questions, identify appropriate specialists and communicate defensible conclusions across scientific, engineering and policy teams.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience connecting biological modeling or design to experimental validation, including workflows combining LLMs, specialized models, agents or laboratory automation.
  • Experience commissioning specialist research or coordinating external scientific collaborators.

Compensation

We offer competitive base compensation with bonus potential and generous early-stage equity. Your final offer will reflect your background, expertise, and expected impact.

U.S. Benefits. Full-time U.S. employees receive a comprehensive benefits program including medical, dental, and vision coverage; employer-paid life and disability insurance; flexible time off with generous company wide holidays; paid parental leave; an educational assistance program; commuter benefits, including bike share memberships for office based employees; and a company subsidized lunch program.

International Benefits. Full-time employees outside the U.S. receive a comprehensive benefits program tailored to their region. USD salary ranges apply only to U.S.-based positions; international salaries are set to local market.

Expected Base Salary Range
$268,000—$384,000 USD

About LILA

Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves.

LILA combines advanced AI models with proprietary AI Science Factory™ instruments into an operating system for science that executes the entire scientific method autonomously, accelerating discovery at unprecedented speed, scale, and impact across medicine, materials, and energy. Learn more at www.lila.ai.

Guided by our core values of truth, trust, curiosity, grit, and velocity, we move with startup speed while tackling problems of historic importance. If this sounds like an environment you'd love to work in, even if you don't meet every qualification listed above, we encourage you to apply.

We’re All In

Lila Sciences is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

Information you provide during your application process will be handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy.

A Note to Agencies

Lila Sciences does not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than candidates. The submission of unsolicited resumes by recruitment or staffing agencies to Lila Sciences or its employees is strictly prohibited unless contacted directly by Lila Science’s internal Talent Acquisition team. Any resume submitted by an agency in the absence of a signed agreement will automatically become the property of Lila Sciences, and Lila Sciences will not owe any referral or other fees with respect thereto.

title: Director of Product
description:
Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the country in which the role is being hired. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

Mark43’s mission is to empower communities and their governments with new technologies that improve the safety and quality of life for all. We build powerful, scalable, and elegant software that sets a new standard for the tools upon which first responders rely. Our users are diverse, and we are committed to embracing diversity of thought and experience within our team.

We are looking for a seasoned product leader to lead Mark43’s product strategy and organisation in the UK. As Director of Product, UKk, you will own the product vision and roadmap for the market, developing a deep understanding of UK policing and public safety, our users, and the market while translating those insights into a clear product strategy.

You will lead a multidisciplinary team spanning Product and Design and serve as a key connection point between our UK customers, the market, and Mark43 teams globally. This role calls for someone who can move comfortably between setting long-term strategy, developing people, engaging directly with customers, and working alongside teams to solve complex product challenges. Most importantly, you will ensure the team executes, turning strategy and customer insight into clear priorities, high-quality products, and measurable outcomes for our customers and the business.

What You’ll Do

If you were part of our team, here are some things you might have done last week:

  • Met with UK customers and frontline users to better understand their operational challenges, then translated those insights into priorities for our UK product roadmap.
  • Worked with Product, Design, and Engineering leaders to refine the vision and roadmap across Case, Custody, integrations, and other UK platform capabilities.
  • Created clarity around priorities, removed obstacles, and held the team accountable for executing against commitments and delivering meaningful customer outcomes.
  • Coached Product Managers and Designers through difficult product decisions, helping the team balance customer needs, market opportunities, technical considerations, and Mark43’s broader strategy.
  • Partnered with Sales, Delivery, Customer Success, and other customer-facing teams to ensure our product strategy reflects what we are learning in the market.
  • Presented our UK product direction to a customer or prospective customer and helped connect near-term investments to a compelling longer-term vision.
  • Identified opportunities to use AI and other emerging technologies to meaningfully improve policing and public safety workflows while maintaining the trust, reliability, and usability required of mission-critical software.
  • Worked with global Product and Engineering teams to determine which UK requirements should extend our core platform and where market-specific capabilities are needed.
  • Built greater product knowledge across the UK team so that individuals can support one another across the platform, reducing single points of failure and creating room for people to grow.

What You’ll Need

We’re looking for an experienced product leader with a track record of leading complex software products and developing high-performing teams. You should have significant product management experience, including several years leading Product Managers and working closely with Design and Engineering.

You have demonstrated experience taking complex products from strategy through delivery and adoption. You are equally comfortable discussing a long-term market opportunity with an executive, exploring workflows with an end user, and working through product and technical trade-offs with a delivery team. You have a strong bias towards execution and know how to translate strategy into priorities, establish accountability, remove blockers, and keep teams focused on delivering results.

Experience with enterprise SaaS, government technology, policing, public safety, or similarly complex and regulated environments is highly valuable. Familiarity with AI-enabled products, data-rich workflows, or modern approaches to software design and development is also beneficial.

People who thrive on our team also tend to share the following characteristics:

  • Customer and mission focused. You are energised by understanding complex users and solving problems that have meaningful consequences in the real world.
  • Strategic and pragmatic. You can establish a compelling vision while recognising that great strategies only matter if teams can execute them.
  • Humble, open, and curious. You seek out perspectives that challenge your own and create an environment where Product, Design, Engineering, customers, and other stakeholders can contribute to better decisions.
  • A multiplier. You build strong teams, create clarity, share context freely, and help people grow rather than becoming the person through whom every decision must flow.
  • Comfortable with complexity. You can bring structure to ambiguous problems and find a simple path through complicated workflows without oversimplifying the needs of our users.

This role is based in Manchester, with an expectation of working from our Manchester office three days per week. The role will also require regular engagement with customers and teams across the UK. Due to the nature of our work with UK policing, the successful candidate must be able to obtain and maintain NPPV Level 3 (NPPV3) clearance.

Mark43 is approved to hire in Canada, the UK, and 36 U.S. states, including Alabama, Arizona, California (excluding San Francisco), Colorado, Connecticut, Washington D.C., Florida, Georgia, Iowa, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Kansas, Massachusetts, Maryland, Maine, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, North Carolina, Nebraska, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New Mexico, New York, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Virginia, Vermont, Washington, Wisconsin, and West Virginia. Before applying to a remote role, please ensure that you are able to perform the position in one of the states listed above. State locations and specifics are subject to change as our hiring requirements shift.

Our Privacy Notice describes how Mark43 uses and protects the personal information of prospective employees during the recruitment process. It informs you about our handling of the personal information you provide to us when you apply for a position in our organization and in general when you express your interest in joining our team.

As a part of Mark43's security measures all employees must: Engage in appropriate use of the company's electronic information resources; Become knowledgeable about and follow relevant security policies and guidelines; Protect the resources under their control, such as passwords, computers, and data that they create, receive, or download; and Promptly report security-related incidents and violations, and responding to official reports of security incidents involving their systems or accounts.

Mark43 is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information. As part of this commitment, we will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed, please email recruiting@Mark43.com requesting the accommodation.

title: Head of Brand and Editorial
description:
About Arc Institute

Arc Institute is an independent nonprofit research organization at the interface of artificial intelligence and biology, working to accelerate scientific progress and understand the root causes of complex diseases. Founded in 2021 and based in Palo Alto, Arc partners with Stanford University, UC Berkeley, and UC San Francisco.

Unlike academia, our scientists have long-term funding and industry-like resources. Unlike industry, they're free to pursue high-risk, long-term research without commercial pressures. Arc's Technology Centers and Core Investigator labs work side by side, integrating experimental and computational biology under one roof to tackle problems neither could solve alone.

Our two Institute Initiatives reflect this model in action:

  • Virtual Cell Initiative: Building a full-stack virtual cell model to identify disease mechanisms and nominate drug targets, accelerating the path from biological insight to clinical trials.
  • Alzheimer's Disease Initiative: Mapping the genes, pathways, and environmental factors behind Alzheimer's disease to develop drug candidates that address root causes.

More than 300 Arconauts work together at our Palo Alto headquarters, backed by substantial long-term philanthropic funding.

About the position

Arc Institute is seeking a leader to own our storytelling for our next stage. The Head of Brand and Editorial will unify our brand, communications, and editorial work. You will set the creative and strategic vision for how Arc speaks to the world, partner directly with our founders and other leaders to shape our communications strategy, and lead the teams that bring it to life every day. This is a player-coach role for someone who operates comfortably on both strategy and execution.

About you

  • You are a storyteller with exceptional taste. You have strong, well-developed opinions about what great looks like in writing, design, and brand, and you can articulate why. People seek out your judgment.
  • You have spent your career in deeply technical work. You have partnered with experts to help them share their knowledge with the world. A background in science is not required, but you must have engaged with complex technical topics.
  • You are skilled at working with brilliant, opinionated people. You can extract a clear creative brief from ambiguous or reactive feedback, earn trust quickly, and push back with credibility when needed.

In this position you will

  • Own and articulate the vision for Arc's story as a new model for scientific institutions and as a producer of meaningful research, and ensure that vision is expressed consistently across every surface: media, web, brand, publications, and internal communications.
  • Serve as a trusted partner to Arc's founders and scientific leaders, translating their expertise into clear creative direction and actionable plans for the team.
  • Lead, integrate, and develop Arc's Communications and Scientific Publications teams into a unified storytelling and editorial function, setting priorities, raising the bar on craft, and helping team members and their leaders grow and succeed.
  • Tell the world about Arc's scientific discoveries, leading the team that works closely with researchers to communicate their work with accuracy, clarity, and impact.
  • Set a high standard of taste and sophistication across all of Arc's output, from major scientific announcements to the smallest touchpoints, and build the systems and review practices that sustain that standard as Arc scales.
  • Develop Arc's brand in the scientific and AI talent markets, partnering with People, University Relations, and other colleagues on integrated internal and external communications.
  • Foster productive relationships with reporters to drive a proactive media strategy and react to coverage as needed.
  • Define the framework to measure the effectiveness of Arc's brand, communications, and editorial efforts.
  • Collaborate with multiple Arc teams on internal communications.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or advanced degree in a field you have applied to marketing and communications.
  • 15+ years of experience in communications, brand, marketing, and/or editorial roles, including significant experience leading and developing teams and managing other managers.
  • A track record of setting communications or brand strategy for a technically sophisticated organization in fields such as AI, computing, biotechnology, life sciences, or other deep technical domains, and translating that complex work for various audiences.
  • Demonstrated success partnering with founders, executives, and/or researchers
  • Exceptional writing and editorial judgment, with the ability to elevate the writing of others.
  • Proven ability to operate strategically while remaining hands-on in the work; comfort in a fast-paced, rapidly scaling organization.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous work at frontier AI labs, technology startups, biotech, life sciences, or academic/research institutions.
  • Experience managing relationships with media at the national and trade level.
  • Familiarity with scientific publishing and the norms of academic communication.

The base salary range for this position is $215,000 to $265,000. These amounts reflect the range of base salary that the Institute reasonably would expect to pay a new hire or internal candidate for this position. The actual base compensation paid to any individual for this position may vary depending on factors such as experience, market conditions, education/training, skill level, and whether the compensation is internally equitable, and does not include bonuses, commissions, differential pay, other forms of compensation, or benefits. This position is also eligible to receive an annual discretionary bonus, with the amount dependent on individual and institute performance factors.

In addition to the Base Salary and Annual Bonus above, you will be eligible to participate in the Institute’s Compound Cash Grant Program (the “CCGP”). The CCGP is a program designed to offer multi-year cash grants providing for a fixed dollar amount paid out in semi-annual installments to reward employees for staying and contributing to the Institute. As soon as reasonably practical after your start date, you will receive a grant letter describing the terms of your award under the CCGP.

title: Materials and Heavy Haul Supervisor
description:
About Us:

At Tomball Controls, we specialize in manufacturing custom fuel tanks, custom sound attenuated enclosures, and access platforms for emergency power generators.

We are proud to serve clients across various industries, providing them with high-quality power packaging solutions to meet their specific requirements. With years of experienced team members and a commitment to excellence, we have built a reputation for delivering reliable and durable products on time and within budget.


Job Description:

We are seeking an experienced and motivated Materials and Heavy Haul Supervisor for our facility in Von Ormy, Texas (South San Antonio area). The ideal candidate will have supervisory experience in a manufacturing environment, strong knowledge of material handling and yard operations, and a commitment to safety, quality, and continuous improvement.


The Materials and Heavy Haul Supervisor oversees yard material handling and heavy equipment movement to support safe and efficient manufacturing operations. This role is responsible for executing loading, unloading, transportation, and staging activities in alignment with production and shipping priorities.

The position leads material movement supporting Packaging, Ship Loose, and Electrical Yard operations while supervising the Heavy Haul team responsible for moving large materials, loading and unloading equipment, and transporting completed units throughout the facility.



Key Responsibilities:

Yard Material Movement and Production Support

  • Oversee daily yard material handling activities supporting Packaging, Ship Loose, and Electrical Yard operations.
  • Ensure kits, components, accessories, and major assemblies are delivered to the correct work areas in accordance with production schedules.
  • Assign daily responsibilities to Material Handlers and Heavy Haul personnel based on priorities established by the Materials Manager and Production leadership.
  • Coordinate the movement of enclosures, fuel tanks, skid frames, generators, switchgear, platforms, and other large assemblies between production, staging, storage, and loading areas.
  • Verify material readiness prior to movement and communicate shortages, discrepancies, or access constraints to the appropriate departments.


Heavy Haul Team Supervision

  • Lead and supervise the Heavy Haul team in the safe and efficient movement of large materials, equipment, and completed units throughout the facility.
  • Verify that personnel, equipment, rigging, and work areas are properly prepared before any movement begins.
  • Ensure all lifting and material handling activities are performed in accordance with approved procedures, equipment capacities, load weights, lifting points, and center-of-gravity requirements.
  • Assign and communicate clear responsibilities to operators, riggers, spotters, and signal personnel to ensure safe and coordinated operations.
  • Monitor heavy haul activities to ensure compliance with safety standards and operational requirements.


Loading and Unloading

  • Supervise the safe and efficient loading and unloading of large equipment, customer-supplied materials, components, and completed units.
  • Coordinate personnel, equipment, and resources to ensure loading and unloading activities are completed according to operational requirements and schedules.
  • Verify unit, job, and equipment identification against receiving, shipping, and production documentation.
  • Confirm all required inspections, approvals, and readiness checks are completed prior to loading finished products.
  • Ensure proper blocking, bracing, protection, and load securement methods are utilized and verified in accordance with company standards and transportation requirements.
  • Document and promptly report any visible damage, missing items, or discrepancies to the appropriate Materials, Quality, Shipping, or Receiving personnel to ensure required information is communicated to the responsible departments.


Packaging, Ship Loose, and Electrical Yard Support

  • Lead and direct material handling activities supporting the Packaging, Ship Loose, and Electrical Yard teams.
  • Ensure materials are properly staged, labeled, and segregated by project and job to maintain organization and prevent material mix-ups.
  • Support Ship Loose verification processes by ensuring required materials and components are available for review against approved bills of material (BOMs) and packing lists.
  • Maintain clear identification and separation of verified, incomplete, damaged, and nonconforming materials.
  • Ensure customer-supplied equipment and materials are properly identified, protected, and maintained throughout handling and storage.
  • Collaborate with Production and Materials teams to resolve material flow issues and support on-time completion of manufacturing activities.


Inventory Accuracy and Material Control

  • Maintain accurate inventory records and physical locations for yard inventory, work-in-process units, finished units, and customer-owned equipment.
  • Ensure all material transfers, movements, and location changes are promptly and accurately recorded in the ERP system or designated tracking tools.
  • Verify job numbers, part numbers, quantities, and serial numbers to ensure inventory accuracy and traceability.
  • Support cycle counts, physical inventories, and inventory audits for assigned areas.
  • Investigate inventory discrepancies and implement corrective actions to improve inventory accuracy and material control.
  • Ensure materials are properly stored, labeled, protected, and handled to prevent damage or loss.
  • Prevent the use or movement of damaged, unidentified, or nonconforming materials without proper authorization.


Equipment, Rigging, and Safety

  • Oversee the safe operation of forklifts, telehandlers, cranes, yard trucks, and other material-handling equipment.
  • Ensure operators, riggers, and signal personnel maintain required training, certifications, and authorizations.
  • Verify completion of required pre-use inspections for equipment, rigging, and lifting devices.
  • Ensure slings, shackles, lifting devices, and related equipment are suitable for use, properly maintained, and stored appropriately.
  • Remove unsafe or damaged equipment from service and coordinate repairs and preventive maintenance with the Maintenance team.
  • Conduct regular safety observations and reinforce compliance with PPE requirements, housekeeping standards, traffic controls, and safe work practices.
  • Report and investigate incidents, near misses, equipment damage, and unsafe conditions, implementing corrective actions as needed.


Leadership and Continuous Improvement

  • Provide daily leadership, direction, coaching, and training to support employee development and operational success.
  • Establish and reinforce expectations related to safety, quality, productivity, inventory accuracy, attendance, and teamwork.
  • Develop team capabilities through cross-training and skill development in material handling and heavy haul operations.
  • Identify and implement opportunities to improve material flow, reduce handling damage, minimize production delays, and increase operational efficiency.
  • Collaborate with Materials and Production leadership to improve yard organization, staging strategies, and point-of-use material delivery.

title: Quoter
description:
Purpose

The Quoter is responsible for preparing accurate and timely cost estimates and pricing proposals for aircraft maintenance, modification, and completion projects. This role develops detailed quotes that reflect labor, materials, vendor services, and project timelines, and supports business growth by ensuring proposals are competitive, technically accurate, and aligned with company financial objectives.

This position reports to the VP of Operations and works closely with engineering, operations, supply chain, sales, program management, and finance teams.

Responsibilities

Estimating & Pricing

● Prepare detailed cost estimates and customer quotations for aircraft maintenance, modification, refurbishment, and interior completion projects.

● Review customer requests for quotes (RFQs), technical specifications, and work scopes to determine project requirements.

● Develop pricing models that account for labor, materials, overhead, and program risk factors.

● Ensure quotes align with company cost structures, margins, and financial targets.

● Prepare formal quotation packages and supporting documentation for customer submission.

Cross-Functional Coordination

● Collaborate with engineering, production, and supply chain teams to identify labor hours, materials, and vendor services required.

● Coordinate with procurement teams to obtain supplier and vendor pricing.

● Participate in internal quote reviews to validate scope, cost assumptions, and schedule feasibility.

● Collaborate with sales, program management, and finance teams to ensure alignment between proposals and operational execution.

Records & Process Improvement

● Maintain and update cost databases, labor rate assumptions, and historical pricing information.

● Track quote activity and maintain records of submitted proposals and outcomes.

● Support continuous improvement of estimating processes, templates, and cost models.

Requirements

Required

● 3–5 years of experience in estimating, quoting, cost analysis, or proposal preparation.

● Experience working in aviation, aerospace, manufacturing, or project-based environments.

● Strong understanding of labor costing, materials pricing, and project-based financial analysis.

● High school diploma or equivalent.

● Able to read, understand, and apply customer RFQs, technical specifications, engineering drawings, and work scopes in English, and to communicate clearly with customers and internal teams to perform the essential functions of the position.

● Authorized to work in the United States and able to pass applicable pre-employment screening. (This is a non-safety-sensitive position; no DOT/FAA drug-and-alcohol testing applies.)

Preferred

● Valid FAA Mechanic Certificate with Airframe and Powerplant ratings.

● Experience in aircraft maintenance, MRO, or VIP aircraft completions environments.

● Familiarity with aviation technical documentation, engineering drawings, and work scopes.

● Experience using ERP systems, estimating software, or proposal management tools.

● Knowledge of contract structures, pricing strategies, and margin management.

Working Conditions

● Work is primarily performed in a professional office environment, with periodic walks through hangar and shop areas to review aircraft condition and work scopes; PPE and OSHA/company safety protocols required when in hangar and shop areas.

● This position is considered MEDIUM work, with frequent lifting up to 20 lbs and occasional lifting up to 50 lbs; occasional climbing, stooping, kneeling, squatting, and reaching; frequent standing; and constant repetitive movements of the arms and hands and seated work with back supported, including extended periods of computer use.

● Travel not typically required; may occasionally occur for customer meetings or site visits.

● May require additional hours during peak proposal cycles or major customer bids.

Knowledge, Skills, and Other Attributes

● Strong analytical and cost estimation skills, with high attention to detail and accuracy in financial calculations.

● Ability to interpret technical documentation and translate it into cost estimates.

● Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and commercial teams.

● Strong organizational and time management abilities, including managing multiple quoting requests and deadlines simultaneously.

● Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and financial modeling tools.

● Professionalism and discretion when handling proprietary or competitive pricing information.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Citadel Aviation, LLC. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Reporting to the Manager of HIM Operations, the Supervisor directly leads an assigned team of approximately 10–12 Document Management staff and is accountable for daily workload allocation, productivity, quality, service levels, staff performance, and operational continuity. The Supervisor coordinates centralized work queues and resources to ensure documents are processed consistently and efficiently across assigned locations and are linked to the correct patient and encounter, accurately represented in the legal health record, available within required timeframes, and handled securely throughout their lifecycle.

The role promotes consistent MSHS practices and compliance with federal and New York State requirements, record-retention standards, privacy and security rules, and applicable organizational policies.

1. Supervises daily Document Management operations and assigns, prioritizes, and redistributes work within and across assigned work queues and locations to meet scanning, indexing, reconciliation, quality, and availability standards.
2. Oversees receipt and tracking of paper and electronic documents from clinical departments, ambulatory practices, ancillary systems, external providers, patients, vendors, and approved interfaces.
3. Directs document preparation, batching, scanning, image enhancement, import, classification, indexing, encounter matching, validation, and finalization in the electronic health record.
4. Ensures each document is complete, legible, correctly oriented, assigned to the correct patient, encounter, author, service date, location, and document type, and available to authorized users within established timeframes.
5. Oversees reconciliation of paper and electronic inventory, interface exception queues, failed imports, fax queues, loose documents, and outstanding batches to prevent omissions or duplicate filing.
6. Reviews and resolves misfiled, mislabeled, duplicate, incomplete, illegible, unassigned, and wrong-patient documents; escalates potential patient-safety, privacy, or legal health record concerns promptly.
7. Controls authorized correction, reclassification, movement, replacement, and deletion workflows while maintaining required audit trails and approvals.
8. Ensures source documents are stored securely and retained or destroyed only after quality validation and in accordance with MSHS retention, legal hold, and approved destruction requirements.
9. Monitors work queues, turnaround time, backlog, aging, scanning volume, indexing accuracy, error rates, productivity, quality, service levels, and staffing capacity and other key performance indicators; prepares routine reports for management.
10. Performs and documents quality audits covering image quality, completeness, patient and encounter selection, document type, service date, author attribution, duplicate content, and final record availability.
11. Analyzes errors and trends and implements coaching, corrective actions, workflow improvements, standard work, and workload-balancing measures in collaboration with the Manager of HIM Operations.
12. Develops schedules and coverage plans and oversees attendance, timekeeping, cross-training, competency validation, and continuity of operations.
13. Trains, coaches, evaluates, and develops staff in document preparation, scanning, indexing, image quality, medical terminology, patient matching, privacy, and electronic health record workflows.
14. Addresses routine performance and conduct concerns and participates in corrective-action processes with the Manager, Human Resources, and Labor Relations, as appropriate.
15. Partners with site HIM teams, clinical departments, ambulatory operations, Health Information Exchange, Information Technology, Privacy, Compliance, Legal, Patient Safety, and vendors to resolve document integrity and availability issues and ensure effective integration between centralized HIM services and facility-based operations.
16. Supports testing, implementation, and optimization of Epic and related document imaging, scanning, fax, interface, recognition, and workflow technologies.
17. Coordinates equipment maintenance, supply availability, downtime procedures, recovery workflows, and secure transport of source documents.
18. Supports audits, regulatory surveys, litigation holds, patient amendments, coding and billing needs, and other requests requiring verification of document integrity or availability.
19. Provides operational oversight of document-management practices within assigned HIM services and escalates concerns involving document workflows performed by non-HIM departments when those practices may affect patient identification, document integrity, legal health record integrity, privacy, retention, or record availability.
20. Maintains confidentiality and safeguards health information in all formats and locations.
21. Performs other related duties as assigned.

Education Requirements

Associate degree in Health Information Technology, Health Information Management, Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.
An equivalent combination of education and relevant HIM experience may be considered.

Experience Requirements

Minimum of three years of progressively responsible document management, document imaging, scanning and indexing, or Health Information Management experience, including at least one year in a lead, senior, or supervisory capacity. Experience in a complex, multi-site healthcare environment is preferred.

Licensing and Certification Requirements

RHIT or RHIA credential preferred.

Compensation Statement

The Mount Sinai Health System (MSHS) provides salary ranges that comply with the New York City Law on Salary Transparency in Job Advertisements. The salary range for the role is $65,193.00 - $110,000.00 Annually. Actual salaries depend on a variety of factors, including experience, education, and operational need. The salary range or contractual rate listed does not include bonuses/incentive, differential pay or other forms of compensation or benefits.

title: Data Engineer
description:
About the role:


Insight Xcite is seeking Data Engineers to build and maintain reliable data pipelines supporting mission-focused programs. Work includes integrating diverse data sources, transforming structured and unstructured data, improving data quality, and making data accessible within appropriate security boundaries.

Responsibilities, technology requirements, and experience levels vary by opening. We will discuss the specific assignment, location, and requirements with you during the interview process.


Key responsibilities:


- Build, maintain, and troubleshoot data ingestion and ETL/ELT pipelines.

- Use Python and appropriate processing tools to transform and integrate data from multiple sources.

- Validate data accuracy, completeness, and consistency, and investigate failed or unreliable data feeds.

- Support data models, storage platforms, metadata, and documentation appropriate to the assignment.

- Work with engineering teams and stakeholders to clarify requirements and explain technical results.


Required qualifications:


- Hands-on experience building or maintaining data pipelines and performing data extraction, transformation, and loading.

- Experience using Python for data processing or automation.

- Experience integrating diverse data sources and applying data-quality checks.

- Ability to troubleshoot problems independently and communicate clearly with technical and nontechnical audiences.

Education and experience requirements depend on the opening. Certain Expert-level assignments require at least 11 years of relevant experience.


Opening-specific technologies and responsibilities:


Depending on the assignment, requirements may include:

- Cloud and distributed data processing: AWS, HDFS, Cloudera, Spark, Presto, SQL, NoSQL, and enterprise data-flow integration.

- Operational data integration: tools such as NiFi or Cribl, log-data analysis, data-feed troubleshooting, Splunk, and work across network and security environments.

- Software-intensive data engineering: batch and real-time pipelines, APIs, microservices, Docker, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and integration with application development.

- Analytics pipelines: PySpark, data mapping, JSON/XML processing, SQL databases, data-quality analysis, and source-to-target documentation.

These are different assignment profiles. Applicants are not expected to have every technology listed above.


Clearance Requirement:


Applicants must currently possess an active TS/SCI with Full-Scope Polygraph. Insight Xcite does not sponsor or process security clearances at this time.


Work Location Requirement:


These opportunities require onsite work at the designated location. Remote and hybrid arrangements are not offered.


Compensation:


Annual base salary: $140,000–$220,000. Compensation depends on relevant experience, technical qualifications, role scope, and assignment requirements.


Candidate Authenticity and Use of AI:


AI tools may be used to help format or draft application materials. All submitted information must accurately represent your own experience, qualifications, and work history. Be prepared to discuss and verify the information provided. Do not include classified or sensitive customer information.

title: Regional Owner Operator (Liquid Bulk)
description:
Job Description:

Altom Transport is seeking dedicated and professional Over The Road CDL A Regional Tanker Drivers to safely transport liquid bulk materials across the country. This role requires extended time on the road, typically 5+ consecutive days, with home time that can be planned based on operational needs and driver preferences. This position offers the flexibility to maximize earnings while ensuring the highest safety and service standards.

Key Responsibilities:

  • As an Owner Operator Driver with Altom Transport, you are more than just a driver—you are a business owner and a critical partner in our operation. Your role includes:
  • Safe Transportation: Hauling chemical and petroleum products using tank trailers while adhering to DOT regulations.
  • Equipment Maintenance: Ensuring your truck meets all inspection standards and remains in top condition for long-haul success.
  • Loading & Unloading: Following proper procedures for ISO/Flexi-Bag or Tanker operations at loading and delivery points.
  • Compliance & Documentation: Maintaining accurate logs, submitting necessary paperwork, and adhering to Hazmat regulations.
  • Customer Service: Representing Altom Transport professionally at all customer locations.
  • Business Management: Managing fuel purchases, trip planning, and scheduling to maximize revenue.
  • Maintain a steady workload by meeting mileage or hour requirements to contribute to the overall success of the operation.
  • 24/7 Operation – Willingness to be available 24/7 when needed.

If you’re looking for a long-term partnership with a company that values your experience, provides top-tier support, and offers high revenue potential, Altom Transport is the right fit for you!

Qualifications:

Altom Transport maintains strict driver qualifications and a safety-first culture to ensure professional, compliant, and well-supported operations. Requirements and safety standards include:

  • Late model equipment that meets Altom’s inspection standards
  • Qualifications
  • Valid CDL Class A License
  • Tanker Endorsement (N) – Required
  • Hazmat Endorsement (H) – Preferred (must obtain within 90 days of hire; assistance available)
  • TWIC Card – Preferred (or must obtain after hire)
  • Minimum 1 year of verifiable tanker driving experience
  • At least 23 years of age
  • Clean MVR and strong safety record
  • Able to pass DOT physical, drug screening, and background check
  • Dependable, safety-minded, and capable of working independently
  • Willing to work flexible schedules, including 24/7 operations if needed

Strict Driver Vetting & Qualification Process Includes:

  • Minimum of 2 years of verifiable tanker experience within the last 5 years
  • No DUI/OWI on record within the last 5 years
  • Cannot be prohibited in the FMCSA Drug & Alcohol Clearinghouse
  • No at-fault/preventable fatal or rollover accidents in the last 5 years
  • No more than 2 moving violations in the last 3 years
  • No more than 2 CSA moving violations in the last 18 months
  • No falsification on the driver application
  • Must hold a current X endorsement
  • Minimum 1-week in-person new hire training
  • Quarterly mandatory safety meetings with employees
  • HM 232 Compliance & Emergency Response Plan provided
  • General Awareness testing in accordance with 49 CFR 172-part H
  • Drug & Alcohol Policy and DOT Compliance program
  • Forward-facing cameras on all Altom and contractor equipment
  • Governed company equipment
  • Incident & Accident Investigation Program (driver reporting + injury investigations)
  • RCMS Certified / HSE policy
  • PPE provided, including replacement policy guidelines

Altom Transport operates with a “mission first, safety always” mindset, placing the safety of drivers, customers, and the public above all operational needs.

Benefits:

  • Revenue & Fuel Surcharge: Earn 68% of freight revenue + 100% fuel surcharge
  • Terminal Fueling Program: Access exclusive fuel discounts
  • License Plate Program: Simplifying administrative tasks
  • National Parts & Service Discounts: Save on maintenance + access in-house PM & repair services
  • Insurance Programs: Affordable Bobtail, Physical Damage, Occupational Accident, Disability & Health Indemnity options
  • Flexible time off based on scheduling and operational needs.
  • Weekly Direct Deposit: Get paid on time, every time

title: Product Design Analyst | Affirmative Job Opening for Diverse Talent
description:
At EBANX, we believe barriers were made to be broken. What your day-to-day will look like

Leverage AI tools such as Claude to accelerate research synthesis, identify patterns, and translate findings into actionable insights that support user-centered product decisions;

Take ownership of design initiatives and contribute to evaluating outcomes and identifying opportunities for continuous improvement;

  • Data analysis — Ability to interpret product metrics and quantitative data, using insights to support discovery, inform design decisions, and identify opportunities for improvement;

What would be a plus?
  • Previous experience in payments, fintech, or e-commerce;
  • Experience applying Service Design methodologies, including journey mapping and service blueprints;

  • Experience leveraging AI tools, such as Claude, for rapid prototyping, workflow automation, and experimentation;
  • Familiarity with Shadcn UI, React, and Tailwind CSS to accelerate prototyping and build scalable design solutions;
  • Good communication skills in Spanish.

EBANX offers:

  • Performance Bonus: Annual bonus program based on company results.

  • Language Classes: Language classes to support your personal and professional development.

    Flexible Work Culture: Semi-flexible hours and additional day off on your birthday.

Learn more about our #ebanxlife on LinkedIn and Instagram, and see what it’s like to be part of a global team that breaks barriers, creates opportunities, and celebrates every achievement together.

✨ An Out Of The Ordinary career is waiting for you here!

title: Sign Maker & Installer
description:
YVR is a place of connection, bringing together people, places and cargo while ensuring a safe and efficient experience for everyone. Terminal Operations ensures the safe, efficient, and seamless operation of terminal facilities, supporting passenger experience, airline operations, and regulatory compliance through day to day terminal readiness, asset management, and stakeholder coordination.

Position overview

We are hiring a 1 year full‑time Sign Maker & Installer to join our Terminal Operations team. Reporting to the Manager, Signage and Wayfinding Program, this role is responsible for designing, producing, installing, and maintaining airport signage that helps people move through YVR safely and efficiently. It’s a hands‑on position that combines sign making, basic graphic layout, and on‑site installation to meet regulatory, branding, and wayfinding standards.

You’ll work closely with internal teams and external partners to manage signage requests from start to finish, translating detailed requirements into clear, functional signage. In a fast‑paced airport environment, your work will be highly visible and directly support smooth passenger flow and daily terminal operations.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Work with internal stakeholders to gather signage requirements, timelines, and specification.
  • Design and prepare signage layouts and artwork in accordance with YVR standards, branding, and regulatory requirements
  • Fabricate a wide range of signage using sign shop equipment, materials, and established production techniques
  • Install signage across terminal, airside, and groundside areas, including working at height
  • Coordinate installation schedules and collaborate with third‑party installers as needed

  • Maintain signage inventory, documentation, tools, and perform audits, repairs, and updates

Key qualifications include:

  • At least one year of sign making experience and one year of computer graphics program experience, supplemented by a minimum of a high school diploma; or an equivalent combination of training and experience
  • Experience with signage fabrication techniques for indoor and outdoor applications
  • Proficiency with sign-making equipment, including plotters, large format printers, hand tools, saws, and cutting tools.
  • Strong working knowledge of design and graphics software (e.g., Adobe Illustrator, FlexiSign)
  • Familiarity with a variety of signage materials, substrates, and installation methods
  • Ability to lift materials, work on ladders, and perform hands-on installation tasks
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to proof designs for accuracy
  • Effective communication skills and the ability to collaborate with diverse stakeholders

Although not required, French language skills are an asset as we are committed to providing bilingual services to our visitors and passengers. This helps us meet federal language obligations while ensuring a welcoming experience. Candidates who do not speak French are still strongly encouraged to apply.

This position is open to both Vancouver Airport Authority employees and external candidates. Previous job performance will be taken into consideration for all internal candidates that apply for this position.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer
description:
Location Details: Colombia, remote

At GoDaddy, the future of work looks different for each team. Some teams work in the office full-time; others have a hybrid arrangement (they work remotely some days and in the office some days) , and some work entirely remotely.​

This is a remote position, so you’ll be working remotely from your home. You may occasionally visit a GoDaddy office to meet with your team for events or meetings.

Join Our Team

The Commerce Data & ML team is at the core of powering intelligent and secure experiences for GoDaddy’s Commerce division. Partnering with the Data Science team, we support a wide range of machine learning and data engineering efforts that help GoDaddy Commerce understand its customers, prevent fraud, and tailor product experiences. We work closely with the Risk team to build and maintain production ML Risk Models, such as Transaction Risk Scoring and Merchant Risk Models. We also collaborate with the Growth team to enable data-driven marketing and customer segmentation through reliable pipelines and predictive models.
We’ve evolved a robust ML platform built on SageMaker Pipelines, Tecton feature store, Glue, GitHub Actions, and MLflow - with support for both batch and real-time inference. Also, recently, we’ve begun developing prompt engineering workflows for LLM-powered chatbots. As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer on the Commerce Data & ML team in Bulgaria, you will play a key role in building production-grade pipelines and scalable ML systems that support fraud mitigation, customer insights, and AI-driven experiences.

What you'll get to do...
  • Design, build, and maintain robust ML pipelines for both batch and real-time inference using tools such as SageMaker Pipelines, EventBridge, MLflow, and feature stores.
  • Collaborate with Data Scientists, Engineers, and stakeholders to implement, monitor, and optimize ML workflows—including model training, evaluation, drift detection, and deployment.
  • Enhance and manage CI/CD pipelines for ML models, oversee model promotion and retraining workflows, and ensure seamless integration across different environments.
  • Lead the end-to-end delivery of ML features from architecture and implementation to monitoring and iteration, while guiding and mentoring junior engineers and promoting best practices.
  • Support operational excellence by participating in on-call rotations, production incident response, post-mortems, and contributing to the planning and scoping of ML initiatives.
Your experience should include...
  • 5+ years in the software industry, with at least 3+ years focused on ML engineering, pipelines, or applied machine learning.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS SageMaker Studio, Tecton, and proficiency in Python and ML frameworks (e.g., scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow).
  • Experience with experiment tracking (MLflow), orchestrating ML workflows (SageMaker Pipelines, EventBridge), and building/monitoring both batch and real-time inference pipelines.
  • Familiarity with data preparation and streaming tools (Glue, EMR, Flink) for feature pipelines.
  • Solid understanding of CI/CD for ML (model deployment, endpoint configuration, validation) and strong cross-functional collaboration skills with Data Science, Risk, and Engineering teams.
You might also have...
  • Experience building dual-model pipelines (e.g., NeuralNet + XGBoost) and evaluating ensemble performance.
  • Knowledge of business-aligned success metrics like recall, hit rate, false positives, and model drift thresholds.
  • Experience with fraud detection, risk modeling, or financial domains.
  • Familiarity with prompt engineering, LLM integration, and evaluation workflows for generative AI.
  • Backend or data engineering skills in Java, Scala, or Go (nice to have).

We encourage you to apply even if your experience or skillset doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement. We value a wide range of backgrounds and transferable skills, and we are excited to support learning and growth.

We've got your back... We offer a range of total rewards that may include paid time off, retirement savings (e.g., 401k, pension schemes), bonus/incentive eligibility, equity grants, participation in our employee stock purchase plan, competitive health benefits, and other family-friendly benefits including parental leave. GoDaddy’s benefits vary based on individual role and location and can be reviewed in more detail during the interview process.

About us... GoDaddy is empowering everyday entrepreneurs around the world by providing the help and tools to succeed online, making opportunity more inclusive for all. GoDaddy is the place people come to name their idea, build a professional website, attract customers, sell their products and services, and manage their work. Our mission is to give our customers the tools, insights, and people to transform their ideas and personal initiative into success. To learn more about the company, visit About Us.

At GoDaddy, we know diverse teams build better products—period. Our people and culture reflect and celebrate that sense of diversity and inclusion in ideas, experiences, and perspectives. But we also know that’s not enough to build true equity and belonging in our communities. That’s why we prioritize integrating diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging principles into the core of how we work every day—focusing not only on our employee experience, but also our customer experience and operations. It’s the best way to serve our mission of empowering entrepreneurs everywhere and making opportunity more inclusive for all. To read more about these commitments, as well as our representation and pay equity data, check out our Diversity and Pay Parity annual report, which can be found on our Diversity Careers page.

We also embrace our diverse culture and offer a range of Employee Resource Groups (Culture). Have a side hustle? No problem. We love entrepreneurs! Most importantly, come as you are and make your own way.

GoDaddy is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. GoDaddy will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with local and federal requirements. Refer to our full EEO policy.

Our recruiting team is available to assist you in completing your application. If they can be helpful, please reach out to myrecruiter@godaddy.com.

title: Sr Manager-Tech Project Management - Enterprise AI Platforms
description:
Joining Amex Tech means discovering and shaping your contribution to something big. Here, you can work alongside talented tech teams and build a unique career with the Powerful Backing of American Express. With a range of opportunities to work with the latest technologies, and a commitment to back the broader engineering community through open source, our mission is to power your success. Because Amex Tech is powered by our technology, our culture, and our colleagues.

The successful candidate will act as strategic partner to the foundational delivery teams to enable AI capabilities for American Express at scale and serve as a trusted strategic thought partner to senior business, product, and technology leaders, actively shaping solution design, implementation strategy, and execution approaches to deliver sustainable business and technology outcomes.

title: Director, Vehicle Acquisitions
description:
Your Mission:

Your mission as a critical member of our Fleet Operations team, is to establish strategic OEM and dealer partnerships while building a best-in-class procurement operation powered by data and technology—enabling predictable stock availability, improved margins, and faster fulfillment for our customers. Your goal is to procure fleet more efficiently so that we can accelerate the transition of ICE vehicles (internal combustion engine) to EVs (electric vehicles) and decarbonize our planet. The Director of Acquisitions leads the sourcing and procurement of vehicles, equipment, parts, and services that support the company's fleet maintenance operations and its clients' fleets. The role owns the order-to-delivery pipeline, vendor and OEM relationships, cost and contract negotiation, and the verification and documentation controls that ensure what is ordered is what is delivered, billed, and serviceable. Success depends equally on commercial acumen, operational discipline, and sound, confidential judgment in vendor and client dealings. Additionally, this role will be responsible for growing and developing technology, processes and controls for the Acquisition team.

  • Verify every purchase against a window sticker and/or detailed build sheet, confirm specs before delivery and payment, and retain records digitally
  • Negotiate and manage vendor and OEM contracts, rates, SLAs, and warranty terms, holding partners accountable to them
  • Develop, build and manage secondary dealer code and OEM Factory ordering to include API data transfers and OEM vehicle locating tools
  • Reconcile quotes, purchase orders, and invoices so that ordered, delivered, and billed always match. Full and complete knowledge of dealer rebates, incentives and available pricing reductions
  • Protect customer confidentiality — sharing client identities with vendors only where a signed contract and NDA are in place
  • Lead, develop, and hold accountable the acquisitions team, and coordinate cross-functionally with operations, sales, and client success
  • Maintain timely, proactive updates to internal and external business partners through the company's workflow systems
  • Plan and manage the build out of our Fleet Procurement team to support our vehicle portfolio growth
  • Plan and build acquisition platforms that best utilize technology and efficiency to meet growing business needs


Who You Are:

  • Progressive experience in fleet or automotive acquisition/procurement; including a leadership role
  • Experience building and supporting technology roadmaps and implementing technology solutions
  • Working knowledge of OEM / Dealer vehicle pricing, specs, build sheets, upfitting, and OEM/dealer fleet processes

  • Demonstrate knowledge of dealership / OEM incentives and discounts

  • Fluency with fleet/maintenance management platforms, ERP, and procurement/workflow tools
  • Track record of process discipline, documentation, and proactive stakeholder communication
  • Our core values (see below) are part of your inherent DNA, and you have many examples of when you demonstrated these values in your career


Salary: $140,000- $160,000 + Bonus Eligibility


Location: This role is remote eligible. However, we have an office in Washington, DC. Our in-office teams come together for collaborative work in the office Tuesday through Thursday and work remotely on Monday and Friday.


Why You’ll Love Working Here:

At Inspiration Mobility, you won’t just fill a role—you’ll help build the company. We’re a fast-growing, mission-driven team tackling real, complex challenges at the intersection of transportation, energy, technology, and finance. You’ll have the autonomy to take ownership, move quickly, and turn ideas into action, with leadership that values pragmatism, creativity, and momentum. We believe in clear accountability, low ego, and learning as we go—giving you the chance to shape how we operate, scale, and win, while doing work that has a meaningful impact on the future of mobility.


Our Core Values:

Inspiration’s culture is based on a shared respect for our core values described HERE. Fit with these values is a critical component of our hiring process, and employees are expected to demonstrate these behaviors in their interactions with colleagues, customers, and all stakeholders. An assessment of how each employee has exhibited our values is an important part of our performance review process.


Our Commitment to You:

Inspiration is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. We are committed to DEIB initiatives and to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.
