title: Engineer I- Sr (Nuc)
description:
Job Title: Engineer I- Sr (Nuc)

Work Place Flexibility: Onsite

Legal Entity: Entergy Operations, Inc.-EOI

*This position can be filled as a Mechanical Engineer I , II , III , Sr, based on experience.**

Job Summary / Purpose

Plant Support Engineering provides technical support for plant systems, components, and related programs. This role is responsible for establishing, maintaining, and revising as necessary, the design configuration to optimize component and system reliability. Control and maintain design basis and licensing basis information. Ensure changes made to the plant are accurately recorded in critical documents such as drawings, calculations, and electronic databases. Resolving day‑to‑day plant issues, maintaining configuration control, supporting Maintenance and Operations, and ensuring the reliability and performance of plant systems. The position serves as a key interface between Engineering and other station departments while contributing to both emergent troubleshooting and long‑term program health. Members of the team are expected to engage cross functional teams to resolve equipment challenges, develop engineering change products, support of the system improvement by identifying and scoping plant changes. Provides timely and accurate estimate designs to implement plant modifications. Design engineers are expected to maintain an understanding of the scope and status of design changes being prepared on their assigned system, components, and programs.

---

Job Duties / Responsibilities

• Identify and resolve plant issues, including those arising from significant events and complex technical challenges.

• Provide technical support to Maintenance and Operations for troubleshooting equipment, systems, and emergent conditions.

• Develop and issue engineering changes, including design modifications and temporary alterations, in support of plant needs and equipment reliability.

• Maintain Emergency Response Organization (ERO) qualifications and perform associated duties as required.

• Provide technical information and guidance related to program bases, performance requirements, compliance status, and industry operating experience.

• Plan, prioritize, and support project lifecycle activities, including corrective action plans and improvement initiatives.

• Prepare engineering products in accordance with established standards, procedures, and quality expectations.

• Support changes in system and component configuration, design, and associated design basis.

• Serve on outage engineering support teams for online system outages and refueling outages.

• Perform failure evaluations and support or lead root cause analyses, as needed.

• Ensure lessons learned from fleet operating experience are incorporated into site programs and processes.

• Maintain required qualifications and complete training necessary for assigned duties.

---

Minimum Requirements

Education

• Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering from an ABET‑accredited program

OR a related physical science discipline associated with power plant operations,

OR equivalent work experience demonstrating success at the electrical engineer/technical specialist level.

Electrical / Instrument and Controls Engineering is desired.

Experience

Experience levels vary by position:

• Engineer I / Technical Specialist I: 0–2 years of nuclear design, operations, or equivalent experience

• Engineer II / Technical Specialist II: 2–3 years

• Engineer III / Technical Specialist III: 4-5 years

• Senior Engineer / Technical Specialist IV: 6-8 years

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

• Strong communication and teamwork skills.

• Proficiency in PC applications, engineering tools, and analytical systems appropriate to the engineering level.

Certificates / Licenses (Desired)

• SRO license or certification on a PWR or BWR.

• Professional Engineer (PE) license.

title: Lighting Designer 3
description:
EwingCole is a nationally recognized architecture, engineering, interior design and planning firm with offices across the country. Our multi-disciplinary practice is built on the core values of professional excellence, design quality and collaboration. We are looking for an Lighting Designer 3 to join our team in our Philadelphia or Wayne office.


The Lighting Designer 3 leads the design and documentation of lighting systems across a wide range of project types, scales, and market sectors. This role provides project-level leadership, overseeing coordination, and quality of work for lighting design teams. The Lighting Designer 3 applies advanced design, technical, and industry knowledge to guide project delivery, mentor junior staff, and contribute to client presentations and project strategy.


Essential Functions:

This position demonstrates advanced skills in:

  • Documentation: Guiding the modeling and creation of drawings used to accurately deliver projects, reviews key project decisions with Discipline leadership
  • Software: Understanding the software analysis to ensure accuracy
  • Building Technology: Applying an understanding of construction methods to building design, including advanced integration of lighting systems and controls across disciplines
  • Project Delivery: Progressing project work from schematic design through construction documentation, ensuring design and production efforts are completed within the project schedule and budget
  • Codes: Ensuring project designs and construction documents comply with applicable lighting, energy, and emergency lighting requirements
  • Quality Standards: Promoting project quality through adherence to and the ongoing improvement of the company standards applying lighting design best practices and industry standards
  • Sustainability: Conceiving projects with rigor to resolve energy and environmental impacts and meet sustainability goals
  • Design Generation: Initiating the design approach to distinctive solutions which consider the totality of a project, including development of advanced lighting system concepts and specialized design applications
  • Material Research: Selecting lighting and control systems and identifying appropriate applications that consider the lifecycle of the products and system performance
  • Construction Administration: Managing the construction phase through responsive coordination with the builder to maintain design intent and contractual requirements
  • Calculations: Determining and applying calculation and analysis models to evaluate engineering conditions and guide project design decisions, performing and reviewing lighting calculations to inform fixture selection and layout
  • Cost Consciousness: Analyzing construction cost estimates for alignment of design intent and approved budgets and develops alternatives for controlling project costs
  • Design Communication: Conveying lighting design intent, technical decisions, and cost implications to clients, consultants, and project teams, including leading client presentations and discussions
  • Specification Writing: Defining the design intent for material qualitative requirements and performance standards to ensure contractually enforceable and accurate representation of the design

Exhibits proficient ability in:

  • Profitability: Effectively managing fees, resources, and the project delivery schedule to ensure the financial health of a project, including assignment of tasks and coordination of team workload

title: Shift Lead
description:
At Copperstate Farms and Sol Flower, we’re creating a better kind of cannabis company. Where we know happy plants begin with happy people. We aspire to high standards, take pride in our work, and drive for better results every day. At the greenhouse, our roots are growing flower, but we’ve branched out to offer an extensive range of cannabis products like edibles, topicals, and concentrates for retail dispensary locations. From farm to market, we are committed to the quality of our products and are always testing for patient and customer safety. By bringing together best practices from big agriculture, consumer packaged goods, and pharmaceutical and retail industries, Copperstate is becoming one of the top cannabis companies to work for.

What We’re Growing:

As one of the largest greenhouse cannabis producers in North America, Copperstate Farms ranges over 1.7 million square feet of canopy and 40 acres under glass. It’s here where we have been growing a house of cannabis brands that our patients and customers can trust, each addressing a different needs state and demographic. From the greenhouse to corporate to multiple Sol Flower dispensaries, we’re an inclusive cannabis community empowering wellness for all. Most of all, we strive for a culture where our employees view us as one of the best places to work.

Job Description:

The Shift Lead is responsible for providing an outstanding customer experience while working closely and collaboratively with other retail staff members to meet revenue goals, lead the retail team, and develop the dispensary staff. The Shift Lead should have a genuine passion for the Cannabis industry and the well-being of its customers and staff. The Shift Lead will ensure that customers’ needs and expectations are met through optimal product selection and top-notch customer service. Ideal candidates should be strong people developers, possess excellent communication and problem-solving abilities, be action-oriented and committed to the highest level of service.

Core Responsibilities:

Duties of this job include, but are not limited to:

  • Drive the shift and motivate an elevated level of service and productivity amongst the dispensary team; assist in operations such as opening and closing procedures.
  • High level proficiency and ability to perform the position of Store Associate throughout the shift.
  • Ability to hit sales KPI’s at the highest level as well as teach and coach Store Associates to elevate individual and store performance.
  • Maintain a clean and organized work environment.
  • Answer questions or assist with escalated customer issues to ensure efficient flow and operation of the front of the house.
  • Work effectively and respectfully with fellow co-workers and other team members.
  • Expert level proficiency in all aspects of retail dispensary duties.
  • Communicate and recognize employees to promote a positive team culture.
  • Assist in training new employees on policies, processes, procedures, and roles.
  • Handle customer and employee requests appropriately.
  • Provide administrative and managerial support to General Manager and Assistant General Manager.
  • Proficiency in all aspects of cash handling including but not limited to cash drops, closing registers and cash audits.
  • Balance cash registers and ensure accurate daily deposits.
  • Adhere to all cannabis state-specific regulations and laws to execute and enforce compliance efforts.
  • Participate in ongoing education and professional development opportunities.
  • Manage operations for smooth opening and closing procedures per hours of operation.
  • All administrative duties relating to the POS system which can include but are not limited to: Inputting purchase orders, running product reports, and identifying trends.
  • Additional duties as assigned by management.

Commitment & Dependability:

  • Willingness to be an integral member of a successful team.
  • Dedication to provide the highest levels of service.
  • Excellent attendance and reliability.
  • Adherence to company policies and procedures.
  • Expectation to work evenings, weekends and holidays as required.
  • Properly handle confidential customer information and other non-public company proprietary information.

Qualifications and Education:

  • Must be at least 21 years of age.
  • Must be able to pass a background check in order to obtain, and maintain, a Facility Agent card in accordance with Arizona State Department of Health Services requirements.
  • Minimum of 1 year supervising or retail management experience with at least 1-2 years dispensary experience.
  • Associates or bachelor's degree is preferred; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Technologically advanced individual with working knowledge of cannabis POS (point of sale) systems.
  • Outstanding leadership, organizational, interpersonal, time management and communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Knowledge of the cannabis industry.

Physical Requirements:

  • Requires prolonged sitting, standing, walking, bending, lifting, and use of hands.
  • Frequently required physical exertion to manually move, lift, carry, pull, or push heavy objects or materials.
  • Frequently stooping, bending, and reaching.
  • Must work indoors and outdoors year-round.
  • Must work in noisy and crowded environments.
  • Lift 25-50 pounds from the floor to a waist-high table when necessary.
  • Crouch & bend often.
  • Stand for short/high periods of time.
  • Sit for short/medium periods of time.
  • Walk for short/high periods of time.
  • Occasionally sit on the floor or at floor level.
  • Handle the responsibilities and routine stress often associated with this position.

  • Cannabis Education course – New Hire.

title: Lead Global D2C Excellence & Transformation Manager
description:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Head of Global D2C Transformation

San Mateo, CA / Hybrid

The Head of Global D2C Transformation will be responsible for leading the global Direct-to-Consumer Operations transformation agenda for PlayStation. Working in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment, they will act as the key interface between B2C/D2C commercial teams and the Operations division of Sony Interactive Entertainment globally.

Reporting into Global Operations, this role will gather, shape, prioritize, and funnel commercial and business requirements into the relevant Operations functions, ensuring that D2C activities are supported, scalable, and aligned to the global growth plan for PlayStation Direct.

The Head of Global D2C Transformation will lead the growth and development program for D2C Operations, partnering with Supply Chain, Logistics, Customer Service, Planning, Finance, Technology, and regional Operations teams to improve service levels, unlock operational efficiencies, and support continued D2C expansion.

What You’ll Be Doing:

This senior leader will build strong relationships with global commercial, business, and operations partners to ensure D2C requirements are clearly understood, prioritized, and translated into operational plans and initiatives.

Lead the global D2C Operations transformation roadmap, ensuring Operations is prepared to support PlayStation Direct growth across new markets, product categories, service models, and customer expectations.

Drive operational readiness for key D2C initiatives, including PlayStation Direct geo-expansion, expansion of the D2C product range, and the development of scalable systems, processes, and capabilities.

Create and present insights that identify opportunities for strategic and continuous improvement, providing commercial and business teams with initiatives they can capitalize on or use to support their own growth plans.

Partner with Operations functions to improve customer service levels, operational efficiency, delivery performance, cost effectiveness, and end-to-end execution for D2C customers globally.

Establish governance, forums, reporting, and performance metrics to track progress against the global D2C Operations growth plan.

Key Areas of Focus:

D2C Growth & Geo-Expansion

  • Support global PlayStation Direct market expansion planning and execution.
  • Coordinate operational requirements across regions and functions.
  • Ensure new market launches are supported by scalable operational processes.
  • Identify operational risks, dependencies, and opportunities linked to D2C growth.

Commercial & Business Requirements

  • Act as the central Operations intake point for D2C commercial and business requirements.
  • Translate commercial ambitions into operational capabilities, roadmaps, and delivery plans.
  • Prioritize requirements with stakeholders based on customer impact, growth potential, cost, complexity, and strategic value.
  • Ensure Operations teams are aligned to D2C business priorities.
  • Understand systems architecture of front-end commerce, payments, fraud, through post purchase, payment & audit.

Operational Excellence & Service Improvement

  • Develop systematic and operational efficiencies that improve service levels for D2C customers.
  • Partner with Logistics, Supply Chain, Customer Service, Planning, Technology, and Finance to improve end-to-end D2C performance.
  • Identify and remove operational barriers to D2C growth.
  • Drive continuous improvement across processes, systems, governance, and ways of working.

Insights, Strategy & Transformation

  • Generate and present insights that highlight opportunities for growth, efficiency, and customer experience improvement.
  • Take ownership of the D2C Operations MRP Roadmap
  • Use data, operational performance, and business feedback to shape transformation priorities.
  • Recommend initiatives that support commercial teams and unlock further D2C growth.
  • Track progress, benefits, and performance against the D2C Operations transformation agenda.

What We’re Looking For:

  • 12+ years’ experience in Operations, Transformation, D2C, eCommerce, Supply Chain, Commercial Operations, or a related field.
  • Experience working in a global matrix organization with senior commercial and operations stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of D2C/eCommerce business models, customer expectations, and operational requirements.
  • Proven ability to translate commercial strategy into operational plans and delivery programs.
  • Strong program leadership, governance, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence across functions, regions, and levels of seniority.
  • Strong analytical capability, with experience turning data and insights into actionable recommendations.
  • Commercial awareness and strong financial acumen.
  • MBA or BA/BS in Business, Supply Chain, Operations, Strategy, or another related field preferred.

At Nextiva, we’re reimagining how businesses connect, bringing together customer experience and team collaboration on a single, conversation centric platform. Powered by AI, driven by human innovation.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead our mid-market customer experience product strategy. You'll work directly with customers, partners, and internal teams to identify market opportunities, shape product direction, and bring innovative omnichannel and AI-powered experiences to market. The AIM team is responsible for targeting, acquiring, engaging, and retaining commercial customers across online and offline channels while delivering world-class analytics, insights, and data products for the Global Commercial Services (GCS) business. In this role, the incumbent will play a key role in shaping analytical strategies, leading complex initiatives, and driving business outcomes for the Prospect Direct Mail channel within AIM.

Purpose of the Role: The Senior Analyst will independently lead complex, high-impact analytical initiatives supporting Commercial Prospect Direct Mail campaigns, with a focus on driving profitable customer acquisition, revenue growth, and marketing investment efficiency. The incumbent will be responsible for developing advanced analytical solutions, identifying strategic growth opportunities, and translating complex business challenges into actionable recommendations through machine learning, statistical methodologies, and disciplined test-and-learn approaches. The role requires strong analytical judgment, technical expertise, and the ability to influence strategic decision-making across cross-functional partners. The ideal candidate will demonstrate ownership of end-to-end analytical initiatives, proactively identify opportunities to enhance targeting and campaign performance, and effectively communicate insights to senior stakeholders. This position operates in a highly collaborative environment, partnering with Marketing, Finance, Decision Science, Technology, and other teams across Global Commercial Services to deliver measurable business impact.

  • Independently lead complex analytical initiatives to drive profitable acquisitions, optimize marketing investments, and improve return on investment (ROI), acquisition, and revenue performance within the Direct Mail channel.
  • Define, design, develop, and implement advanced analytical and data science solutions across the end-to-end Direct Mail campaign lifecycle, from prospect identification and targeting through campaign execution and performance measurement.
  • Identify strategic growth opportunities and develop data-driven recommendations to influence channel strategy, investment allocation, prospect targeting, and offer personalization in partnership with GCS Prospect Marketing, Finance, and Investment Optimization teams.
  • Lead the evaluation of new commercial data sources and collaborate with external data vendors to assess data quality, incremental value, and opportunities to enhance targeting effectiveness.
  • Develop and optimize sophisticated prospect segmentation, targeting, and offer strategies by leveraging statistical modeling, machine learning, and advanced analytical techniques to maximize acquisition profitability and customer value.
  • Translate complex and ambiguous business challenges into structured analytical and machine learning problems, partnering with Decision Science teams to evaluate model performance, quantify business impact, and identify opportunities for model enhancement.
  • Collaborate with Machine Learning and Technology teams to guide the development and implementation of scalable analytical solutions that improve targeting efficiency, campaign effectiveness, and operational performance.
  • Design and lead analytical experimentation, including A/B testing and performance measurement, to evaluate strategic initiatives, generate actionable insights, and continuously improve marketing effectiveness.
  • Serve as a trusted analytical partner to cross-functional stakeholders, synthesizing complex findings into clear, actionable recommendations and influencing business decisions through data-driven insights.
  • Provide analytical thought leadership and technical guidance to colleagues, promoting best practices, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement in analytical methodologies and processes.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Physics, Engineering, Finance, or Economics).
  • Demonstrated experience independently leading complex analytical initiatives and influencing cross-functional teams to deliver measurable business outcomes.
  • Strong programming skills with experience in big data technologies (e.g., Hive, Spark) and analytical programming languages such as Python, R, or Java.
  • Strong SQL skills and demonstrated ability to work with large, complex datasets to develop scalable analytical solutions.
  • Advanced technical and analytical skills, including statistical analysis, predictive modeling, segmentation, optimization, and experimental design (e.g., A/B testing).
  • Strong analytical and conceptual thinking skills, with demonstrated ability to independently structure ambiguous business problems, develop innovative solutions, and translate complex findings into actionable business recommendations.
  • Proven ability to communicate analytical insights and strategic recommendations to senior leaders and stakeholders in a clear, concise, and compelling manner.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently in a matrixed organization, manage competing priorities, and influence cross-functional partners across Marketing, Finance, Decision Science, Risk, Technology, and external vendors.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to connect analytical solutions to measurable outcomes, including acquisition growth, marketing efficiency, profitability, and revenue performance.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master's degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Physics, Engineering, Finance, or Economics) or MBA with a strong quantitative background.
  • Strong knowledge of machine learning techniques, including XGBoost, Decision Trees, and Natural Language Processing (NLP) models.
  • Experience in marketing analytics, customer acquisition, campaign optimization, or investment optimization, preferably within financial services.
  • Experience evaluating machine learning model effectiveness and translating analytical insights into business strategies.
  • Knowledge of commercial data, prospect targeting, and external data sources is a plus.
  • Experience providing technical guidance, mentoring colleagues, or leading cross-functional analytical workstreams.

title: Data Center Technician - Chester, VA
description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at .

About the Team

Our Data Center Operations team is at the physical core of our business, responsible for building, maintaining, and operating the infrastructure that powers the cloud. We are seeking Data Center Technicians across a range of experience levels to ensure service availability, physical reliability, and operational excellence across our facilities.

In this salaried, 100% on-site position, you will perform hands-on hardware and network diagnostics, equipment installations, structured cabling, and physical repairs. Your responsibilities and level of autonomy will match your experience, with opportunities to build technical skills and take on more complex work. Candidates will be leveled during the interview process based on technical expertise, depth of experience, and problem-solving ability.

This role requires participation in a rotating on-call schedule. You must live within 60 minutes of the site to support on-call responsibilities and be able to travel up to 15% to other data center locations as needed.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Data Center Operations & Maintenance: Assemble, rack, stack, and maintain data center server, storage, and networking hardware. Maintain hot/cold aisle containment, conduct inventory audits, and perform routine physical maintenance.
  • Diagnostics & Repair: Conduct hardware and network diagnostics on live and offline systems. Troubleshoot issues reported through tickets, replace components, and perform physical repairs.
  • Equipment Deployment: Support equipment installations, device provisioning, and operating system installations, taking on more complex troubleshooting and deployment work as your experience grows.
  • Structured Cabling & Security: Maintain high standards of cable management and structured cabling, and follow physical and cybersecurity protocols.
  • Process & Documentation: Maintain accurate inventory records and ticket updates. Contribute to standard operating procedures (SOPs), technical documentation, and process improvements.
  • Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing: Collaborate with local and cross-functional teams to support operational readiness. Share knowledge and contribute to team training and development.
  • On-Call & Response: Participate in a rotating on-call schedule and be available to arrive on-site within 60 minutes when an incident requires hands-on support.

Qualifications:

  • Hardware Foundation: Hands-on experience or coursework in computer hardware assembly, installation, and physical and logical troubleshooting.
  • Operating Systems & Networking: Familiarity with Linux operating systems and fundamental networking concepts.
  • Problem-Solving & Judgment: Ability to follow established procedures, prioritize tasks, troubleshoot technical issues, and recognize when to ask for guidance or escalate.
  • Communication & Teamwork: Strong organizational and communication skills, a collaborative and curious mindset, and a commitment to high reliability standards.
  • Learning & Development: Willingness to build technical skills, learn new systems, and take on responsibilities that match your experience.
  • Physical Requirements: Ability to perform the following essential duties, with or without reasonable accommodation:
    • Move and position equipment weighing up to 50 lbs.
    • Remain in a stationary position for extended periods while performing diagnostics and repairs.
    • Access equipment in confined spaces, under-floor areas, and on ladders.
    • Handle small hardware components, connectors, and cabling with precision.
    • Work in data center environments with hot/cold aisle temperatures ranging from 60°F to 90°F.

Preferred Skills:

  • Associate’s degree, bachelor’s degree, or equivalent practical experience in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Networking, or a related field.
  • Hands-on experience in enterprise or commercial data center environments.
  • Experience with Linux OS administration, command-line tools, and device provisioning.
  • Scripting and automation experience with Python, Bash, or shell scripts.
  • Networking experience with Cisco IOS, Juniper Junos, or enterprise switch/router configurations.
  • Industry certifications such as CompTIA A+, Network+, Server+, or Linux+.

Why CoreWeave?

At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:

  • Be Curious at Your Core
  • Act Like an Owner
  • Empower Employees
  • Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences
  • Achieve More Together

We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and enables the development of innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the organization’s growth opportunities are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!

Compensation & Benefits

The base salary range for this role is $65.000 to $85,000. The starting salary will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).

What We Offer

The range we’ve posted represents the typical compensation range for this role. To determine actual compensation, we review the market rate for each candidate which can include a variety of factors. These include qualifications, experience, interview performance, and location.

In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs. The benefits below reflect our US-based offerings for full-time employees; for roles in other locations, benefits vary and are shared during the hiring process. These include:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance - 100% paid for by CoreWeave

  • A work culture focused on innovative disruption

CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.

As part of this commitment and consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), CoreWeave will ensure that qualified applicants and candidates with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations for the hiring process, unless such accommodation would cause an undue hardship. title: Azure Devops Engineer
description:
Job Title: DevOps Engineer Azure, Azure DevOps & Kubernetes (AKS)
Location: Chennai (Work from Office)
Experience: 3-5 years
Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent
Notice Period: Immediate to 30 days preferred
Interview Mode: Face-to-face (in-person) at our Chennai office

About the Role
We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to design, deploy and manage cloud-native applications on Microsoft Azure. You will own CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps, run containerized workloads on AKS, and make sure our infrastructure is secure, scalable and highly available. Strong hands-on Azure and Azure DevOps experience is the most important requirement.

  • DevSecOps tooling (SonarQube, Trivy, Defender for Cloud)
  • Certifications: AZ-104, AZ-400 (DevOps Engineer Expert) or CKA

Candidate Profile

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field
  • 3-5 years of relevant DevOps/cloud experience with real Azure production exposure

title: Design Leader I - Interiors
description:
If you think your skills, experience and aspirations make you a good match for this position, we encourage you to apply.
ABOUT THE ROLE
We are seeking a creative leader who has the skills, experience and a growing reputation that reflect the importance of this role in our interior design practice. You will help us achieve our goal to be one of the most innovative, creative, and highly regarded design firms in the world. You will contribute to office leadership, nurturing and developing our people and culture and being a voice for design excellence to your colleagues, clients and the outside world.
HERE'S WHAT YOU'LL DO
Your primary responsibilities include but are not limited to the following:
  • Perform in a lead design role communicating and representing design goals to the client and the team for the life of the project, with particular emphasis on early phase development. Partner with team members, co-lead visioning and set conceptual direction. Collaborate with teams throughout all phases of development to ensure design quality. Support Senior Design Leaders on significant strategic pursuits.
  • Create innovative design concepts that synthesize our clients’ culture, goals, and aspirations with the needs of people, community, society and the environment. Deliver solutions uniquely responsive to this expanded view of design impact.
  • Prepare and direct the preparation of client presentation materials, including oversight and production of design visualizations, to convey the design in a compelling and sophisticated manner. Co-lead design presentations, with an emphasis on storytelling and aiding client understanding of the design. Capture and communicate key client goals and metrics and how our design solutions add value to our clients’ success.
  • Work within our culture of being an integrated practice by collaborating with technical leaders, subject matter experts and others, creating holistic design solutions that fulfill the complex array of demands our projects require.
  • Integrate performance-based and sustainable design strategies into design solutions. Further our goals to decarbonize the built environment and meet the AIA 2030 Commitment.
  • Engage in activities that strengthen, differentiate, and promote our brand locally, regionally and nationally. Contribute to the external recognition of our work by identifying opportunities for publication and awards and contributing to submissions.
Culture, Growth and Mentorship
Partner with us in creating a strong design culture in your office and region. You will be responsible for:
  • Mentoring and growing emerging professionals toward future creative leadership. You will assist in nurturing an environment that exemplifies collaboration, experimentation, innovation, creativity and entrepreneurship.
  • Recruiting and retaining design talent.
  • Creating a stimulating and rewarding environment that sets the tone for design excellence and demonstrates it across the firm.
  • Empowering staff and delegating effectively; building high-performance teams by encouraging innovation and continuous improvement.
  • Provoking critical thinking and critique of our work.
  • Leading by example, contributing to project pursuits that represent our future selves and advance our Living-Centered Design philosophy.
Client and Business Development
You will be responsible for developing and maintaining client relationships; building client trust and loyalty; and collaborating in bringing in work. You will be expected to build upon CannonDesign’s legacy clients, as well as your own prior relationships for these purposes. You will seek out and identify new client opportunities for CannonDesign in collaboration with the business development and marketing teams.In service of top line success, you will have a contributory goal of $1M in net signed fees, in collaboration with your office practice and market leaders.
HERE'S WHAT YOU'LL NEED
  • Bachelor or Master degree in Architecture, Interior Design, Interior Architecture or relevant required.
  • Current licensure or NCIDQ certification preferred.
  • Minimum of 12 years of experience in related roles. Interiors project experience preferred.
  • Current US Architectural Registration preferred.
  • Additional accreditations and/or training relevant to this role is preferred, including LEED.
  • Design portfolio of built and unbuilt work for which you were both primary and contributing designer. Must contain 3 or more fully constructed building designs representing a high level of design excellence.
  • Third party recognition (awards, publications) preferred.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills.
  • Must be able to understand and execute business strategy.
  • Must have professional acumen and maturity demonstrated by the ability to communicate authentically and respectfully.
  • Travel required.
For a general overview of our benefits, please visit our careers page at
ABOUT OUR FIRM
CannonDesign is a design practice where strategy, experience, architecture, engineering, and social impact converge. We don’t just dream up solutions — we create and bring them to life in ways to solve some of the biggest challenges facing our clients and the society. At the heart of everything we do is Living-Centered Design, a bold commitment to using our talents to not just improve the world but to truly reshape it for the better. It’s more than a philosophy — it’s who we are, and it drives us to make a meaningful, lasting difference every day.
ABOUT WORKING HERE
  • We are relentless in our pursuit of client adoration (not simply satisfaction). Consistent delivery of the best service is what we are about.
  • We are committed to ensuring our practice provides equal opportunities for all employees, as we strive to connect with communities around us and focus on the future of design. We support equity, diversity, and inclusion efforts that benefit all employees through the leadership of our DEI Council, our Employee Resource Groups which are open to everyone, and other community initiatives.
  • We’re about communication and transparency here. If you want to talk to someone about an idea you have, or a challenge that needs addressing, we’re ready for you.
Please note that candidates can only apply to our positions on our company Careers site. It's not uncommon for scammers to create positions that look legitimate on other sites; never enter your information or apply for CannonDesign positions on any platform. Should an issue arise that you feel we should be aware of, please contact us. Please provide your resume and portfolio when applying.
As a condition of employment, all employees are expected to complete mandatory training, including compliance training, within required timeframes and adhere to our internal policies and our Code of Conduct.

It is therefore the firm’s policy to prohibit discrimination and harassment against any applicant, CannonDesign employee, vendor, contractor, or client on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, genetic information, citizenship status, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law. title: Occupational Health Supervisor
description:
Occupational Health Supervisor – 1st shift

Pella, Iowa (hybrid)

Lead Pella Corporation’s Occupational Health nursing function and provide leadership, clinical guidance, and operational oversight for Occupational Health services across supported locations. This role supervises Occupational Health team members working within Pella’s centralized Occupational Health structure and is responsible for staff management, occupational health services, workers’ compensation case management, injury prevention and return-to-work programs, vendor management, and strategic Occupational Health projects.

The Supervisor also provides nursing assessment, intervention, and evaluation for occupational and non-occupational illnesses and injuries; manages ongoing team member care; conducts required screenings and testing; and supports preventive care and other medical needs.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Occupational Health and Clinical Services

  • Provide and oversee care for team members with work-related and non-work-related injuries and illnesses.
  • Provide nursing assessment, intervention, evaluation, ongoing care, preventive care, required screenings, and testing.
  • Maintain appropriate nursing licensure and certifications.
  • Support development and review of medical directives with appropriate medical providers.
  • Support hearing-conservation activities and required hearing testing.
  • Oversee and support Occupational Health programs including early symptom intervention, work conditioning, industrial athlete, and ergonomic assessment activities.
  • Manage Occupational Health budget responsibilities within assigned scope.

Workers' Compensation

  • Provide leadership and hands-on case management of workers’ compensation claims.
  • Coordinate with claims representatives and other workers’ compensation partners.
  • Communicate with injured or ill team members and assist in coordinating appropriate care and return-to-work activity.
  • Provide required claim documentation and participate in periodic claim reviews.
  • Support litigated claims, including communication with attorneys and attendance at claim hearings and settlement discussion when appropriate.
  • Lead and support transitional-work initiatives designed to facilitate productive and appropriate return to work.

Regulatory Compliance and Recordkeeping

  • Support OSHA compliance and recordkeeping within the position’s scope of responsibility.
  • Ensure timely and accurate documentation of care in team member health records.
  • Maintain applicable health and safety information systems and ensure health information and treatment plans are entered accurately and timely.
  • Maintain appropriate confidentiality of team member medical information and records.

Programs and Strategic Initiatives

Lead, participate in, and/or support Occupational Health initiatives / projects.

Vendor and Business Partnership

  • Research, evaluate, establish, and manage medical vendors supporting Pella locations.
  • Coordinates contracts and invoice processing associated with Occupational Health vendors.
  • Partners with HR, Safety, operations leaders, healthcare providers, claims administrators, attorneys, and other stakeholders on team member health and workers’ compensation matters. The vendor responsibilities are directly documented; the partner list is a proposed consolidation of relationships demonstrated by the underlying responsibilities.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

Provides direct supervision and leadership for members of Pella Corporation's Occupational Health team. Responsibilities include staffing, hiring, onboarding, training and development, scheduling, performance support, individual meetings, staff meetings, and responding to clinical and operational questions.

The current structure is centralized, with Occupational Health nurses supporting their primary locations as well as additional manufacturing and sales locations for Occupational Health and workers’ compensation needs.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

Requirements for this Supervisor position:

  • Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN) from an accredited nursing program.
  • Current, unrestricted Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state where employed, with ability to obtain additional licensure when required to support assigned responsibilities.
  • Five or more years of professional nursing experience, with occupational health, workers’ compensation, manufacturing, employee health, or related experience strongly preferred.
  • Prior leadership, supervisory, or demonstrated clinical-leadership experience in an Occupational Health setting preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex occupational injury and workers’ compensation cases preferred.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES AND REGISTRATIONS

Required:

  • Current Registered Nurse licensure in the state where employed.
  • Current CPR certification.
  • AAHON certification preferred.
  • CAOHC certification preferred.
  • COHN/COHN-S certification preferred.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES

  • Strong clinical judgment and ability to assess occupational and non-occupational injuries and illnesses.
  • Knowledge of occupational health principles, workers’ compensation case management, injury prevention, return-to-work practices, and occupational health recordkeeping.
  • Ability to define problems, collect and analyze information, establish facts, and draw sound conclusions.
  • Ability to interpret scientific, technical, regulatory, and legal information.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with team members, managers, healthcare providers, claims professionals, attorneys, vendors, and other business partners.
  • Ability to provide leadership and professional guidance to geographically dispersed Occupational Health staff.
  • Strong organizational, prioritization, documentation, and project-management capabilities. Pella's current nurse description expressly requires problem solving, interpretation of technical and legal materials, communication with regulators and the business community, and presentation skills.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

The position works primarily in an office setting with regular exposure to manufacturing environments. Noise levels in manufacturing areas may range from moderate to loud.

HOURS AND TRAVEL

Flexibility in scheduled hours may occasionally be required to support business needs. Travel may be required based on supported locations and business needs.

Job Description:

This role requires extended time on the road, typically 5+ consecutive days, with home time that can be planned based on operational needs and driver preferences. This position offers the flexibility to maximize earnings while ensuring the highest safety and service standards.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Safe Transportation: Hauling chemical and petroleum products using tank trailers while adhering to DOT regulations.
  • Equipment Maintenance: Ensuring your truck meets all inspection standards and remains in top condition for long-haul success.
  • Loading & Unloading: Following proper procedures for ISO/Flexi-Bag or Tanker operations at loading and delivery points.
  • Compliance & Documentation: Maintaining accurate logs, submitting necessary paperwork, and adhering to Hazmat regulations.
  • Customer Service: Representing Altom Transport professionally at all customer locations.
  • Business Management: Managing fuel purchases, trip planning, and scheduling to maximize revenue.
  • Maintain a steady workload by meeting mileage or hour requirements to contribute to the overall success of the operation.
  • 24/7 Operation – Willingness to be available 24/7 when needed.

If you’re looking for a long-term partnership with a company that values your experience, provides top-tier support, and offers high revenue potential, Altom Transport is the right fit for you!

Qualifications:

Altom Transport maintains strict driver qualifications and a safety-first culture to ensure professional, compliant, and well-supported operations. Requirements and safety standards include:

  • Late model equipment that meets Altom’s inspection standards
  • Qualifications
  • Valid CDL Class A License
  • Tanker Endorsement (N) – Required
  • Hazmat Endorsement (H) – Preferred (must obtain within 90 days of hire; assistance available)
  • TWIC Card – Preferred (or must obtain after hire)
  • Minimum 1 year of verifiable tanker driving experience
  • At least 23 years of age
  • Clean MVR and strong safety record
  • Able to pass DOT physical, drug screening, and background check
  • Dependable, safety-minded, and capable of working independently
  • Willing to work flexible schedules, including 24/7 operations if needed

Strict Driver Vetting & Qualification Process Includes:

  • Minimum of 2 years of verifiable tanker experience within the last 5 years
  • No DUI/OWI on record within the last 5 years
  • Cannot be prohibited in the FMCSA Drug & Alcohol Clearinghouse
  • No at-fault/preventable fatal or rollover accidents in the last 5 years
  • No more than 2 moving violations in the last 3 years
  • No more than 2 CSA moving violations in the last 18 months
  • No falsification on the driver application
  • Must hold a current X endorsement
  • Minimum 1-week in-person new hire training
  • Quarterly mandatory safety meetings with employees
  • HM 232 Compliance & Emergency Response Plan provided
  • General Awareness testing in accordance with 49 CFR 172-part H
  • Drug & Alcohol Policy and DOT Compliance program
  • Forward-facing cameras on all Altom and contractor equipment
  • Governed company equipment
  • Incident & Accident Investigation Program (driver reporting + injury investigations)
  • RCMS Certified / HSE policy
  • PPE provided, including replacement policy guidelines

Altom Transport operates with a “mission first, safety always” mindset, placing the safety of drivers, customers, and the public above all operational needs.

Benefits:

  • Revenue & Fuel Surcharge: Earn 68% of freight revenue + 100% fuel surcharge
  • Terminal Fueling Program: Access exclusive fuel discounts
  • License Plate Program: Simplifying administrative tasks
  • National Parts & Service Discounts: Save on maintenance + access in-house PM & repair services
  • Insurance Programs: Affordable Bobtail, Physical Damage, Occupational Accident, Disability & Health Indemnity options
  • Flexible time off based on scheduling and operational needs.
  • Weekly Direct Deposit: Get paid on time, every time

title: Professional, Asset Manager
description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries.

KKR REAL ESTATE CREDIT AND K-STAR INVESTMENT SERVICES OVERVIEW

KKR Real Estate Credit was formed in January 2015 to invest in real estate credit products and complement KKR Real Estate’s private equity platforms. Within KKR Real Estate Credit, we seek opportunities where we have a sourcing, underwriting or execution advantage by leveraging KKR’s brand, industry knowledge and relationships. KKR Real Estate Credit currently invests through eight separately capitalized vehicles across our Direct Lending and Securities portfolios and consists of 120+ dedicated professionals based in New York, San Francisco, Houston and Dallas.

K-Star Asset Management LLC ("K-Star") was formed in 2022 and is a wholly owned subsidiary of KKR. K-Star is a dedicated investment services platform that supports underwriting, asset management, loan origination, securities investing, risk management, and client experience for KKR Real Estate Credit as it continues to scale. The K-Star team includes industry specialists in special servicing, asset management, due diligence, and loan closing, among other functional areas. For additional information about K-Star, please visit K-Star’s website at .

POSITION OVERVIEW

K-Star is seeking an intelligent, analytical, and proactive asset manager to join the Credit Asset Management team. The asset manager will be responsible for the oversight and reporting on a portfolio of loans secured by stabilized, light to high transitional and possibly construction projects located throughout the United States. The asset management team takes the lead in all required loan modifications including foreclosures up to title transfers. The qualified candidate will also be expected to participate in special projects and assignments related to the growth of the platform. With a goal of process development and execution, this candidate must be an exceptional communicator and have the ability to build strong partnerships across the various KKR businesses, including the Firm’s real estate credit originations, legal, finance, and asset management teams.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Analyze and evaluate draw requests, lease approvals, loan modifications and various other borrower requests and periodic underwriting of collateral
  • Monitor portfolio performance for potential adverse credit issues and trend analyses
  • Analyze and utilize monthly and/or quarterly financial statements and rent rolls with comparison against underwriting and budgets
  • Monitor national, regional and local market dynamics to assess tenant credit risks and concentrations
  • Prepare and present asset performance reports to company management and other investor parties
  • Collaborate with construction consultants and other members of the project team to monitor schedules, budgets, leasing and business plans in real time
  • Interpret complex loan documents to confirm and track satisfaction of relevant loan terms and covenants
  • Work closely with investment team on relationship management of transaction sponsor
  • Partner with internal and external legal counsel when evaluating legal issues and documenting various transactions arising from the asset management of the portfolio
  • Mentor and coach portfolio analysts in analyzing operating statements and rent rolls and supporting other asset management responsibilities
  • Manage special projects, including implementation of new technologies to support K-Star’s platform
  • Travel on an as needed basis

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience preferably in a related course of study
  • 5-7+ years of related work experience in asset management of loans secured by commercial real estate
  • Fundamental knowledge of commercial real estate, fixed income, and general financial concepts
  • Superior analytical and financial modeling skills
  • Excellent organizational, verbal, and communication skills
  • Exceptional attention to detail and thoroughness is required to ensure accuracy in all data and work product
  • High proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint and Outlook
  • Special Servicing, Argus, construction loan or development experience a plus
  • Team Player with collaborative and strong relationship building skills with the ability to work independently in a way that reflects the company’s culture and core values
  • Skilled at developing and maintaining personal, social and business relationships representing KKR in a professional manner

The Emergency Management Manager is responsible for Disaster Preparedness and the Emergency Management for the West Chester Hospital campus. title: Senior Product Manager, Sports
description:
About the role


We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to own our sports product and turn Chartmetric’s data and AI capabilities into something sports marketers, agencies, teams, and brands can’t work without.

Working closely with our CPO, our data engineering and product teams, and our go-to-market leads, you’ll decide what we build for sports, why, and in what order. You’ll be accountable for whether the product earns real usage and revenue.

This is a builder role. You’ll be close to the data and the customers, prototype ideas yourself when it’s faster than writing a spec, and stay involved from discovery through launch and iteration.

You won’t need to know our music business. You will need a sharp sense of how sports fandom, audiences, and marketing work, and the judgment to tell a real customer need from noise.


What you'll do


Own the sports product. Set the vision, strategy, and roadmap for our sports offering. Decide which customers we serve first, which problems we solve, and what we say no to.

Turn signals into customer insight. Synthesize what you learn from customer calls, sales conversations, support tickets, product usage, churn, market trends, and competitor moves. Separate what customers say from what they actually need, and use that to make clear product bets.

Build products around fandom and audience. Shape how we measure and surface athlete, team, and league audiences, fan engagement, social growth, and brand affinity in ways that drive real decisions for sports marketers and partners.

Vibe-code your ideas into working prototypes. Use AI coding tools like Cursor, Claude Code, Replit, or Lovable to build functional prototypes, internal tools, and demos yourself. Put real, clickable products in front of customers and engineers instead of static specs, and validate ideas before committing the team to them.

Work deep in the data. Write SQL, explore datasets, and build your own analyses and dashboards to understand sports audiences, fan behavior, and product usage. Partner with data engineering on what we collect and how it’s modeled, define product metrics, and spot when a number doesn’t add up.

Validate with the market. Run discovery with teams, agencies, brands, and athlete representatives. Get early versions in front of customers, measure adoption, and adjust fast.

Partner with go-to-market. Work with sales and marketing on positioning, pricing, packaging, and launches. Help the team understand who buys, why, and what wins deals.

Connect product to the business. Define the metrics that matter, report on progress and risks, and help leadership understand where sports can grow and what it will take.


Qualifications


  • 5+ years in product management
  • SQL
  • Workflow Automation (with python, vibe-coding etc)
  • Web Apps
  • Data Visualization


You should apply if: You’re a builder. You have 5+ years in product management and can point to products you took from idea to real adoption. You’re comfortable prototyping, querying data, and using AI tools to move faster instead of waiting on others.

You have strong judgment about customers. You pull insight from many sources, including interviews, usage data, sales feedback, market research, and industry trends, and you know how to weigh conflicting signals. You can explain why you believe something, and you change your mind when the evidence does.

You know sports. You’ve built or managed products in sports, ideally around sports marketing, sponsorship, audience analytics, fan engagement, or fandom. You understand how teams, leagues, athletes, agencies, and brands think about audiences and measure value.

You’re comfortable with data. You can work with analytics and engineering teams on how data is collected and modeled, write SQL or work with someone who does, and recognize when a number doesn’t make sense.

You’re comfortable in a lean company where product leaders stay close to the work. Experience with data or analytics products, B2B SaaS, social and audience data, or AI-native products is a plus. Music-industry experience is not required.

title: Cybersecurity System Administrator
description:
Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities: (Knowledge, skills, and behaviors required for this position.)

  • Assist in identifying, prioritizing, and coordinating the protection of critical cyber defense infrastructure and key resources. Employ approved defense-in-depth principles and practices (e.g., defense-in-multiple places, layered defenses, security robustness).
  • Develop, implement, and maintain cyber security technical controls and operational systems.
  • Analyze organization's cyber defense policies and configurations and evaluate compliance with regulations and organizational directives. Coordinate with intelligence analysts to correlate threat assessment data.
  • Conduct required reviews as appropriate within environment (e.g., Technical Surveillance, Countermeasure Reviews [TSCM], TEMPEST countermeasure reviews). Perform technical (evaluation of technology) and nontechnical (evaluation of people and operations) risk and vulnerability assessments of relevant technology focus areas (e.g., local computing environment, network and infrastructure, enclave boundary, supporting infrastructure, and applications).
  • Develop and conduct cyber security related human performance improvement projects.
  • Build, install, configure, and test dedicated cyber defense hardware.
  • Perform system administration on specialized cyber defense applications and systems (e.g., antivirus, audit, and remediation) or Virtual Private Network (VPN) devices, to include installation, configuration, maintenance, backup, and restoration.
  • Administer test bed(s), and test and evaluate applications, hardware infrastructure, rules/signatures, access controls, and configurations of platforms managed by service provider(s).
  • Create, edit, and manage network access control lists on specialized cyber defense systems (e.g., firewalls and intrusion prevention systems). Identify potential conflicts with implementation of any cyber defense tools (e.g., tool and signature testing and optimization).
  • Monitor external data sources (e.g., cyber defense vendor sites, Computer Emergency Response Teams, Security Focus) to maintain currency of cyber defense threat condition and determine which security issues may have an impact on the enterprise.
  • Coordinate with Cyber Defense Analysts to manage and administer the updating of rules and signatures (e.g., intrusion detection/protection systems, antivirus, and content blacklists) for specialized cyber defense applications.
  • Identify potential conflicts with implementation of any cyber defense tools (e.g., tool and signature testing and optimization).
  • Follow software and systems engineering life cycle standards and processes. Develop applicable metrics and monitor results.
  • Implement Risk Management Framework (RMF)/Security Assessment and Authorization (SA&A) requirements for dedicated cyber defense systems within the enterprise, and document and maintain records.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Education, Credentials, and Work Experience:

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution.
  • Level 1: High School and 6 years of relevant experience or Bachelors Degree Level 2: High School and 8 years of relevant experience or Bachelors Degree and 2 years of experience or Masters Degree

Preferred

  • Bachelor's degree in a related technical field including computer science, computer engineering.
  • Experience working with AI, Security +, and Splunk general.
  • Direct technical experience working in Enhanced Security Environments.

The job requires hand/finger dexterity to keyboard or type, handle materials, manipulate tools, and reach with hands and arms. title: Engineer I/II, Research Operations (1st shift)
description:
Your Impact at LILA

Lila Sciences’ Research Operations team executes the automated laboratory workflows that power our scientific platform. We are seeking a versatile and detail-oriented Engineer I/II who can quickly learn and independently execute high-throughput workflows across a range of biological applications, including DNA, RNA, mRNA, protein, and cell-based workflows.

You will remain part of Research Operations while working closely with a cross-functional team of scientists and engineers, providing the scientific and operational context needed to execute, evaluate, and improve laboratory systems. You will operate laboratory automation and instrumentation, monitor workflow performance and quality-control results, troubleshoot issues, maintain operational readiness, and translate workflow observations into improvements that strengthen reliability and scalability.

This is an on-site, first-shift role, with scheduled hours of either 7:00 AM to 3:00 PM or 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM based on operational needs. Level will be determined based on experience, technical breadth, and demonstrated independence.

What You'll Be Building

  • Independently execute high-throughput automated and manual workflows across DNA, RNA, mRNA, protein, cell-based, and other biological applications.
  • Prepare and verify reagents, samples, labware, and consumables required for workflow execution.
  • Operate liquid handlers, plate readers, incubators, integrated workcells, and other laboratory instrumentation.
  • Serve as a scientific and operational partner to cross-functional teams, translating workflow requirements, observations, and performance issues into actionable feedback.
  • Monitor workflow execution and quality-control results, troubleshoot common equipment or process issues, and coordinate escalation of complex failures.
  • Perform startup, shutdown, cleaning, routine maintenance, and readiness activities to support safe and reliable operations.
  • Maintain accurate and traceable workflow records, SOPs, technical instructions, and cross-shift handoffs.
  • Identify and implement improvements that strengthen workflow reliability, efficiency, scalability, and operational coverage.

What You'll Need to Succeed

  • Bachelor’s degree in Biology, Chemistry, Biotechnology, Bioengineering, or a related scientific or engineering field, plus a minimum of 3 years of relevant industry laboratory experience; applicable co-op experience may count toward this requirement.
  • Hands-on experience with core laboratory techniques such as pipetting, reagent preparation, sample handling, serial dilution, plate-based workflows, or aseptic technique.
  • Experience operating laboratory automation or instrumentation in a research, production, or high-throughput environment.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to interpret quality-control results, recognize unexpected workflow behavior, perform initial troubleshooting, and escalate appropriately.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to follow SOPs and technical instructions while maintaining accurate, complete, and traceable documentation.
  • Demonstrated ability to learn new scientific workflows, work independently, manage competing priorities, and apply training accurately as operational needs evolve.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to work effectively across scientific, engineering, and operational teams.
  • Ability to work on-site during first shift, with scheduled hours of either 7:00 AM to 3:00 PM or 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM based on operational needs.

Bonus Points For

  • Hands-on experience across more than one biological workflow area, such as DNA, RNA, mRNA, protein, mammalian cell culture, or LNP.
  • Experience operating laboratory automation platforms such as Hamilton, Tecan, Beckman, Echo, Opentrons, or similar systems.
  • Experience partnering with hardware or automation engineers on instrument integration, testing, qualification, user acceptance testing, or workflow deployment.
  • Experience troubleshooting laboratory instrumentation, performing routine maintenance, or supporting root-cause investigations.
  • Experience reviewing and interpreting quality-control data generated by automated laboratory workflows.
  • Familiarity with laboratory information management, sample-tracking, maintenance, or workflow-scheduling systems.
  • Experience identifying and implementing process improvements.
  • Willingness and flexibility to provide occasional second-shift coverage from 2:00 PM to 10:00 PM with advance notice, based on operational needs.

Compensation

We offer competitive base compensation with bonus potential and generous early-stage equity. Your final offer will reflect your background, expertise, and expected impact.

U.S. Benefits. Full-time U.S. employees receive a comprehensive benefits program including medical, dental, and vision coverage; employer-paid life and disability insurance; flexible time off with generous company wide holidays; paid parental leave; an educational assistance program; commuter benefits, including bike share memberships for office based employees; and a company subsidized lunch program.

International Benefits. Full-time employees outside the U.S. receive a comprehensive benefits program tailored to their region. USD salary ranges apply only to U.S.-based positions; international salaries are set to local market.

Expected Base Salary Range
$75,600—$124,800 USD

About LILA

Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves.

LILA combines advanced AI models with proprietary AI Science Factory™ instruments into an operating system for science that executes the entire scientific method autonomously, accelerating discovery at unprecedented speed, scale, and impact across medicine, materials, and energy. Learn more at www.lila.ai.

Guided by our core values of truth, trust, curiosity, grit, and velocity, we move with startup speed while tackling problems of historic importance. If this sounds like an environment you'd love to work in, even if you don't meet every qualification listed above, we encourage you to apply.

We’re All In

Lila Sciences is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

Information you provide during your application process will be handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy.

The submission of unsolicited resumes by recruitment or staffing agencies to Lila Sciences or its employees is strictly prohibited unless contacted directly by Lila Science’s internal Talent Acquisition team. Any resume submitted by an agency in the absence of a signed agreement will automatically become the property of Lila Sciences, and Lila Sciences will not owe any referral or other fees with respect thereto.

title: Engineering Manager, Lyft Business

  • Monitors customer, market and competitor activity and provides feedback to company leadership.
  • Works closely with the marketing function to establish successful patient/customer access and therapy adoption.
  • Manages customer relationships and provides leadership in advancing strategic opportunities.
  • Establishes themselves as the “Vivistim® Paired-VNS™ Patient Expert” for their assigned geography.
  • Constant driver of clinical excellence and possesses a “sense of urgency” in goal attainment.
  • Demonstrates outstanding product, technical, and clinical expertise.
  • Completes all administrative requirements on time and accurately.
  • Maintains company standards involving ethical and moral character while professionally representing the company.

Qualifications

  • Degree in Occupational Therapy, Physical Therapy required (OT, PT, COTA, or PTA)
  • Neuro-focused training background is strongly preferred.
  • Minimum of 3-5 years of documented, successful clinical/sales experience with supportive results.
  • Experience selling directly to the (Physical Medicine & Rehabilitation (PM&R/Physiatry)), Neurosurgery, and OT/PT) healthcare physician communities preferred.
  • Successfully representing and launching a revolutionary, pioneering, and disruptive technology strongly preferred.
  • Experience educating and advocating for Stroke rehabilitation patients.
  • Experience calling on hospitals and rehabilitation facilities strongly preferred.
  • Solid process orientation demonstrated resource management/allocation experience, and the ability to perform multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Intellectual, self-starter and independent thinker, with the aptitude to work autonomously.
  • Experience utilizing Salesforce or similar CRM.
  • Robust interpersonal skills, with evidence of teamwork and collaboration.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with customers and patients at all levels.
