title: Sterile Processing Tech II - Sterile Processing - Per Diem
description:
Position Summary:

The Sterile Processing Technician II acts as a clinical resource for staff and participates in the orientation, coaching and mentoring process of new employees and staff as well as participates in departmental improvement activities. The Sterile Processing Technician II will provide quality processed instrumentation, materials and equipment for patient care. The main functions of this position include: demonstrating knowledge and proper cleaning / care, handling, assembly, and sterilization of equipment and supplies based on IFUs, AAMI best practice standards, and regulatory requirements; team work participation with staff members; achieving the turn-around plans / priority processing; and maintaining a clean work environment within the department.

Experience:

2 years of surgical/ relevant experience. Must have good interpersonal skills to effectively interact with all levels of the medical staff.

Education:

  • High School education or GED required.
  • Surgical Technician, Licensed Practical Nurse or other relevant clinical surgical experience i.e. Certified Ophthalmology Assistance etc. preferred.
  • Sterile Processing Certification required.

Essential Functions:

  1. Demonstrates knowledge and understanding of instrument/ equipment Instructions for Use (IFU), AAMI standards, hospital policies and regulatory requirements.
  2. Follow Standard Work in the decontamination process to properly clean instruments in compliance with recommended IFUs to prevent contamination and infection.
  3. Follow Standard Work in the assembly process to properly assemble instrumentation following required tray assembly using “SPM” system including appropriate indicators / filters for sterilization to prevent contamination and infection.
  4. Follow Standard Work in the sterilization process to properly sterilize instrumentation following recommended IFUs to prevent contamination and infection.
  5. Follow Standard Work in case cart completion to ensure all required instruments and supplies are available for the cases to be performed to prevent delays and provide safe patient care.
  6. Follow Standard Work related to the Sterile Processing Priority Process to ensure availability of required instrumentation and supplies for the cases to be performed to prevent delays and provide safe care for our patients.
  7. Follow Standard Work for all high-level disinfection processes to properly reprocess flexible scopes and probes in compliance with recommended IFUs to prevent contamination and infection.
  8. Follow Standard Work related to Sterile Processing Vendor Process to ensure availability of required instruments and supplies for the cases to be performed to prevent delays and provide safe care for our patients.
  9. Follow Standard Work for inventory control to ensure availability of needed supplies, verify sterility/ integrity and prevent expiration of supplies.
  10. Follow Standard Work related to quality monitors/ measures related to maintenance of equipment utilized in the cleaning and sterilization process as well as other key quality measures and performance improvement activities.
  11. Communicates with others, as necessary, within and outside the department to coordinate department activities and assure needs are met in a timely fashion.
  12. Collaborates with Sterile Processing Leadership in reporting SPD departmental needs, inventory shortages and equipment repairs in a timely fashion.
  13. Demonstrates effective time management, flexibility, prioritization, and critical thinking skills in his/her performance of duties.
  14. Represents the department and hospital in a professional, courteous manner to co-workers, members of the Guthrie Healthcare system and visitors being sensitive to their perception of verbal and non-verbal communication.
  15. Demonstrates knowledge and maintains competency of standard work/ key work processes.
  16. Applies principles of microbiology, sterilization, disinfection and modes of disease transmission to promote an infection free environment.
  17. Uses proper body mechanics when moving or transferring items to prevent injury to self or others.
  18. Assists in maintaining a clean and safe work environment.
  19. Operates all required equipment and machinery accurately and safely. Maintains appropriate records and monitors quality control.
  20. Maintains competent in the use of EPIC and ensuring patient privacy is protected.
  21. Is proactive in controlling costs by seeking any cost-saving strategies and reporting them to SPD Leadership.
  22. Follows hospital/ department policies and procedures in emergency/ stressful situations; i.e. fire drills, disaster pans, etc.
  23. Identifies/ participates in departmental problem-solving actions and proper departmental escalation.
  24. Demonstrates willingness to accept non-routine work assignments as appropriate.
  25. Attends and participates in departmental staff meetings and in-services.
  26. Demonstrates willingness to participate in departmental improvement activities, process changes or implementations.
  27. Demonstrates willingness to learn, train and operate Nutrace instrument laser unit while maintaining personal and staff safety.
  28. Acts as a clinical resource for staff, participate in the orientation process and be a preceptor for new employees.
  29. Acts as coach and mentor for staff to promote utilization of standard work.
  30. Participates in educational sessions for new employees and staff.
  31. Participates in providing annual competencies for staff.
  32. Assists with the orientation of new employees.

Other Duties:

It is understood that this description is not intended to be all-inclusive and that other duties may be assigned as necessary in the performance of this position.

The pay range is $19.87 - $31.48/hour based on experience.

title: Solid Oxide Electrochemical Cells Postdoctoral Research Associate
description:
Idaho National Laboratory is seeking one or more postdoctoral researchers in the hydrogen and electrochemistry department to perform laboratory experiments for solid oxide cells at elevated temperatures. Our team works a 9x80 schedule located out of our Idaho Falls facility with every other Friday off.

The position requires knowledge and experience in at least one of the following areas:

  1. Ceramic oxygen conductor R&D with preference on fundamental understanding of solid-state physics or defect chemistry as well as the electrochemical characterizations on materials properties.
  2. Electrochemical system and test facility development include P&ID design, HAZOP/safety analysis, drafting controls and alarms documents, work control documentation development.
  3. Electrocatalysis (high temperature system with heterogeneous catalysis skills, the expertise in CO2 hydrogenation and/or N2 reduction are preferred).
  4. Ceramic cell fabrication, and manufacturing (expertise with the conventional ceramic engineering, additive manufacturing, spray coating, 3D printing and extrusion is a plus).
  5. Electrochemical cell/stack testing and characterization testing. Ideally fuel cell, electrolysis, co-electrolysis.

The position requires expertise in laboratory techniques such as Impedance Spectroscopy, GC/MS, temperature programmed experiments, etc. for in-line measurements, and other common characterization methods. The expectation for the successful candidate is that the person will be highly motivated and a self-starter, but also be capable of working well and efficiently in a highly team-oriented environment. The candidate will be required to communicate effectively with team members, mentor, and INL management.

Activities that the candidate will undertake include: hands-on laboratory collection and interpretation of data, document preparation (reports, peer-review journal articles, etc.), preparation and presentation of results and interpretations to internal and external communities, and, when appropriate, propose new research concepts and work with team members to write and submit proposals for new work. The candidate also will be required to remain current with the literature in their technical area. Additionally, the candidate will read, review, and comment on safety documentation and will maintain an orderly workspace in accordance with pertinent laboratory best practices and procedures.

Required:

  • PhD requirements in chemical engineering, material science and engineering, mechanical engineering, electrochemistry, chemistry, or related disciplines must be completed by commencement of appointment and within the previous 5 years.
  • Demonstrated oral and published written communication skills (in English).

Physical Requirements:

While performing the duties of this classification, the employee is frequently required to stand, walk, sit, stoop, bend, and work in an office and laboratory environment. The job requires hand/finger dexterity to keyboard or type, handle materials, manipulate tools, and reach with hands and arms. The job requires operation of job-related equipment. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds without assistance. Sufficient visual acuity and hearing capacity to perform the essential functions and interact with the people is required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Job Information:

title: Interior Technician III
description:
Purpose

The Interior Technician III removes, repairs, installs, and/or fabricates custom aircraft interior assemblies and components.

Essential Job Functions

• Accomplish repairs and modifications throughout the cabin in conjunction with specific drawings.

• Support engineering drawings with ideas and solutions to ensure a VIP/VVIP appearance.

• Remove and install cabin monuments including galleys, lavatories, credenzas, bulkheads, deco panels, closets, and vanities.

• Remove and install door liners, including plated items and doors requiring opening up that require further investigation to ensure doors are deactivated.

• Interpret blueprint drawings along with the AMM, IPC, and Customer-Supplied Supplement Manual.

• Interpret LOPAs in support of cabin reconfigurations.

• Perform floorboard removal and installation.

• In conjunction with a helper, learn to interpret the manuals in support of the task being performed (AMM, IPC, Customer-Supplied Supplement Manual).

• In conjunction with a helper, maintain the VIP/VVIP interior presentation at all times during work being performed — cleanliness, customer service, and overall professionalism.

• Perform lower dado panel removal and installation.

• Remove and install wet barrier mylar, seats, decorative sidewall, ceiling, valance, door surrounds, and MSA window shades.

• Remove and install existing moon mats and insulation throughout the aircraft.

• Accomplish specific cleaning tasks in support of maintenance requirements.

• Inspect, remove, repair, and install aircraft interior pieces, including doors, galleys, seats, bulkheads, floorboards, emergency path lighting, gill liners, closets, and lavatories.

• Become familiar with and follow the requirements of the RSQM, Federal Aviation Regulations, Airworthiness Directives, Advisory Circulars, manufacturer's service bulletins, and any other required references to perform assigned work. Never begin any maintenance unless in possession of the proper, current, and applicable approved or acceptable data.

• Ensure the work area is kept to the highest standards of safety, compliant at all times, enforcing regulations and practices to avoid accidents. Ensure that good housekeeping practices are performed at all times.

• Perform the proper tagging of aircraft components, parts, and panels, appropriately stored (including racks by aircraft).

• Perform documentation procedures and sign-offs in accordance with the Repair Station Quality Manual and respective task requirements.

• Ensure that tools and equipment are correctly used and handled for both safety and to reduce breakages, wear, and tear. Ensure tooling, GSE, and ground equipment is returned to its proper storage area following use.

• Strive for continuous process improvements and increasing efficiencies in execution and delivery with safety as a priority.

• Maintain close and frequent communication with the Lead Technician, notifying him/her of progress and any roadblocks or threats to task accomplishment that could impact re-delivery.

• Deal with customers in a cordial, respectful, and professional manner.

• Ensure the highest quality service, safety standards, and performance, with the objective of exceeding customer satisfaction in the re-delivery of airworthy, reliable, and clean aircraft, in a timely manner.

• Take part in any required training as determined by the company.

• Perform other duties as assigned.

Requirements

Required

• More than 10 years' aircraft structural maintenance experience on commercial narrow-body and wide-body transport-category aircraft (Boeing, Airbus) fleet types.

• Valid FAA Mechanic Certificate with Airframe rating.

• High school diploma or equivalent.

• Able to read, understand, and apply technical data, drawings, and regulatory documentation in English, and to communicate clearly with coworkers and supervisors to perform the essential functions of the position safely.

• Must report for assignment with a personal set of standard trade-specific tools.

Preferred

• Aircraft structural maintenance experience on current fleet types being maintained or modified by the Repair Station.

• Valid FAA Mechanic Certificate with Airframe and Powerplant ratings.

• Experience in V/VIP custom aircraft interior completions.

• Completion of General Familiarization Training Courses on current fleet types being maintained or modified by the Repair Station.

Supervisory Responsibilities

• This position has no direct supervisory responsibilities.

Knowledge, Skills, and Other Attributes

• Able to read and interpret engineering drawings, technical manuals, and structure repair manuals, understanding symbols, flags, and general notes; identify aircraft locations by station, butt-line, and waterline as shown on engineering documentation and technical orders.

• Able to read, interpret, and apply FAA-approved or accepted data (i.e., IPC, M/M, OHM, SRM) proficiently.

• Proven ability to work alone and in a team environment.

• Effective decision-making skills.

• Dependability: personally responsible, completes work in a timely manner, and performs tasks accurately.

• Motivation: must maintain a positive attitude and strong work energy.

• Organization: very detail oriented and always prepared.

Working Conditions

• This position is considered OUTDOOR WORK, characterized as follows.

• Requires frequent walking, standing, and/or climbing.

• Expected to work through specially designed airframe, engine, and undercarriage openings while standing on ladders or scaffolds; to use hoists and lifts; and to use required precision instruments and other necessary tools.

• Exposure to climate changes normally experienced in an aviation repair facility.

• This position is considered MEDIUM work, with frequent lifting up to 20 lbs and occasional lifting up to 50 lbs; occasional climbing, stooping, kneeling, squatting, and reaching, with repetitive movements of arms and hands and seated work with back supported.

title: Sales Engineer/Business Development Manager

Location and Travel

Why Apex

title: Senior Validations Specialist
description:
Position Overview

The Senior Validations Specialist is responsible for the analysis and interpretation of genetic data using computational and statistical methods, and for the validation activities that ensure our assays, pipelines, and data systems are accurate, reliable, and ready for use. Working with large-scale genomic data sets, this role identifies patterns and trends, implements quality control measures, and uses a variety of bioinformatics tools - developing new software applications where needed to solve problems in the field of genomics.


As a global company with a presence in the United States, the United Kingdom, and Australia, we operate as lean, hands-on teams where every role has real ownership and visible impact. This position suits someone who moves with urgency, approaches challenges with a solutions-first mindset, and enjoys the pace and variety that come with contributing to moderately complex aspects of projects both independently and collaboratively.


Accountabilities and Responsibilities

Validation and Verification:

  • Design, execute, and document validation and verification studies for assays, bioinformatics pipelines, instruments, and data analysis workflows in line with regulatory and accreditation requirements.
  • Define acceptance criteria, analyze validation data, and prepare clear, well-organized validation reports documenting the performance metrics of pipelines and products, ensuring that they are in compliance with required quality guidelines.
  • Drive validation activities to completion with urgency, proactively removing roadblocks and keeping stakeholders informed of progress and risks.

Bioinformatics Analysis and Interpretation:

  • Analyze and interpret large-scale biological and genomic data sets using computational and statistical methods.
  • Identify patterns, trends, and anomalies in sequencing and genotyping data, and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
  • Apply sound statistical rigor to study design, data analysis, and interpretation of results.

Quality Control and Data Integrity:

  • Implement and maintain quality control measures to ensure the accuracy, reliability, and reproducibility of collected data.
  • Monitor pipeline performance metrics, investigate deviations, and lead root-cause analysis with a solutions-first mindset.
  • Support internal and external audits, inspections, and accreditation activities as they relate to validated systems and data.
  • Write, review, and update standard operating procedures relevant to validation and quality control procedures in compliance with regulatory requirements.

Tools and Software Development:

  • Use a variety of bioinformatics tools and platforms; evaluate, select, and configure tools to fit business and scientific needs.
  • Document tools, pipelines, and processes so that knowledge is shared and work is repeatable across the team.

Collaboration and Continuous Improvement:

  • Work independently on moderately complex aspects of projects while collaborating closely with laboratory, quality, and product teams.
  • Contribute to a lean, efficient way of working by simplifying processes, eliminating redundant steps, and sharing improvements across teams.
  • Bring energy, ownership, and a can-do attitude to cross-functional initiatives, helping the team move quickly without compromising quality.


Position Requirements

Skills and Knowledge:

  • Strong knowledge of bioinformatics tools, pipelines, software, and databases used in genomics (e.g., NGS and genotyping analysis workflows), including proficiency in Linux/UNIX environments
  • Working knowledge and understanding of molecular biology and genetic laboratory testing workflows
  • Proficiency in computational and statistical methods for analyzing large-scale biological data sets
  • Thorough knowledge of quality control principles, validation and verification practices, and regulatory standards published by national and international accrediting programs (e.g., CLIA, CAP, COLA, NYSDOH, ISO 15189, ISO/IEC 17025, UKAS, etc.)
  • Proven experience drafting technical validation plans, summary reports, and standard operating procedures in a regulated clinical laboratory environment
  • Clear written and verbal communication, with strong documentation habits
  • A sense of urgency, a solutions-first mindset, and the resourcefulness to thrive in a lean, fast-moving environment

Experience:

  • Typically requires 4-7 years of related experience in bioinformatics, genomics data analysis, laboratory process validation and quality assurance, and/or regulatory compliance, within a laboratory or biotechnology setting
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and collaboratively, contributing to complex aspects of projects

Education

  • Ph.D. or M.S. degree in Genetics, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, or a related field required


Key Relationships / Stakeholders

Internal Stakeholders:

  • Bioinformatics and Data Science teams
  • Laboratory Operations
  • Quality Assurance and Regulatory Affairs
  • Research and Development / Product teams
  • IT and Software Engineering

External Stakeholders:

  • Accreditation and regulatory bodies (e.g., CAP, CLIA) during audits and inspections
  • Instrument, reagent, and software vendors
  • External collaborators and reference laboratories, as required


Decision Making

Decisions this role makes alone:

  • Selection of analytical methods, statistical approaches, and bioinformatics tools for assigned work.
  • Design details of validation and verification studies within approved protocols.
  • Day-to-day prioritization and sequencing of tasks within assigned projects.
  • Identification and escalation of data quality issues and validation risks.

Decisions this role makes under guidance or escalates

  • Final acceptance and release of validated assays, pipelines, or systems (with Quality and management).
  • Changes to SOPs, validated processes, or regulated workflows.
  • Significant tool, software, or infrastructure purchases.
  • Project scope, timeline, and resourcing changes.


Why Join Us

At Gene by Gene, you’ll join a mission-driven team advancing the science of genetics and discovery. You’ll have the opportunity to shape meaningful campaigns, tell compelling brand stories, and collaborate with talented professionals who share your passion for creativity, curiosity, and impact.


Comprehensive Benefits

  • Medical & Health Savings: Choice of 3 medical tiers generously sponsored by the company, with a monthly $50–$100 employer HSA contribution based on plan type and dependent level.
  • 100% Covered Dental & Vision: No premium costs for employees or dependents.
  • 401(k) Matching: Generous 50% company match up to 6% of annual base salary.
  • Diverse PTO Framework: Structured time off incorporating vacation, sick leave, mental health days, personal days, company holidays, and a flexible floating holiday.
  • Income Protection & Family Leave: Full company sponsorship of Short-Term and Long-Term Disability (STD/LTD) alongside Paid Family Leave offerings.

title: Robotics Systems & Simulation Engineer
location: South San Francisco, California, United States
description:
About Xaira Therapeutics

Xaira is an innovative biotech startup focused on leveraging AI to transform drug discovery and development. The company is leading the development of generative AI models to design protein and antibody therapeutics, enabling the creation of medicines against historically hard-to-drug molecular targets. It is also developing foundation models for biology and disease to enable better target elucidation and patient stratification. Collectively, these technologies aim to continually enable the identification of novel therapies and to improve success in drug development. Xaira is headquartered in the San Francisco Bay Area, Seattle, and London.

About the Role

We are building a next-generation lab automation and robotics platform that brings together robotic systems, simulation, computer vision, and AI to improve the speed, reliability, reproducibility, and scale of experimental biology.

As a Robotics Systems & Simulation Engineer, you will connect digital environments with physical systems and make robotic capabilities easier to adapt to new equipment and settings. You will own the simulation and digital-twin infrastructure that lets us bring vision-guided robots to new instruments quickly, and build the venue to test robotics control, perception and embodied AI. Working alongside robotics, AI, software, and automation engineers, you will develop and validate integrated systems from prototype through real-world operation.

This is a on-site hands-on role spanning software, 3D geometry, simulation, and hardware. We value strong fundamentals, practical problem-solving, and the ability to learn across disciplines using modern engineering and AI development tools.

What You’ll Do

  • Build integrated Real2Sim and Sim2Real workflows that can be reused across robotic platforms and laboratory environments.
  • Create and validate digital twins from CAD, robot and sensor models, and reconstructed scenes, including coordinate alignment, articulation, and collision geometry.
  • Connect simulation, perception, motion planning, and physical execution through the existing robot control stack, including robot state feedback and synchronization; investigate discrepancies between simulated and measured behavior.
  • Integrate AI models and task-level state machines with simulation and robotic tools, including structured requests, action validation, and execution feedback.
  • Build synthetic-data and augmentation workflows, along with synchronized video and telemetry capture, replay, and evaluation tools.
  • Benchmark system accuracy, reliability, latency, and GPU resource use; improve performance across local and cloud computing environments.
  • Collaborate with software engineers on reusable configuration and operator tools; validate new installations and reduce manual setup effort.
  • Work with scientists to integrate new capabilities, debug physical systems, and document architecture, experiments, and operating procedures.

Qualifications (Required):

  • Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field. Recent graduates with substantial relevant research or project experience are encouraged to apply.
  • Strong software engineering skills in one or more languages such as Python, C++, or C#, with experience developing and debugging integrated applications in Linux.
  • Hands-on experience building or extending robotics simulations or digital twins using Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, Gazebo, or comparable tools.
  • Solid understanding of 3D coordinate transformations, robot kinematics, calibration, and the relationship between simulated models and physical systems.
  • Experience integrating robots, sensors, or other physical systems through APIs, SDKs, ROS2, or comparable middleware.
  • Familiarity with GPU computing and cloud-based workflows for simulation, AI, or data processing.
  • Strong debugging and experimental skills, clear technical communication, and the ability to learn unfamiliar methods while critically validating software and AI-generated outputs.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with 3D reconstruction, CAD/robot-model pipelines, RGB-D perception, multi-view fusion, or learned scene representations.
  • Experience integrating LLMs, vision-language models, AI agents, or Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers with external tools and physical systems.
  • Experience with spatial or object reasoning, active perception, or perception of transparent, reflective, or partially occluded objects.
  • Experience with video understanding, human-object interaction, learning from demonstrations, imitation learning, or other robot-learning methods.
  • Experience with GPU profiling, CUDA programming, accelerated inference, or edge deployment.
  • Experience with 6-axis robotic arms, mobile robots, laboratory instruments, or hands-on mechanical prototyping.
  • Experience integrating robots, sensors, or other physical systems through APIs, SDKs, ROS2, or comparable middleware.
  • Experience mentoring students, interns, or junior engineers.

What We Offer:

  • Hands-on ownership of robotics and simulation systems in a state-of-the-art biotechnology laboratory.
  • Opportunities to work across biology, mechanical and computational engineering with AI, software, automation, and scientific teams.
  • Access to advanced robotic platforms, scientific instrumentation, GPU computing, and AI development tools.
  • Technical mentorship, the opportunity to mentor research interns and residents, cross-disciplinary growth, and the opportunity to contribute to AI-enabled drug discovery in a collaborative environment.

Compensation

We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, seeking to provide an open, flexible, and friendly work environment to empower employees and provide them with a platform to develop their long-term careers. A Summary of Benefits is available for all applicants. We offer a competitive package that includes base salary, bonus, and equity. The base pay range for this position is expected to be $150,000 - $185,000 annually; however, the base pay offered will vary depending on the market, job-related knowledge, skills and capabilities, and experience.

description:
Avetta is building the largest global community of hiring clients and suppliers that are Ready to Work. Its unified platform streamlines compliance, prequalification, safety and performance benchmarking in a single, integrated experience. Trusted by 360,000 businesses across more than 120 countries, Avetta blends AI-driven insights and human expertise to close risk gaps and strengthen supplier reliability so projects start on time, risks are managed proactively and operations scale with certainty.

SUMMARY

Avetta is evolving beyond traditional Agile and SAFe delivery frameworks into an AI-Augmented Product Development Lifecycle (AI-PDLC) a structured pipeline where AI agents assist at every stage, from product discovery through to production release, while humans retain ownership of every key decision.

As an Agile Project Manager (APM) in the AI-PDLC, you are the connective tissue of that pipeline. You don't just track progress, but you ensure the right human judgment is applied at the right gates, so AI-generated work meets Avetta's quality bar before it moves forward.

This role is ideal for a mid-level Agile delivery professional who is confident running cross-functional initiatives, comfortable working directly with product and engineering pod teams, and genuinely curious about how AI is reshaping software delivery.

Candidates residing within 30 miles of an Avetta office are required to follow a hybrid work schedule of three days in the office and two days working from home each week. Candidates residing more than 30 miles from an Avetta office may be considered for remote employment.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Pipeline Coordination & Flow Management
    • Own end-to-end delivery flow for one or more initiatives across Avetta's 5-zone AI-PDLC pipeline — from validated discovery through to production release.
    • Track initiative progress using the 3 Red Box milestone model (pipeline entry → approved spec → production), with cycle time and throughput as primary delivery metrics.
    • Coordinate zone-to-zone handoffs, ensuring the right sign-offs are in place before any AI-generated artifact like spec, task breakdown, or code advances downstream.
    • Facilitate the Spec Agreement gate: the checkpoint where both the Product Manager and Tech Lead confirm intent and approach before AI-assisted coding begins.
    • Maintain the Gate Decision Log in Confluence for each initiative: what was reviewed, what was decided, and what changed: the audit trail proving human judgment drove every step.
    • Flag missing or incomplete dependencies (such as the SDAP coding rulebook) early; no AI coding work moves forward without them.
  • Cross-Pod Dependency Orchestration
    • Coordinate across 3–5 person delivery pods, acting as the integration point for work spanning multiple teams, domains, or codebases.
    • Facilitate cross-pod syncs focused on AI pipeline blockers, spec quality issues, and zone-to-zone handoff readiness, replacing traditional Scrum of Scrums.
    • Own RAID and decision logs at the initiative level, with specific attention to AI pipeline failure modes such as unresolved spec questions and AI output drift.
    • Partner with Scrum Masters to surface and escalate pod-level blockers before they become pipeline bottlenecks.
  • Stakeholder Management & Communication
    • Act as the primary communication point between Product Management, engineering pod leads, Release Management, and senior stakeholders for initiative status, risks, and key decisions.
    • Prepare concise, data-driven updates for monthly C-level reporting, structured around pipeline volume, spec approval rate, and production throughput.
    • Communicate spec quality issues and AI agent output concerns clearly, with proposed mitigations not just escalation.
    • Help PMs set stakeholder expectations around AI-PDLC timelines, which may differ from traditional Agile estimates.
  • Spec Quality & Gate Integrity
    • Apply the Spec Rubric (a pass/fail quality checklist) at the approved-spec gate to ensure no work is greenlighted below the agreed quality standard.
    • Surface and report spec rejection patterns as early-warning signals — high rejection rates predict downstream delivery slowdowns.
    • Ensure Definition of Ready criteria are met before any initiative enters the delivery zone.
    • Track open spec questions across initiatives and ensure they are resolved — not bypassed.
  • Tooling, Metrics & Continuous Improvement
    • Maintain delivery data in Jira, Aha!, and Confluence aligned to the AI-PDLC pipeline; log gate timestamps accurately for cycle time reporting.
    • Build and maintain dashboards tracking key metrics: cycle time, throughput, spec rejection rate, PR review cycles, and human gate hours per initiative.
    • Use AI productivity tools (Glean, Claude, Jira automation/Scriptrunner/Atlassian Intelligence) to reduce manual tracking overhead and surface blockers proactively.
    • Coach pod teams and stakeholders on AI-PDLC process expectations, HITL (Human-in-the-Loop) gate responsibilities, and how to engage productively with AI agents.
    • Champion the principle: “The AI generates artifacts; humans own decisions.”
    • Contribute improvement observations back into the AI-PDLC framework: this is a living system and your insights matter.

IDEAL EXPERIENCE, EDUCATION & TRAINING:

  • Experience
    • 3–5 years in Agile delivery, project management, or program coordination in a SaaS or software environment.
    • Hands-on experience with cross-functional teams (Product, Engineering, QA, Design).
    • Background in organizations undergoing Agile or technology transformation; AI-augmented delivery experience is a strong plus.
  • Agile & AI-PDLC Skills
    • Solid understanding of Agile/Scrum frameworks with ability to adapt ceremonies to AI-augmented team models.
    • Familiarity with Spec-Driven Development (SDD) — understanding that input spec quality directly drives AI output quality.
    • Working knowledge of human-in-the-loop (HITL) gate concepts and the distinction between AI-generated artifacts and human-owned decisions.
  • Tools
    • Proficiency with Jira, Scriptrunner, Confluence, and Aha! for initiative tracking, gate logging, and reporting.
    • Experience with AI productivity tools (Atlassian Intelligence, Glean, Claude, or equivalent).
    • Comfortable with Microsoft Teams and SharePoint for distributed team collaboration.
  • Soft Skills
    • Strong written and verbal communication: able to translate AI pipeline status into clear, business-relevant updates for any audience.
    • High judgment and organizational discipline; able to manage multiple initiative workstreams without losing sight of gate integrity.
    • Collaborative, proactive, and comfortable influencing without direct authority.
    • Change-agent mindset with genuine openness to rapid iteration as the AI-PDLC framework matures.
  • Education
    • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field; or equivalent practical experience in Agile delivery or program coordination roles.
  • Certifications (Preferred, Not Required)
    • SAFe and AI fluency credentials (SAFe (SA / SSM / SASM / SPC), AWS AI Practitioner, Google AI Essentials) are weighted above traditional PM certifications (CSM / PSM I–II, CAPM / PMP for this role.

title: Revenue Manager
description:
Job Summary

Omninet Capital is seeking an experienced, commercially minded Revenue Manager to lead pricing strategy and revenue optimization across our multifamily portfolio. This role owns revenue management processes, renewal strategies, market intelligence, and actionable performance insights for both existing properties and new acquisitions.


Working closely with Asset Management, Regional Managers, and onsite teams, the Revenue Manager will lead pricing discussions, translate market and property-level data into decisions, and drive improvements in occupancy, rental revenue, and net operating income (NOI).


Responsibilities

Revenue Management & Pricing Strategy

  • Own portfolio pricing and revenue management strategy, including revenue management platform configuration, pricing parameters, lease terms, amenity premiums, and data integrity.
  • Set and adjust rental pricing by property, floor plan, unit type, and renovation level to balance occupancy, leasing velocity, and rent growth.
  • Lead renewal pricing and offer strategy, monitoring retention, lease expirations, exposure, and revenue impact.
  • Evaluate concessions and promotions and direct timely adjustments based on performance and market conditions.
  • Identify and implement ancillary revenue opportunities, including parking, laundry, technology fees, and other income streams.

Acquisitions & Asset Strategy

  • Partner with Asset Management and Operations on acquisition underwriting, market rent assumptions, pricing strategies, and Year 1 revenue plans.
  • Develop revenue strategies for new acquisitions, lease-ups, repositioning, and stabilization, including opportunities from unit renovations, amenity premiums, and ancillary income.
  • Proactively identify underperforming assets and develop actionable revenue improvement plans with property leadership.

Market Intelligence & Competitive Analysis

  • Oversee market surveys and competitive sets, including competitor outreach and property visits.
  • Analyze rent comparables, new supply, demand, employment trends, and submarket dynamics to inform portfolio pricing decisions.
  • Anticipate market shifts and communicate risks and opportunities with recommended actions.

Financial Analysis & Performance Reporting

  • Own revenue models, dashboards, forecasts, and recurring portfolio reporting, translating results into clear recommendations for leadership.
  • Monitor occupancy, effective rents, lease trade-outs, renewal conversion, concessions, leasing velocity, and revenue growth.
  • Lead weekly pricing and renewal meetings and partner with Asset Management on budget performance, forecasts, and business plans.

Technology, Process Improvement & Collaboration

  • Establish portfolio revenue management standards, reporting procedures, controls, and pricing best practices.
  • Coach Regional Managers and onsite teams on pricing execution and effective use of revenue management tools.
  • Leverage AI, automation, and analytics to strengthen forecasting, streamline reporting, and improve decision-making.

Qualifications

  • 5–10 years of progressive experience in multifamily revenue management, pricing, asset management, or closely related real estate functions, including substantial hands-on responsibility for portfolio revenue strategy.
  • Demonstrated experience owning multifamily pricing decisions and leading revenue management discussions across multiple properties.
  • Hands-on expertise with multifamily revenue management platforms such as YieldStar/AIRM, LRO, or comparable systems required.
  • Strong knowledge of multifamily operations, leasing economics, occupancy management, concessions, and renewal strategy.
  • Working knowledge of Yardi and EliseAI preferred; advanced Excel and financial modeling required. Experience with Power BI or similar tools preferred; SQL a plus.
  • Strong business judgment, executive communication, stakeholder influence, and the ability to coach property teams without direct reporting authority.
  • Experience supporting acquisitions, lease-ups, repositioning, or asset stabilization strongly preferred.
  • Comfort using AI and automation tools responsibly, including validating outputs and applying sound commercial judgment.
  • Ability to travel to properties up to 25% of the time.


Location: Dallas, TX (HQ2)

Job Type: Regular, Full-Time

Compensation Range: $95,000-$120,000 base salary, consumerate on experience, + annual performance bonus

title: ETQ QMS System Administrator
description:
About Us

Founded in 2015 to develop the world’s first industrially scalable laser metal additive manufacturing solution, VulcanForms is reshaping how the world manufactures critical products. We build and operate advanced digital infrastructure that enables innovation, accelerates growth, and supports sustainability across aerospace, defense, medical, and other essential industries. Our team brings deep expertise in manufacturing, materials science, software, automation, and operations, united by a shared commitment to quality, curiosity, and accountability. We foster an inclusive culture where people take ownership, solve meaningful problems, and continuously learn, because we believe diverse perspectives lead to better outcomes.

VulcanForms Inc. seeks an ETQ QMS System Administrator for our Devens, MA location (hybrid).

About the role

As the ETQ QMS System Administrator, you’ll own the administration, configuration, and day-to-day support of our ETQ Reliance Quality Management System (QMS). You’ll be the go-to resource for end users across the business, troubleshooting and resolving incidents, configuring workflows to match evolving quality and business needs, and keeping the platform stable, reliable, and aligned with how our teams actually work.

Working closely with Quality, IT, and business stakeholders, you’ll gather and analyze requirements, translate them into system configurations, and rigorously prepare, execute, and validate tests before changes reach production, coordinating User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to confirm every release meets business needs. You’ll support continuous improvement initiatives that help the platform scale alongside VulcanForms’ growth.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys being the trusted expert for a critical enterprise system and wants to help build a best-in-class quality platform in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

Key Responsibilities

• Act as the primary functional analyst and administrator for the ETQ Reliance QMS platform, providing application support and guidance to end users across the business.

• Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve incidents related to ETQ Reliance QMS, identifying root causes and implementing lasting solutions.

• Administer and configure the ETQ Reliance platform to keep it stable, secure, and aligned with business needs.

• Design and configure workflows that translate business processes into effective system solutions.

• Elicit, document, and analyze business requirements from stakeholders, and translate them into functional specifications and system configurations.

• Develop test plans and scripts, then prepare, execute, and validate testing to confirm changes meet business and quality requirements.

• Coordinate and facilitate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), gathering stakeholder feedback and driving issues to resolution.

• Evaluate platform usage and performance to identify opportunities for continuous improvement and recommend enhancements.

• Monitor application stability and data integrity, ensuring ongoing alignment with evolving business requirements.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience; MBA or other advanced degree is a plus.

• Proven experience administering ETQ Reliance, or a comparable enterprise QMS, including platform configuration and workflow design, ideally within a manufacturing or regulated industry.

• Prior experience with QMS system implementation, such as leading or supporting a platform rollout from design through go-live.

• Experience in functional and/or corporate application support, including troubleshooting and resolving end-user incidents.

• Experience gathering and analyzing business requirements and translating them into system configurations.

• Experience preparing, executing, and validating tests, including coordinating User Acceptance Testing (UAT).

• Familiarity with quality processes and standards such as CAPA, document control, audits, change management, ISO 9001, and AS9100.

• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills, with proficiency in Jira, SharePoint, and Microsoft Office.

Benefits

• Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance are available to you starting on your first day of employment.

• Generous time off package, including vacation PTO, sick PTO, and 14 company-paid holidays.

• 401(k) with company match and stock options.

Equal Opportunity Employer

VulcanForms Inc. is committed to being an Equal Opportunity Employer, valuing employees with diverse, multi-cultural perspectives. We are dedicated to fostering an inclusive environment, empowering our team, and embracing diversity. We welcome all applicants and ensure fair and impartial treatment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, legally protected physical or mental disability, protected veteran status, status in the U.S. uniformed services, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

title: Vital Records Specialist 1- 006480
description:
Purpose/Description

The Vital Records Specialist 1 perform highly difficult, complex, and responsible office work, handling complex public contact, reviewing and processing various vital statistics documents such as Marriage Licenses, Birth and Death Records, Notary Commissions, Assumed Business Names, and CPL Applications. Vital statistics documents, as listed above, are utilized for various purposes, i.e. obtaining benefits such as social security and retirement benefits, state financial assistance, etc. Vital statistics documents are in most cases, treated as legal documents. The Vital Records Specialist 1 provides services to clients in the approximately 40 cities and townships located in Wayne County along with others who require our services.

Required Tasks

  • Enforces the Vital Records Act by ensuring all instructions and regulations are followed according to state regulations. Oversees that all documents are completed and accurate.
  • Provides information through mail, phone, both local and worldwide for people requesting information on obtaining birth, death certificates i.e., law enforcement, adoption agencies, genealogy, legal offices, veterans administration, social security etc.
  • Handles public requests and provides information by resolving/referring a wide variety of problems regarding birth and deaths requested at the window.
  • Monitors window, answers phone calls, and refers customers to the appropriate office. Issues certified vital records to customers at the window and documents all daily transactions.
  • Files and distributes certified death records to funeral home directors.
  • Maintains confidential personal information that must be safeguarded to prevent damage to customer’s lives.
  • Utilizes sound judgment and caution in communications with individuals inside and outside the Department.
  • Validates all identification and evidentiary documents presented by customers and agencies.
  • Processes and issues receipts for required fees for all services provided.
  • Accurately enters data and create records into various vital record programs in response to customer requests for certifiable copies of birth, death, marriage, CPL, assumed names, notary, etc.
  • Prepares end of the day reports for Vital Chek, counter operations and marriage report to submit to the State of Michigan.
  • Detects errors and make corrections according to appropriate MCL.
  • Compiles data into electronic form for uploading by referring to computerized indexes, card files, microfiche, typed and handwritten ledgers, and vault books.
  • Assists with training for new employees to be able to accurately enter vital record information.
  • Provides fast and accurate customer services for requests of vital records for the public and other governmental agencies.

QUALIFICATIONS

Educational/Experience Requirements

  • High School Diploma or equivalent; AND
  • At least two (2) years of full-time paid relevant clerical or administrative experience

NOTE: Equivalent part-time experience in a law firm will be assessed and credited at the discretion of the Department of Personnel/Human Resources.

SPECIAL CONDITIONS Employees will be fingerprinted and must pass a national criminal background check before being placed in this position and periodically thereafter.

TYPES OF ASSESSMENTS A Written Assessment (100%) covering knowledge of general office practices, general clerical abilities, basic math skills, general clerical practices and procedures and related knowledge. Online virtual testing and testing at the Guardian Building is available.

title: Clinical Services Specialist, Transplant, Full-Time, First Shift
description:

title: AI Enablement Manager
location: Bellevue, Washington, USA; Santa Clara, California, USA
description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for an AI Enablement Manager to join our team. This is a hybrid in-office (Santa Clara CA HQ preferred, Bellevue, WA possible) role, reporting to the Director, People Success Enablement in our People & Culture organization. As Zscaler transitions to an AI-native organization, this individual will serve as the hands-on catalyst to develop and scale company-wide enablement initiatives, reimagining workforce capability building for the age of AI. You will design workflow-embedded learning solutions, facilitate interactive learning labs, and champion human-AI collaboration to accelerate workforce productivity and responsible adoption.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Pioneer agentic enablement by designing and deploying conversational agents, contextual digital coaches, and workflow-embedded guidance rather than static LMS courses
  • Architect and scale company-wide AI capability-building initiatives, orchestrating high-impact learning sprints, live tool walkthroughs, and practical learning labs across diverse skill levels
  • Own the end-to-end enablement charter for the People & Culture organization, turning functional teams into AI power users and internal champions
  • Activate peer knowledge scaling by cultivating an internal network of AI champions to crowdsource real-world use cases and cross-team best practices
  • Establish holistic enablement measurement frameworks that track business impact, productivity gains, and reclaimed time, while ensuring alignment with security, privacy, and ethical guardrails

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You are AI-native by default. Generative AI is your everyday thought partner and productivity accelerator, instinctively collaborating with modern tools to ideate, synthesize, and iterate while applying sound critical judgment.
  • You are a pragmatic builder. You thrive on rolling up your sleeves to prototype, test, and ship hands-on enablement solutions, balancing rapid execution with user-centric value creation.
  • You thrive in dynamic environments. You are energized by emerging technology, comfortable navigating evolving priorities, and eager to adapt quickly in high-growth settings.
  • You are an engaging facilitator. You bring infectious energy, clarity, and actionable guidance to every session, creating collaborative spaces where employees at all skill levels can experiment and build fluency.
  • You are a continuous learner. You maintain relentless curiosity for advancements in AI, proactively mastering new workflows and translating complex technical capabilities into simple, accessible insights.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Demonstrated, hands-on daily proficiency using modern generative AI tools (e.g., enterprise LLMs) to develop effective enablement solutions and accelerate everyday workflows
  • 5+ years of experience in enablement, talent development, or instructional design within fast-paced environments, including direct AI enablement or AI transformation experience
  • Proven track record designing modern, bite-sized learning assets, playbooks, and toolkits embedded directly into daily workflows rather than relying on traditional long-form training
  • Demonstrated success facilitating engaging, interactive workshops and hands-on learning labs for cross-functional audiences
  • Proven ability to partner with cross-functional stakeholders to drive capability-building and organizational change initiatives

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Experience designing modern agentic learning solutions, custom internal AI assistants, or AI literacy curricula that move beyond static LMS courses
  • Prior background driving enablement or change initiatives within high-growth SaaS, enterprise software, or cybersecurity environments
  • Track record of measuring enablement success through behavioral scorecards, sentiment analysis, and tangible business impact metrics rather than traditional training completion hours

title: Shift Lead at Voodoo Dougnut
description:

Shift Leaders act as support to the restaurant managers in daily operations and are responsible for helping to set the tone, ensure memorable guest experiences, resolve issues, and proactively achieve goals. The Shift Leader must be willing to cross-train and master all positions in the restaurant. The primary responsibility of the Shift Leader is ensuring product quality and consistent service on the scheduled shift.

SHIFT

Must be open to working any 8-hour shift between 2 AM and 10 PM. Including weekends.

BENEFITS & PERKS

  • Starting Pay: $23 per hour, plus tips.
  • Dental and Vision Insurance: Available after 60 days
  • Health Insurance: Available to eligible full-time employees after 1 year
  • Transportation Benefits: Free RTD EcoPass or employee parking reimbursement
  • Additional Benefits: EAP, Critical Illness, Hospital Indemnity, and Life Insurance options
  • 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan: Available after 6 months

  • Paid Leave: Provided in accordance with applicable Colorado and federal laws
  • Supportive team environment with training and professional development opportunities

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Provide excellent guest service. Nothing is more important than being courteous, friendly, helpful, and prompt in the attention given to guests.
  • Assist in accomplishing the goals of the location set forth by the General Manager.
  • Support shifts to ensure the accurate and timely production of product, service times, and flow.
  • Maintain good morale by maintaining a professional, positive atmosphere.
  • Ensure informed communication with management and employees both verbally and via utilization of the 7Shifts Log.
  • Maintain the restaurant organized, stocked, cleaned, and sanitized.

  • Support of each shift to ensure company and brand standards are met.
  • Follow operating procedures regarding cash handling, ensuring cash control by correcting errors and watching for/reporting mistakes or theft.
  • Follow guidelines to complete daily administrative paperwork as needed and other paperwork as requested, including prohibited items logs.

  • Support new programs, policies, or products each shift, as introduced by the General Manager.
  • Assist General Manager in producing an accurate inventory. Under General Manager direction monitor inventory levels and place orders and requisitions.
  • Follows food safety and sanitation guidelines

REQUIRED SKILLS/ABILITIES

  • Genuine interest in providing a positive guest experience
  • Friendly, outgoing, approachable personality
  • Ability to lead and mentor the team to support a positive and productive work environment
  • Ability to manage complaints with professionalism.
  • Customer-oriented individual and an outstanding problem-solver.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment
  • Dependable

Restaurant: This position may require frequent exposure to a restaurant or retail operation environment. Regular exposure to varying temperatures (hot/cold/freezing), fumes, vapors, industrial restaurant equipment, noise, and guests will be a common occurrence.

Most of the workday is spent standing or walking and working in close proximity to others. Eye-hand coordination, depth perception, finger dexterity, and functional vision and speech perception are required. Some bending, crouching, pushing/pulling and lifting/lowering of 20-50 lbs. Some repetitive motions with hands, wrists, or arms. Must be able to operate all equipment used in the restaurant. Some exposure to skin irritants, electrical equipment, and sharp instruments. description:

The primary duty of the food runner is making sure that food is delivered to tables promptly and correctly. dropping off to the guests.

Hospitality – the genuine care of our guests and fellow associates; this allows us to

create Guests from Customers.


2. Teamwork – goal-oriented drive for the bigger picture supported by unselfish action

and unwavering support.


3. Pursuit of Perfection – we set the standard for the guests’ expectations; a perpetual

attention to detail and focus on the needs of the guest allows us to exceed them


4. Enjoyment in Your Work – creating a fun atmosphere that everyone enjoys being a part

of, while continuously working to meet goals and exceed expectations (fun doing work,

not only fun at work)


5. Self-Improvement – taking accountability for your actions in all situations to make

improvements upon oneself in support of the team


6. Pride – putting your name on your actions and the product that our brand creates

Supplemental pay

Benefits

title: Director of Online Admissions
description:
LIM College - The Business of Fashion & Lifestyle is currently seeking candidates for the position of Director of Online Admissions

GENERAL DESCRIPTION:
Founded in 1939 and located in midtown Manhattan, LIM College is focused on the global business of fashion and lifestyle. Offering master’s, bachelor’s, and associate degree programs, LIM prepares students forcareer success via an immersive approach grounded in real-world experience and learning by doing required internships. LIM College’s commitment to excellence in business education ensures graduates are sought after by a wide range of employers, as evidenced by a Career Outcomes Rate of 96% for the Class of 2022. Alumni excel throughout all areas of fashion and lifestyle and have gone on to work for companies such as Chanel, Gucci, Alexander McQueen, Ross Stores, The Financial
Times, Ulta Beauty, Google, Saks Fifth Avenue, Cannabis Creative, and The National Football League.

POSITION PURPOSE:
The Director of Online Admissions owns online enrollment across the full funnel, from lead generation through registration and financial clearance, for the College’s online undergraduate and graduate programs. Reporting to the Senior Vice President of Enrollment Management and Student Success, the position is accountable for meeting or exceeding budgeted start goals for each online session and leads the Online Admissions Counselor(s).
Because online programs operate on rolling admission across multiple 7.5-week sessions, the position manages a distinct, high-velocity admissions process that runs in tandem with the College’s on-ground admissions systems. The position partners with program directors and faculty and with Marketing and Communications on digital advertising content and placement, program messaging, and lead generation, and directs time-sensitive, high-touch engagement to convert students at every stage of the funnel.
The position works closely with divisional and campus partners, including the Vice President of Admissions and Enrollment Operations, the Senior Director of Graduate and International Admissions, Academic Advising, Student Financial Services, and the Registrar, to ensure admitted students move seamlessly to registered and financially cleared before each session start. The position represents the division on matters related to online enrollment as delegated and provides regular reports and updates to senior leadership.

SALARY RANGE: $95,000 - $100,000/Annually

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND BASIC DUTIES
Online Enrollment Strategy and Lead Generation
  • Develop and execute an annual online enrollment plan, in partnership with the Senior Vice President, with session-by-session start goals, budget, and tactics for online undergraduate and graduate programs.
  • Partner with Marketing and Communications, program directors, and faculty on digital advertising content and placement, landing pages, and program messaging to generate qualified leads; monitor lead volume, quality, channel performance, and cost per lead and per start; and recommend adjustments.
  • Build online pipelines through employer and corporate partnerships, alumni, and professional and industry organizations, and through community college and transfer pathways in coordination with the Senior Director of Admissions Recruitment.
  • Analyze online market, competitor, and demand trends; identify program and market opportunities; and forecast starts by session.
Funnel Management and Conversion
  • Manage a rolling-admission process across multiple 7.5-week sessions, with defined service standards for speed to lead, follow-up cadence, and application completion.
  • Direct high-touch, multi-channel engagement (phone, text, email, and video) from inquiry through start; ensure timely, personalized follow-up; and carry a caseload of prospective students as needed.
  • Oversee application review and admission decisions for online applicants in accordance with College standards, ensuring documents and credentials are collected, processed, and recorded accurately in Slate.
  • Lead admitted-to-start conversion: coordinate with Academic Advising to ensure admitted students are advised and registered, and with Student Financial Services to ensure aid is packaged and students are financially cleared before each session start; identify stalled students and intervene; and manage deferrals and re-entry to subsequent sessions.
  • Monitor funnel activity daily; identify conversion gaps by stage, program, and channel; and deploy targeted interventions.
Team Leadership
  • Hire, supervise, train, and coach the Online Admissions Counselor(s); set clear expectations and key performance indicators, including speed to lead, contact and appointment rates, applications, admits, registrations, and starts; and conduct regular individual meetings and performance reviews.
  • Monitor the quality of student interactions, response times, and student feedback, and ensure a level of service consistent with on-ground Admissions.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, urgency, and student-centered service.
Process, Systems, and Collaboration
  • Design and maintain online admissions workflows, communication plans, and session calendars in Slate, in coordination with the Vice President of Admissions and Enrollment Operations, so that the online process runs in tandem with on-ground systems.
  • Serve as the primary liaison among Admissions, Academic Advising, Student Financial Services, the Registrar, Academic Affairs, and Marketing and Communications for online student onboarding, and convene regular cross-functional session-launch meetings.
  • Plan and execute virtual information sessions, admitted-student events, and session-start touchpoints with campus partners.
  • Ensure online admissions practices comply with College policy, accreditation requirements, and state authorization and federal regulations affecting online enrollment.
  • Work with enrollment consultants, digital agencies, and vendor partners as assigned, serving as project manager where appropriate.
Data and Reporting
  • Deliver weekly funnel and start reports and session forecasts to senior leadership; query and model data to inform decisions; and track session-to-session persistence in partnership with Academic Advising.
  • Represent the division on matters related to online enrollment as delegated; serve on committees and task forces as requested; and perform other duties as assigned.
PERFORMANCE MEASUREMENTS
  • Budgeted start goals for online undergraduate and graduate programs are met or exceeded for each session and annually.
  • Speed-to-lead and follow-up standards are met, with measurable improvement in conversion from inquiry to application, admit, registration, and start.
  • Admitted students are registered and financially cleared before each session start, and melt between admission and start is minimized.
  • Lead-generation campaigns produce qualified leads at target cost, with messaging aligned with program directors and faculty.
  • Online Admissions Counselors consistently meet activity and performance metrics, and service quality is consistent with on-ground Admissions.
  • The online admissions process operates reliably in tandem with on-ground systems; Slate records are accurate; and reports and forecasts are timely.
  • Effective communication and coordination are maintained with campus partners, with clear upward reporting on progress and challenges.

REQUIREMENTS: The person selected will have the following qualifications:

EDUCATION/CERTIFICATION:
  • Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree preferred.
REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE:
  • Strong understanding of higher education academic operations, academic scheduling, academic systems, student information systems, learning management systems, data reporting, process documentation, FERPA/privacy expectations, and Microsoft Excel, including sorting, filtering, formulas, PivotTables, data validation, and data cleanup.
REQUIRED EXPERIENCE:

title: Senior Manager - Agentic Commerce Partner Integrations
description:

We leverage emerging technologies to deliver innovations that enhance how customers pay, travel, dine, and experience the brand.

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to lead partner integrations for Agentic Commerce at American Express. Working closely with AI platforms, payment service providers, wallet providers, merchants, technology partners, and internal stakeholders, you will translate platform capabilities into scalable partner implementations that drive adoption while maintaining the highest standards of customer trust, security, and operational excellence.

This position will focus on the strategy and execution required to enable seamless, secure agent-driven transactions, including defining the experiences, platform capabilities, and trust frameworks needed to scale across partners and future use cases. This position requires a unique combination of product strategy, payments expertise, and partnership management.

As a trusted, closed-loop network, American Express is uniquely positioned to extend its authentication, authorization, identity, and risk capabilities into AI-powered commerce experiences while preserving Card Member visibility and control over agent-initiated activity. By leveraging our membership model, premium brand, and differentiated data assets, this person will help define the experiences and capabilities that create value for Card Members, merchants, partners, and the broader ecosystem.

Product Strategy

  • Define partner‑specific strategies and roadmaps that support the broader Agentic Commerce vision and platform strategy

  • Analyze adoption trends, performance metrics, customer outcomes, and partner feedback to drive continuous optimization
  • Partner with platform, network, and growth teams to ensure alignment across platform capabilities, infrastructure investments, and future innovation initiatives
  • Balance near-term execution priorities with long-term strategy to support the overall product vision
  • Keep a pulse on market trends, competitive landscape, and industry shifts in payments to inform continuous product evolution
  • Collaborate across Amex Digital Labs to identify ways to continuously build better products and drive an innovation first culture

Partner Enablement

  • Lead the development and execution of strategic integrations across AI platforms, digital wallets, PSPs, merchants, and ecosystem partners
  • Translate platform capabilities into scalable partner implementations that balance customer experience, technical feasibility, risk, and business objectives
  • Influence partner roadmaps and integration priorities to align with American Express ecosystem objectives
  • Bring structure to ambiguous, cross-ecosystem problems by defining how data flows across merchants, PSPs, and AI/LLM partners to support fraud, servicing, and Card Member experiences
  • Define and manage development and release timelines, navigate complex dependencies, and clearly communicate impacts and updates to stakeholders

Risk and Compliance

  • Partner closely with Fraud and Servicing to define strategies for fraud prevention, dispute management, and call or chat handling related to agentic transactions
  • Partner with internal stakeholders such as Legal, Compliance, and Risk teams to develop and adhere to governance principles and payments regulations to ensure compliant and secure payment experiences
  • Support audit processes and respond to regulatory inquiries as needed

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in product management, leading product development initiatives, or similar role
  • Experience launching products across multi‑sided platforms and ecosystem businesses
  • Experience launching products, partnerships, or capabilities within rapidly evolving markets
  • Experience utilizing customer research, analytics, and data to drive product strategy and roadmap decisions
  • Strong customer empathy and a passion for building exceptional products and services; skilled at clearly articulating user needs and product functionality
  • Exceptional communication and relationship-building skills across cross-functional teams; able to engage, influence, and inspire stakeholders to drive collaboration and alignment
  • Ability to reconcile competing needs across customers, stakeholders, and partners, making effective decisions and gaining buy in
  • Proven experience leading strategic integrations, platform partnerships, ecosystem products, or large‑scale technology initiatives
  • Highly organized self-starter with strong ownership mentality and business track record
  • Strong understanding of APIs, platform architectures, developer ecosystems, and integration models
  • Experienced in collaborating closely with engineering; able to bridge business goals with technical implementation and speak fluently across disciplines
  • Intellectually curious with a systems-thinking mindset; able to connect dots across functions and uncover innovation opportunities within complex environments
  • Detail-oriented and analytical; adept at framing key questions, interpreting data, and making informed product decisions
  • Skilled at balancing big picture strategy and tactical details
  • Team player, comfortable with ambiguity, open to feedback, willing to collaborate and grow
  • Flexible and comfortable with iteration; embraces a test-and-learn approach and continuously adapts based on user insights, data, and team input

Preferred Qualifications

title: MFC CO-OP Intern - Spring/Summer 2027
description:
Idaho National Laboratory's Cooperative Education Program (CO-OP) offers students an extended, hands-on opportunity to apply what they're learning in the classroom alongside nationally recognized scientists and engineers. Unlike a traditional internship, a CO-OP is a longer-term commitment, students typically work with INL for two or more terms (Fall, Spring, or Summer), and these terms do not need to be consecutive.

The Project:

The Materials and Fuels Complex (MFC) is the prime testing center in the United States for advanced technologies associated with nuclear energy power systems. This complex is the nexus of research on new reactor fuels and related materials. MFC contributes significantly to the development of increasingly efficient fuels and the important work of nonproliferation. As a CO-OP student at MFC, you will join our dynamic team whose mission is to provide engineering support to the nuclear fuels and materials research facilities. This team works a 4x10 schedule and works onsite at the Materials and Fuels Complex near Idaho Falls, Idaho.

Typical Responsibilities Include:

  • Define requirements and develop design concepts
  • Complete and document detailed design
  • Develop engineering documents such as drawings, specifications, and calculations to support work assignments
  • Support instrumentation, controls, or electrical systems design and troubleshooting
  • Support software, automation, or data acquisition efforts for facility systems
  • Provide engineering support during equipment installation
  • Perform system and component testing and surveillance
  • Perform data collection and analysis
  • Solve equipment issues
  • Maintain configuration of assigned facilities and systems
  • Other duties as assigned based on project needs and student skill set

Minimum Qualifications

  • Must be registered and eligible to participate in their university CO-OP education program
  • Undergraduate students enrolled full time at an accredited college or university in Electrical, Computer, Mechanical, or a closely related Engineering field
  • A minimum overall 3.0 GPA
  • Maintenance of good academic standing in an undergraduate program of study at college/university for the duration of CO-OP participation
  • This position is subject to export control restrictions per the Department of Energy. For this reason, you must be either a US Citizen or a US Green Card holder to qualify for the job.

Application Requirements:

  • Current Resume or CV
  • Unofficial Transcripts (include current and completed degree programs)
  • Current class schedule and number of credits

Compensation:

  • Undergraduate Internships ($29.79/hour - $32.41/hour)
  • Masters Internships ($35.34/hour - $37.73/hour)
  • Multi-Level: CO-OP internships are typically multi-level posting and you will be placed at the appropriate level dependent on degree field and level of education.
  • Eligible interns are provided with paid holiday time off, and many of our internships offer travel reimbursements.

Physical Requirements:

While performing the duties of this classification, the employee is frequently required to stand, walk, sit, stoop, kneel, bend, and work in an office and laboratory environment. The job requires hand/finger dexterity to keyboard or type, handle materials, manipulate tools, and reach with hands and arms. The job may require operation of job-related equipment and driving a vehicle. Sufficient visual acuity and hearing capacity to perform the essential functions and interact with the public is required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
