title: AOC Training Management
description:
Classification: Exempt

Career Level: Associate

Role: AOC Training Management

Reports to: C2ISR Program Manager

Work Hours: 40 hour week with core hours of 9-5pm

OnPoint, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Sapient Government Services, is a vibrant, energetic, and growing ISO-certified technology and management consulting partner that provides critical thinking, strategic analysis, and thought leadership in a collaborative environment in an enduring effort to improve performance, lower costs, and achieve results for clients. We are guided by our principles: Clarity. Action. Results—for each client engagement we work to gain clarity, move into action, and achieve results. OnPoint specializes in delivering solutions in Information Assurance, Network Operations, Project Management and Systems Development.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Summary/Objective

The essential duties of this position include providing technical support for knowledge based services to ACC Command, Control, Intelligence, Surveillance and Reconnaissance Division (A3C) primarily supporting the Air Operations Center (AOC), Control and Reporting Center (CRC), Battle Control Center (BCC), Integrated Air and Missile Defense (IAMD), Joint Surveillance Target Attack Radar System (JSTARS), Airborne Warning and Control System (AWACS), E-11 Battlefield Airborne Communications Node (BACN), and Airborne Reconnaissance Operations. The position requires one-on-one interaction with USAF staff both on-premise and remotely. The position requires independent research and analysis, communication, documentation, and problem solving.

Essential Functions

· Provide expertise and advise leadership in the overall development, planning, establishment, and implementation of Combat Air Forces (CAF)/Mobility Air Forces (MAF) AOC training programs.

· Review, develop and prepare inputs for CAF/MAF AOC training program guidance. Advise leadership on AOC training programs and any implementation issues.

· Assist in the oversight of the AOC Formal Training Unit (FTU) Initial Qualification Training (IQT) program.

· Maintain and update the AOC Master Training Lists providing specific training guidance for AOC IQT, Mission Qualification Training (MQT), and Continuation Training (CT) training programs. Provide leadership with lists upon request.

· Review, develop, prepare and publish formal AF bi-annual guidance for training and evaluation of AOC weapons system (WS) personnel to include but not limited to AFI 13-1 AOC, Vol 1, AOC Training; AFI 13-1 AOC, Vol 2, AOC Standards and Evaluation; AFI 13-1 AOC, Vol 3, AOC Organization; and AFTTP 3-3.AOC – AOC Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures (TTP) or most recent document.

· Plan, organize and conduct AOC training and support conferences.

· Liaise with ACC AOC intelligence, weather, airspace, information operations, communications, HQ ACC/A589, HQ Air Force, US Space Force (USSF), AFGSC, USAFE, PACAF, and Air Mobility Commands.

· Provide operational and training requirements for the AOC, TBMCS, Tactical Data Link and GCCS.

· Provide support for AOC exercise simulation and distributed mission operations (DMO).

· Assist in reviewing, developing and preparing training inputs to support the AOC/AFFOR readiness program.

· Assist leadership to provide AOC Functional management for the FTU IQT courses.

· Actively participate in Syllabus Review events to provide inputs and changes to FTU course syllabi as well as Type 1 systems training. Advise leadership of all inputs and changes.

· Develop training requirements to include but not limited to Training Task Lists (TTL), syllabi and courseware to support AOC IQT, MQT, CT programs utilizing Instructional System Development (ISD) practices and principles.

· Support AOC Training, Standardization, and Evaluation programs by reviewing, developing and maintaining CAF AOC checklist, Tactics, Techniques, Procedures (TTPs) and Master Question File (MQF).

· Maintain Mission Essential Task Lists (METL) for AOC.

· Manage and maintain the CAF AOC’s Learning Management System (LMS) and future versions.

· Perform records management for the branch.

· Assist as Alternate AFFOR Training Management.

Competencies

· Self-motivated

· Ability to maintain an extreme sense of urgency in all interactions with the customer

· Exceptional email management and written communication skills

· Solution-oriented

· Ability to research, analyze, and create viable solutions

· Strong technical attitude and ability to quickly learn and apply technical knowledge

· Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills

· Ability to multi-task

Supervisory Responsibility

This position has no supervisory responsibilities.

Work Environment
OnPoint exercises a hybrid work environment, meaning that some work can be done remotely, while other work needs to be completed on-premise.

Physical Demands

While performing the duties of this job, the employee may be required to move physical IT equipment.

Position Type/Expected Hours of Work
40 hour work week

Travel

Occasional travel to a client site may be required.

Required Education and Experience

· USAF Training program management experience 8 Years

· USAF Headquarters Staff (NAF, MAJCOM, or above) experience working AOC program and funding actions, weapons system capabilities, developments and initiatives (3 Years)

OR

AOC operational experience with AOC weapons system capabilities, developments and initiatives (5 Years)

· Relevant experience as a project and/or program manager with demonstrated ability to perform as a senior level expert and serve as a senior project lead (6 Years)

· Experience working in a Headquarters Staff (NAF, MAJCOM, or above) environment producing decision documents, presenting briefings, building staff packages, coordinating with other staff personnel, working with other major command elements, and interfacing with USAF staffs (2 Years)

· Proficiency supporting and executing government meetings, conferences, working groups, and symposiums (3 Years)

· Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Access, PowerPoint, and Outlook) Microsoft Teams, and Adobe Acrobat software (Meets)

Additional Eligibility Qualifications
None

Work Authorization/Security Clearance
Secret

Other Duties

We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. title: Sr Field Application Scientist, Bioinformatics and ML
description:
About The Role

You will be our first Senior Field Application Scientist. You are the scientific advisor to every team training models on Harell. You know the data. You know the models. You help researchers get from first login to a model that works.

This role fits a bioinformatician, computational biologist, or data scientist working on biological data. You want a change in your day-to-day. You want to spend it with customers. You do not want to leave the science.

Why This Role

Stay close to the biology. Work with binding data few people outside the companies that generated it have seen.

Trade one program for many. See the modeling problems of teams across biotech, pharma, and academia.

Become the voice on the data. Alongside our founder, you become the person customers trust to explain what our datasets can and cannot do.

Shape how the field measures progress. Help build blind benchmarks and competitions that score every model to one standard.

What You Will Do

Advise on the data. Explain how our datasets were generated, what they measure, where they are strong, and where they run out. Help researchers match the right data to their model.
Get researchers to their first trained model. Write getting-started guides, sample notebooks, and self-serve resources. Shrink the time from first login to first training job.
Diagnose why a model underperforms. Find the cause, whether it sits in the training code, the GPU setup, or the data. Debug PyTorch and Hugging Face jobs. Tune workloads on H100 and H200 systems.
Bring the science back to the product. Turn customer friction into clear input for engineering. Shape the roadmap.

What You Bring

  • Hands-on work in bioinformatics, computational biology, or ML on biological data. Industry or academic. Graduate research counts.
  • You have trained and debugged your own models in PyTorch, Hugging Face, or a similar framework.
  • You have run training jobs on GPUs or a cluster (SLURM, cloud GPUs) and can explain why a job runs slow.
  • You want to work with customers. You get energy from helping other scientists succeed with their models, not only your own.
  • You collaborate across teams and groups. You have a track record of working with people outside your own team: other labs, partner companies, core facility users, or cross-functional groups. You are the person others seek out to make hard things clear.
  • Clear technical writing. Guides, notebooks, protocols, or docs other people use.

Bonus Points

  • Protein, antibody, TCR, immune repertoire, or binding affinity data.
  • Moving training code across GPU generations, CUDA and driver versions, or mixed precision.
  • AWS or GCP, Linux, Docker.
  • Startup or zero-to-one experience.
  • Consulting, core facility, or customer-facing work.

What This Role Is Not

Not wet lab. The work is computational.
Not sales. No quota.
Not pure research. You succeed when customers succeed.
Travel and location. Most work is virtual. Expect occasional travel to customer sites and conferences. The role is based in Bellevue, WA. No relocation assistance.

description:

About the Role

PRG is hiring a Fiber Designer to produce constructible fiber network designs for broadband clients. You’ll work on both Outside Plant (OSP) FTTH projects (aerial and underground feeder, distribution and drop design) and MDU/MXU projects (multi-dwelling unit retrofit and new-build fiber design). The work is hands-on: you’ll take a project from base data and field information through a finished design package that a contractor can build from and a client can approve.

This is a good fit for a designer who knows OSP and MDU work, is comfortable in CAD and GIS tools, and takes pride in getting the details right.

What You’ll Do

  • Design FTTH OSP networks – aerial, underground, boring and micro-trenching – with routes that are clear and constructible.
  • Design MDU/MXU fiber layouts, including building entry, risers, horizontal pathways, distribution points and unit-level connectivity.
  • Produce and audit complete design packages: construction drawings, Bill of Materials (BOM), scope of work, and client deliverables such as NTP packages.
  • Build and maintain splice matrices, fiber assignments and connectivity records.
  • Prepare and audit aerial and underground permit drawings and support ROW and easement requirements with municipalities, counties and DOTs.
  • Use field survey data, photos and walkout notes to develop and correct designs.
  • QC your own work and colleagues work against client standards before it goes out, and turn client and agency comments quickly.
  • Support as-built updates and keep design records accurate.
  • Suggest process and tool improvements that make the team faster and the work cleaner.

What You Bring

  • 3+ years of fiber design experience in OSP/FTTH, MDU/MXU, or both. Experience in both is a strong plus.
  • Working knowledge of fiber architecture: feeder/distribution/drop, splitters, terminals, fiber counts and splicing.
  • High Level Proficiency with Esri/ArcGIS is a must.
  • Basic Proficiency with design tools such as AutoCAD, MicroStation, Vetro FiberMap, 3-GIS and QGIS. Experience building splice matrices and connectivity documentation.
  • Familiarity with aerial and underground permitting and ROW/easement requirements.
  • Strong attention to detail, the ability to manage multiple projects, and clear communication with team members and clients.

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing to large-carrier or ISP design standards.
  • BOM development and material research across different OSP architectures.
  • Visio, Bluebeam or other PDF markup tools; Microsoft Office and Google Workspace.
  • Field survey or walkout experience.
  • A technical degree or certificate (GIS, CAD, engineering technology) – equivalent hands-on experience is just as valuable.

Benefits

  • Mileage reimbursement for business use of a personal vehicle.
  • Medical, dental and vision coverage for you and your dependents, starting the first of the month after your start date.
  • 401(k) plan with safe-harbor match after one year of service.

Compensation & Benefits:

  • Highly competitive salary and sign-on bonus.

  • Excellent work-life integration in a collegial and supportive atmosphere

About Nemours:

Nemours Children’s Hospital, Florida, part of the nationally recognized Nemours Children’s Health system, offers innovative, family-centered pediatric care. Located in Orlando’s Medical City, our hospital provides an ideal environment for professional growth and outstanding patient outcomes.

We encourage prospective candidates to learn more about our organization and the communities we serve. At Nemours Children’s, we’re not just treating illness; we’re helping children and families live healthier, happier lives.

title: Real Assets Product Strategy, Principal
location: New York, New York, United States
description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries.

TEAM OVERVIEW

The Global Client Solutions team (“KCS”) is KKR’s dedicated investor solutions team. KCS was formed in 2009 to invest in and focus on KKR’s relationships with current and potential investors. Today, KCS consists of over 250 executives located in 21 offices globally.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Real Assets Strategies Team within KCS is seeking an Associate/Principal to join its New York office to be focused on coordination of capital formation and product development for KKR’s Global Infrastructure business.

This individual will serve as a product specialist, working closely with the firm’s Infrastructure investment professionals and global capital raising teams. The role offers exposure to the full lifecycle of the Infrastructure platform, encompassing fund structuring, marketing, fundraising, investor engagement, and ongoing investor relationship management.

The successful candidate will play a key role in supporting live fundraising processes for KKR Infrastructure as well as ongoing investor servicing of existing clients. The Associate/Principal will collaborate closely with investment teams to develop a detailed understanding of the current portfolio, investment pipeline, and broader market environment. Specific responsibilities include:

  • Managing and responding to written and analytical due diligence inquiries from investors;
  • Coordinating with investment teams, sales, and portfolio management teams to address investors questions and prepare investor communication materials;
  • Working across Finance/Operations for ongoing fund reporting and Legal/external counsel to prepare legal documents including PPMs, LPAs, subscription documents and investor-negotiated side letters;
  • Partnering with senior team members on structuring, raising and maintaining funds;
  • Participating in interactions with prospective and existing investors and consultants;
  • Preparing, updating, and maintaining marketing materials, investor presentations, reporting, and regular updates; and
  • Supporting client-specific follow-up requests and other bespoke projects as required.

KKR’s Real Assets Strategies Team is characterized by a collaborative, performance-driven culture built on the following guiding principles:

  • Build and Maintain Relationships with Intensity: Engage proactively with stakeholders across investment, sales, operations, and legal functions, leveraging the firm’s capabilities to strengthen relationships and enhance outcomes.
  • Pursue Excellence: Deliver high-quality, accurate, and impactful work, consistently upholding the highest professional standards.
  • Act with Urgency and Ownership: Execute objectives decisively and take accountability for results, applying lessons learned to drive continuous improvement.
  • Communicate Transparently: Share information openly, raise issues promptly, and ensure clarity and alignment across teams.
  • Lead by Example: Recognize achievements publicly and provide constructive feedback privately.
  • Contribute Thoughtfully: Develop and articulate well-reasoned perspectives, embracing challenges and opportunities for growth.

IDEAL EXPERIENCE

Qualified candidates will have spent 5-7 years at an investment bank, placement agent or asset management firm with a preference for candidates with an infrastructure background. The hire will act as a gateway for global sales teams to access information for our Infrastructure investment strategies, interacting regularly with multiple parts of the firm. We are looking for team-oriented candidates with strong analytical backgrounds, outstanding oral and written communication skills, maturity, executive presence, and sound judgment.

CRITICAL COMPETENCIES FOR SUCCESS

  • Project and Time Management: Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality work under tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment, while maintaining strong attention to detail.
  • Analytical and Creative Thinking: Proven aptitude for both quantitative and qualitative analysis, with the ability to think critically, synthesize complex information, and develop innovative solutions.
  • Intellectual Curiosity and Initiative: A fast learner with strong self-motivation and a genuine interest in continuous learning, fundraising dynamics, and product development.
  • Communication Skills: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interpret information from multiple perspectives and tailor messages effectively for different audiences.
  • Organization and Precision: Highly organized with a meticulous approach to detail and a commitment to producing accurate, polished deliverables.
  • Technical Proficiency: Advanced command of Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel, with the ability to present information in a clear, concise, and visually compelling manner.
  • Content Expertise: Strong ability to understand and articulate complex concepts, translating technical information into accessible, investor-ready materials.
  • Professional Presence and Judgment: Displays maturity, sound judgment, and executive presence, with the confidence to form and express well-considered views to senior stakeholders across functions.
  • Relationship Management: Skilled in developing productive relationships across global and cross-functional teams, including effective collaboration with senior management and external partners.
  • Team Orientation: Positive, adaptable, and collaborative, with a willingness to assist colleagues and contribute to the broader success of the team.

title: Senior Director of Admissions Recruitment
description:
LIM College - The Business of Fashion & Lifestyle is currently seeking candidates for the position of Senior Director of Admissions Recruitment

GENERAL DESCRIPTION:
Founded in 1939 and located in midtown Manhattan, LIM College is focused on the global business of fashion and lifestyle. Offering master’s, bachelor’s, and associate degree programs, LIM prepares students forcareer success via an immersive approach grounded in real-world experience and learning by doing required internships. LIM College’s commitment to excellence in business education ensures graduates are sought after by a wide range of employers, as evidenced by a Career Outcomes Rate of 96% for the Class of 2022. Alumni excel throughout all areas of fashion and lifestyle and have gone on to work for companies such as Chanel, Gucci, Alexander McQueen, Ross Stores, The Financial
Times, Ulta Beauty, Google, Saks Fifth Avenue, Cannabis Creative, and The National Football League.

POSITION PURPOSE:
The Senior Director of Admissions Recruitment provides leadership for undergraduate recruitment, including first-year and transfer students, for the College’s on-campus programs, and supports the recruitment of students for the College’s online undergraduate programs. Reporting to the Vice President of Admissions and Enrollment Operations, the position leads the day-to-day performance of the undergraduate recruitment team, translating institutional enrollment strategy into disciplined execution across outreach, engagement, application generation, and yield.
The position develops and manages the annual undergraduate recruitment plan, including territories, travel, events, and communication; monitors the admissions funnel from inquiry through enrollment; and provides the coaching, training, and performance management staff need to achieve their goals.
The position works closely with the Senior Vice President of Enrollment Management and Student Success, the Senior Director of Graduate and International Admissions, and the Director of Online Admissions, and partners with Marketing and Communications, Student Financial Services, Academic Affairs, and Student Success. The position represents the division on matters related to undergraduate recruitment as delegated and provides regular reports and updates to senior leadership.

SALARY RANGE: $110,000 - $120,000/Annually

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND BASIC DUTIES
Recruitment Team Leadership
  • Directly supervise Admissions Counselors and recruitment staff; set clear expectations for daily, weekly, and seasonal recruitment activity; and monitor performance against key performance indicators, including outreach, appointments, applications, admits, deposits, and enrollment.
  • Conduct regular individual and team meetings and performance reviews; coach staff on admissions counseling, communication, and relationship-building; and address underperformance through active coaching and management.
  • Onboard and train new counselors on recruitment processes, systems (Slate), and expectations, and reinforce best practices in CRM usage, communication, and time management.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, urgency, and student-centered service, and support the professional development of staff.
Undergraduate Recruitment Strategy and Execution
  • Develop and execute an annual undergraduate recruitment plan, in partnership with the Vice President and the Senior Vice President, with defined goals, territories, travel, budget, and tactics for first-year and transfer populations.
  • Manage territory assignments and recruitment travel, including high school and community college visits, college fairs, and school counselor relations; evaluate territory performance and recommend adjustments based on data.
  • Lead transfer recruitment, including community college partnerships, transfer-specific events and communications, and support for articulation agreements in collaboration with Academic Affairs.
  • Plan and execute on-campus and virtual recruitment events, including Open House, Accepted Students Day, campus visits, and information sessions, in collaboration with campus partners.
  • Cultivate relationships with school counselors, community-based organizations, and pre-college and pipeline programs that generate qualified applicants.
  • Support recruitment for online undergraduate programs in coordination with the Director of Online Admissions, including referral of prospective students best served by online programs, shared transfer and community college pathways, and participation in joint events and communications.
Funnel Management and Yield
  • Monitor daily and weekly funnel activity from inquiry through deposit and enrollment; identify conversion gaps; and deploy targeted interventions.
  • Ensure structured, stage-based, multi-channel communication (phone, text, email, and virtual) and timely, personalized follow-up with prospective students, applicants, and families.
  • Lead yield strategy for admitted students in partnership with Student Financial Services on award communication and with Student Success on the transition to enrollment, including melt prevention through deposit and orientation.
  • Partner with Admissions Operations to ensure seamless handoffs, accurate application processing, and effective communication flows.
Data, Reporting, and Collaboration
  • Track and report recruitment activity and funnel outcomes on a weekly, monthly, and annual basis; use CRM data to inform priorities and coaching; and ensure accurate documentation of all student interactions in Slate.
  • Partner with Marketing and Communications to align outreach campaigns, messaging, and materials for first-year, transfer, and online audiences, and to inform prospective-student search and name-acquisition strategy.
  • Serve as liaison to Student Financial Services, Academic Advising, Student Affairs, and faculty to involve the campus community in recruitment and address barriers to enrollment.
  • Work with enrollment consultants and vendor partners as assigned, serving as project manager where appropriate.
  • Represent the division on matters related to undergraduate recruitment as delegated; serve on committees and task forces as requested; and perform other duties as assigned.
PERFORMANCE MEASUREMENTS
  • First-year and transfer applicant, admit, deposit, and enrollment goals are met or exceeded, and online undergraduate recruitment targets are supported.
  • A healthy admissions funnel is maintained, with measurable improvement in inquiry-to-application and application-to-enrollment conversion rates.
  • Admissions Counselors consistently meet or exceed established activity and performance metrics, and underperformance is addressed through active coaching and management.
  • Travel, virtual outreach, and recruitment events are executed effectively, aligned with data-informed priorities, and produce measurable results.
  • Stage-based outreach and communication strategies are executed consistently, and prospective students and families receive timely, accurate, and supportive communication.
  • Recruitment and funnel data are tracked accurately, reported on time, and actively used to inform decisions, and Slate is used in alignment with institutional standards.
  • Effective communication and coordination are maintained with campus partners, with clear upward reporting on progress and challenges.

REQUIREMENTS: The person selected will have the following qualifications:

EDUCATION/CERTIFICATION:
  • Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree preferred.
REQUIRED EXPERIENCE:
  • Seven or more years of progressive admissions experience, including at least three years in a supervisory capacity. Seven or more years of progressive experience in undergraduate admissions and recruitment, with demonstrated success in achieving enrollment goals. Experience supervising, leading, or mentoring staff. Working knowledge of first-year and transfer recruitment practices. Proficiency with Microsoft Office and CRM systems (Slate preferred). Ability to travel regionally and nationally and to work evenings and weekends during peak recruitment seasons.
PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:
  • Experience in transfer recruitment and community college partnerships. Experience supporting online program recruitment. Experience with territory management, prospective-student search strategy, and event management. Familiarity with the New York metropolitan and regional high school and community college landscape. Proficiency in a second language.
SKILLS:
  • Strong leadership, coaching, and team management abilities; results-oriented with a focus on metrics and outcomes; excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills; data-driven and analytical; strong organizational and time management skills; and a commitment to a student-centered admissions experience.

WORK PERKS:
  • College Closed for Summer Fridays
  • Tuition Remission or Tuition Exchange
  • 6 Weeks of Paid Holidays
  • Birthday Day to Celebrate your Birthday
  • 2-4 weeks of vacation based on longevity; 7 sick days annually
  • Medical, Dental, Vision, Employee Assistance, 401K etc.

title: Assistant Director, Student Experience and Operations
description:
Who You Are

You are passionate about helping students achieve their educational goals. You thrive in a collaborative environment and are comfortable working remotely while building strong partnerships across the organization. You possess exceptional leadership, technical, and operational expertise and can successfully bridge strategy, process, technology, and execution.


As the Assistant Director, Student Experience & Operations, you will be responsible for the strategic leadership, development, optimization, and execution of the student lifecycle and journey at ACE. You will oversee operational functions, lead process and technology transformation initiatives, and ensure alignment between business objectives, student needs, and institutional priorities. You will define and implement scalable solutions that enhance the student experience, improve operational efficiency, and increase student satisfaction and success. You will need to collaborate with all student facing teams and the IT department in tandem.


As the Assistant Director, Student Experience & Operations, you will provide strategic leadership for the student lifecycle, student operations, process improvement, and technology enablement across the institution. You will need to be expert in CRM and SIS processes and systems.


Compensation

ACE is committed to paying a competitive wage while staying true to our mission of maintaining high quality, affordable programs for our students. The starting salary range for this position is $90,000 plus all full-time employees are eligible for an annual bonus. Offers vary depending on education, prior experience, and expertise being applied to the role.


What We Look for in the Ideal Candidate

• Demonstrates self-reliance by meeting and exceeding organizational objectives.

• Demonstrates positive attitude, motivation, concern for students, teamwork, and excellent time

management skills.

• Follows established processes while identifying opportunities for innovation and improvement.

• Consistently produces a high volume of quality work.

• Adapts effectively to changing priorities and tight deadlines.

• Proven ability to work independently and collaboratively across departments.

• Supports and embraces the College's Impact mission.

• Possesses exceptional communication, organization, and stakeholder management skills.

• Demonstrates creativity and efficiency in solving complex business and operational challenges.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail.

• Builds and maintains student satisfaction throughout the lifecycle.

• Recognizes, anticipates, and responds to student needs.

• Successfully leads teams through change, process improvement, and technology adoption.

• Develops strong partnerships and influences decision-making at all organizational levels.


Day to Day Responsibilities

In this role, you will provide strategic and operational leadership across the student lifecycle. Your

responsibilities include:

• Serve as the institutional subject matter expert on all aspects of the student lifecycle.

• Lead the strategy, design, implementation, and continuous improvement of the end-to-end student

experience.

• Direct student operations initiatives and establish operational standards that support student

success.

• Partner with executive leadership, business leaders, Product Owners, and IT teams to define and

prioritize strategic enhancements.

• Lead cross-functional initiatives that improve operational effectiveness, scalability, system

functionality, and student satisfaction.

• Ensure all system changes, business processes, and operational workflows align with defined student

lifecycle objectives using agile methodologies.

• Develop and implement policies, processes, procedures, and technology solutions that streamline the

student experience.

• Promote the effective utilization of technology to support staff productivity and student success.

• Partner with technology teams to implement and support enterprise solutions and process

enhancements.

• Monitor performance metrics, operational effectiveness, and student experience outcomes, using

data-driven insights to drive continuous improvement.

• Provide leadership and oversight for operational teams while fostering employee engagement,

accountability, and professional development.

• Lead organizational change management efforts associated with process, technology, and

operational improvements.

• Act as a champion for innovation, collaboration, and student-centered decision-making across the

institution.

title: Vice President, Research
description:
Company: Ellington Management Group, LLC

Position: Vice President, Research

Location: 711 Third Avenue, 5th Floor, New York, NY 10017

Job Duties: Oversee the development, implementation, and enhancement of the firm’s quantitative risk, valuation, and collateral modeling infrastructure. Architect and lead the development of the firm’s collateral modeling framework, ensuring scalability, accuracy, and alignment with business and regulatory requirements. Develop, implement, and maintain quantitative models for structured finance products, including mortgage-backed securities, utilizing industry-standard tools such as Intex and related subroutines to generate OAS-based cashflow and valuation models. Lead the design and development of AI/ML-enhanced systems to monitor and optimize the profitability of loan origination and securitization activities. Lead the development of AI-enhanced analytical tools to support trading desk workflows and improve efficiency and decision-making. Ensure that all models adhere to established best practices, including appropriate documentation, validation, and governance standards. Review and evaluate modeling work produced by research team members to ensure consistency, accuracy, and adherence to quantitative and scientific standards. Apply statistical, econometric, and quantitative techniques to analyze financial markets, model asset performance, and inform investment decisions. Assess and integrate internal and third-party market data into model calibration processes; evaluate external vendor data and incorporate such data into existing modeling frameworks as appropriate. Monitor and analyze market developments, regulatory guidance, and industry best practices related to financial modeling; review relevant academic and industry research. Collaborate with portfolio managers, traders, and senior research staff to identify business needs and develop quantitative solutions to support investment strategies. Coordinate and oversee the implementation of research initiatives and modeling enhancements across the research team. Prepare and review technical materials and analyses for internal stakeholders and external parties, including clients and prospective investors. Assist in responding to technical inquiries from clients and prospective investors in coordination with senior management and investor relations. Participate in the recruitment and evaluation of research personnel, including conducting interviews, assessing candidate qualifications, and providing hiring recommendations.

Job Requirements: Must have a Bachelor’s degree, or foreign equivalent, in Computer Science, Economics, Finance, or a closely related quantitative field. Must have 2 years of experience as a Research Analyst, Quantitative Analyst, or a related role. The 2 years of experience must include experience with: quantitative risk, valuation, and collateral modeling for structured finance products, including mortgage-backed securities and related instruments; Intex and Intex subroutines for constructing and analyzing OAS-based cashflow and valuation models; statistical, econometric, and quantitative modeling techniques for financial market and asset performance analysis; analysis of large-scale financial and market datasets, including integration of internal and third-party data sources into model calibration and validation processes; programming in Python, C++, or similar languages for model development, data analysis, and system implementation; model performance evaluation and application of modeling best practices, including documentation, validation, and governance standards; and design and implementation of quantitative solutions supporting investment strategies.

Salary Range: $200,000 - $205,000/year

title: Manager - Clinical Operations
description:
At UC Health, we're proud to have the best and brightest teams and clinicians collaborating toward our common purpose: to advance healing and reduce suffering.

As the region's adult academic health system, we strive for innovation and provide world-class care for not only our community, but patients from all over the world. Join our team and you'll be able to develop your skills, grow your career, build relationships with your peers and patients, and help us be a source of hope for our friends and neighbors.

Position Summary

The Manager of Clinical Operations provides day-to-day leadership for assigned ambulatory practice locations and is accountable for safe, efficient, patient-centered operations. This leader partners closely with physicians and interdisciplinary teams to improve access, workflow, quality, patient experience, financial performance, and team engagement. The manager oversees clinical and clerical support staff while ensuring consistent application of UC Health and UC Physicians policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.

Clinical Operations and Patient Access

  • Oversees daily practice activities to support patient safety, efficient patient flow, and cost-effective care delivery.
  • Partners with physicians and practice leaders to understand operational needs, remove barriers, and improve provider and staff efficiency.

  • Enforces applicable departmental, UC Physicians, and UC Health policies and procedures.

  • Provides leadership, coaching, clinical guidance, and support to clinical and clerical team members.

  • Ensures new team members complete departmental orientation and required competencies within established timeframes.
  • Promotes professional growth through ongoing education, mentoring, competency review, and regular staff communication.

Facilitates team meetings and fosters an inclusive, accountable, and collaborative work environment.

Quality, Safety, and Regulatory Compliance

  • Develops and leads quality-improvement initiatives related to clinical practice, productivity, patient access, infection prevention, equipment, policies, and multidisciplinary standards.
  • Collects and analyzes operational and clinical data to evaluate results, identify improvement opportunities, and sustain effective solutions.
  • Reviews performance measures and develops action plans to improve access, internal quality, clinical outcomes, and the patient experience.
  • Works with physicians and staff to maintain compliance with applicable requirements, including Joint Commission, OSHA, Ohio Department of Health, and billing standards.

Financial and Resource Management

  • Supports budget preparation and manages assigned areas within approved expense and staffing targets.
  • Monitors revenue-cycle opportunities, including charge capture, billing, pre-certification, registration accuracy, and open or pending encounters.
  • Develops productivity standards and staffing plans that appropriately align resources with practice needs.
  • Manages supplies, inventory, capital equipment, repairs, and rental equipment while evaluating options for quality, safety, and cost-effectiveness.

Collaboration and Practice Support

  • Serves as a liaison to internal and external partners to support coordinated, patient-centered service delivery.
  • Collaborates with Marketing and other support departments on practice signage, standardized materials, and website updates as needed.
  • Participates in assigned UC Physicians and UC Health committees, leadership meetings, and clinical initiatives.
  • Performs other duties and projects as assigned.

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in a healthcare-related field, business, management, or a related discipline.
  • Three to five years of relevant experience in ambulatory practice operations, healthcare administration, clinical operations, or a comparable setting.
  • Demonstrated experience leading teams and managing day-to-day operations in a complex, service-focused environment.
  • Working knowledge of ambulatory workflows, patient access, quality improvement, revenue-cycle processes, staffing, and regulatory compliance.
  • Proficiency with electronic health records and automated billing, scheduling, and registration systems.
  • Strong communication, problem-solving, organizational, and relationship-management skills.

Preferred

  • Six to ten years of relevant healthcare operations experience.
  • Previous leadership experience in a multispecialty or academic ambulatory practice.
  • Experience with Epic or a comparable electronic health record platform.
  • Experience using operational and clinical performance data to improve access, quality, productivity, and patient experience.

Leadership Scope

This position may oversee approximately 2 to 50 employees across clinical and administrative functions, including clinical supervisors, registered nurses, licensed practical nurses, medical assistants, patient service representatives, medical records staff, coders, and medical secretaries.

Work Environment

This role works primarily in an ambulatory clinical and office environment and requires regular on-site presence. Travel among UC Health hospitals, practices, and other work locations may be necessary. Work hours may vary based on patient care and business needs.

UC Health Values

The Manager of Clinical Operations supports UC Health's PRIIDE values by putting patients and families first, showing respect, acting with integrity, embracing inclusion, seeking discovery, and offering empathy in interactions with patients, families, employees, physicians, and community partners.

title: PMC Mechanical and Piping Field Supervisor
description:
Wood is currently recruiting for an experienced PMC Mechanical and Piping Field Supervisor with extensive experience in the oil and Gas industry for client to be based in Abu Dhabi within our Oil, Gas & New Energies business. Due to the nature of the projects and client expectation, the position will be based at onshore site in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates.

Our Clients and Projects

Designing the future. Transforming the world.

Wood's Oil, Gas & New Energies business is built on a strong legacy of delivering large and complex projects for national and international energy companies across the globe. We have experienced teams, a proven delivery model and a strong reputation.

We are the market-leading provider of integrated and innovative solutions that challenge the status-quo in the oil and gas upstream and midstream, onshore and offshore, gas to liquids and decarbonization and electrification markets. We pride ourselves in steady and predictable delivery, setting our sights on an exciting growth trajectory.

Energy security, transition and supply have never been more important. You, our enabling teams, are at the very forefront of transformative projects that are providing sustainable power to generations to come. We are the ones to bring low-carbon concepts to reality.

What we can offer

  • Meaningful and interesting projects: Delivered to high profile clients across the Energy Sector
  • Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: We are an organization actively committed to diversity and inclusion across our business
  • Competitive renumeration package: With regular reviews to ensure we are rewarding at the right level in line with the market
  • Medical Insurance: Ensures inpatient, and outpatient medical care is available should you require treatment
  • Group Life and Personal Accident Insurance: The company provides Life Assurance cover
  • End of Service Gratuity: In line with UAE Labor Law, all employees are eligible for an End of Service benefit
  • The Employee Share Plan: Gives you the opportunity to purchase Wood shares and receive a match from the company
  • Long Service Award: Wood values the commitment and loyalty of our people. Celebrating Long Service provides an opportunity for the business to demonstrate their appreciation of the hard work, dedication and many years’ services of our employees at 5 - year service milestones
  • Commitment to continued professional development: Development plans that are tailored to your individual needs and interests
  • Global connections: Join experts around the world who are at the leading edge of our industry, shaping the standards of our profession
  • Energy Transition Academy: Join a community of experts sharing your knowledge and gaining more exposure to a variety of existing and emerging energy systems – delivered by experts in their field

Key Responsibilities

  • Supervise and monitor all mechanical construction activities performed by EPC Contractors and subcontractors.
  • Act as the PMC Mechanical representative at site and coordinate closely with the PMT, EPC Contractor and other PMC disciplines.
  • Ensure mechanical construction activities are carried out in accordance with:
    • Approved drawings and specifications
    • Project procedures and method statements
    • ADNOC standards and requirements
    • Applicable international codes and standards
    • HSE and quality requirements
  • Review and provide technical input on construction/installation procedures, method statements, ITPs and work plans.
  • Monitor installation and construction of:
    • Piping systems
    • Valves and piping components
    • Static equipment
    • Rotating equipment
    • Tanks and vessels
    • Pumps, compressors and associated mechanical systems
  • Monitor contractor manpower, equipment, materials and resources to ensure they are adequate for planned construction activities.
  • Coordinate mechanical construction activities with civil, structural, electrical, instrumentation, commissioning and other disciplines.
  • Monitor contractor progress against the approved construction schedule and milestones.
  • Identify construction delays, constraints and potential schedule slippage and recommend corrective actions.
  • Participate in daily/weekly construction coordination and progress meetings.
  • Conduct regular site inspections to verify workmanship, construction sequence, productivity and compliance.
  • Coordinate with QA/QC to ensure inspection and testing activities are completed in accordance with approved ITPs.
  • Monitor mechanical testing, pre-commissioning and mechanical completion activities.
  • Follow up punch list items and ensure timely close-out.
  • Review and verify mechanical completion documentation, including as-built drawings, test packs, inspection records and handover dossiers.
  • Review contractor red-line drawings and provide construction input for final as-built documentation.
  • Monitor contractor compliance with approved HSE procedures and ADNOC site safety requirements.
  • Participate in HSE inspections, toolbox talks, site safety initiatives and incident-prevention activities.
  • Identify construction risks and field issues and coordinate appropriate corrective actions.
  • Provide regular daily, weekly and monthly construction reports covering progress, manpower, productivity, issues and key activities.
  • Support commissioning and handover activities and ensure mechanical systems are ready for the next project phase.

What makes you remarkable

At Wood, we are committed to equal opportunities and welcome all talented individuals to consider joining our team. So even if you don't match every statement below but feel you have some of the experience, knowledge or skills needed for this role, we encourage you to apply. It will take all of us working together to deliver solutions to the world’s most critical challenges.

Expected:

  • Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent.
  • Minimum 10 years of relevant Oil & Gas / Petrochemical experience.
  • Minimum 5 years GCC experience preferred.
  • Strong mechanical construction supervision experience on onshore oil & gas projects.
  • PMC experience is highly preferred, particularly on EPC onshore brownfield, field production upgrade or modification projects.
  • ADNOC Onshore experience is strongly preferred.
  • Experience working directly with EPC Contractors and subcontractors in a PMC/client-representative capacity.
  • Strong knowledge of mechanical construction methods, piping and equipment installation.
  • Good knowledge of relevant ASME, API, ASTM and project-specific standards.
  • Ability to interpret P&IDs, piping isometrics, mechanical drawings, equipment drawings and specifications.

title: Associate Project Manager
description:
Position Summary

The Associate Project Manager is for independently managing low-to-moderate complexity commercialization and launch projects from initiation through execution. This role serves as the primary project owner for assigned projects and is responsible for driving timelines, coordinating cross-functional activities, managing risks, and ensuring successful launch execution while achieving Product Availability Date (PAD), On-Time In-Full (OTIF), and Right First Time (RTFT) objectives.

The Associate Project Manager partners closely with Operations, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Regulatory, Research & Innovation, and Sales to ensure project deliverables are completed on time and customer expectations are met. This position leads customer and internal project communications, proactively identifies risks, develops mitigation plans, and drives accountability across functional teams to support successful commercialization, development, pilot, line trial, and production launch activities.

The role requires strong organizational, communication, and project management skills, along with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment while supporting continuous improvement and launch excellence initiatives.

Responsibilities and Essential Duties

  • Own and manage low-to-moderate complexity project timelines, ensuring tasks, dependencies, and milestones are created, maintained, and consistently updated.
  • Lead customer and internal project meetings, ensuring action items, risks, and deliverables are clearly communicated and tracked. Coordinate commercialization activities including development, pilot runs, line trials, first production, and launch readiness activities.
  • Execute established launch processes to ensure RFT and OTIF metrics are achieved.
  • Drive weekly project reviews, identifying at-risk items and enforcing escalation paths when delays threaten PAD or customer commitments.
  • Serve as the primary owner of the launch timelines, and ensuring timelines reflect accurate information from Operations, Supply Chain, Engineering, and Quality.
  • Track and communicate risks and blockers, develop mitigation plans, and ensure accountability across teams.
  • Coordinate line trials, pilot batches, and component readiness with Packaging Engineering and Process Engineering.
  • Conduct post-launch evaluations to identify process inefficiencies, lessons learned, and improvement opportunities.
  • Collaborate with Scheduling and Outside Sales to support capacity alignment and execution readiness.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives related to launch execution, project visibility, and cross-functional processes. Maintain limited ERP updates (item setup, PAD-aligned dates, demand entry) as needed to keep project timelines accurate.
  • Foster strong internal partnerships and communication channels to improve launch performance.
  • Utilize AI and automation tools to improve project coordination, reporting, risk identification, and process efficiency.

Technical Skills Required

  • Proficiency with project management platforms, including Monday.com, Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, or equivalent systems.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to effectively communicate with customers, suppliers, and cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to identify project risks, evaluate impacts, and develop mitigation plans.
  • Ability to facilitate meetings, drive action items, and hold stakeholders accountable to project commitments.
  • Understanding of project lifecycle management, commercialization processes, and launch execution.
  • Working knowledge of manufacturing operations, supply chain processes, production scheduling, and product development activities.
  • Ability to analyze project data, timelines, and performance metrics to support decision making.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
  • Ability to navigate changing priorities and support multiple customer projects simultaneously.
  • Understanding of ERP systems, Bills of Material (BOMs), specifications, and product master data preferred.
  • Ability to build collaborative relationships across Operations, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Regulatory, Research & Innovation, and Sales functions.
  • Proficiency with AI tools, reporting platforms, and workflow automation tools.
  • Ability to analyze project data and leverage technology to improve project execution and visibility.

Experience Required

  • Bachelor’s Degree preferred in Business Administration, Project Management, Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, Manufacturing, Industrial Engineering, Life Sciences, Chemistry, or a related field. 2-5 years of experience in project management, project coordination, manufacturing, engineering, supply chain, quality, commercialization, or related business functions. 2-5 years of experience utilizing project management systems such as Monday.com, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, or equivalent platforms preferred.
  • 1+ year experience within Personal Care, Cosmetic, Pharmaceutical, Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG), or Contract Manufacturing environments preferred.

Physical Requirements

  • Regularly sit, stand, and walk for extended periods of time.
  • Ability to sit, balance, climb, stand, bend, squat, squeeze, kneel, turn, crouch, stoop repeatedly.
  • Physically able to lift 25 pounds occasionally.
  • Frequent exposure and/or to varying temperatures, loud noises, heavy machinery, fumes, or airborne particles, moving mechanical parts, electrical, chemicals, and vibrations.
  • Frequent use of computer screen and use of headphones.

title: Senior Analyst-Data Analytics
description:

  • Intellectual curiosity, attention to detail ability to learn quickly and drive results.

  • Ability to drive insights from data, manage multiple projects and drive results in a fast-paced environment.

  • Bachelors in Statistics/Mathematics/Economics/ Engineering/Data Science with relevant experience.

Education

Experience

  • Required learn to perform additional sonography protocols under the direction of the Senior Ultrasonographers and Lead Ultrasonographer.

  • Develop new and better techniques to keep the department up to date.

title: Partner Channel Manager
description:
About the Role

MCM Technology is looking to hire a Partner Channel Manager to build, grow, and manage a network of reseller and strategic partners that extend MCM's reach across the public safety market. This role owns the full partner lifecycle: recruiting and onboarding new partners, enabling and training their sales teams, opening senior-level and engineering relationships that deepen a partnership over time, and establishing the cooperative purchasing vehicles that make MCM easier for agencies to buy. This role does not carry an individual sales quota. MCM's direct sales team closes the business. This role is measured on its contribution to partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline and on the partnership milestones that create it. This is a full-time, remote role with up to 40% travel, reporting directly to the Chief Revenue Officer.

What We Value in You

• You understand the public safety market: law enforcement, fire, EMS, radio and communications, and can speak credibly to its buyers and influencers.

• You're a relationship builder who knows how to motivate a partner's sales team to prioritize and sell your solution alongside their own.

• You have a "can do" attitude. Our teams create high-quality work on quick timelines.

• You're never tired of learning and are always looking for ways to grow personally and professionally.

• You're both an effective communicator and an eager listener.

• You want to be an active part of helping our team continue to be at the forefront of how we serve public safety. You bring your energy and expertise to the table every day. We are stronger working together as a team.

What You'll Be Doing

• Build and execute a partner channel strategy that includes managing MCM’s current partners, as well as identifying and recruiting new partners to extend MCM's coverage of the public safety market.

• Establish and manage onboarding, training, and enablement programs so partner sales teams can effectively position and MCM's platform.

• Own a contribution target for partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline. MCM's direct sales reps close the business; this role creates the joint pipeline that feeds them and works with partners to advance it.

• Effectively and efficiently document and track all partner-sourced and partner-influenced opportunities in Salesforce CRM to ensure accurate forecasting and pipeline evaluation.

• Serve as the primary point of contact for partners, resolving conflicts, coordinating deal support, and ensuring a consistent, positive partner experience.

• Work cross-functionally with the Sales, Solutions Engineering, and Customer Success teams to ensure partner-sourced deals and post-sale handoffs are well-supported.

• Develop joint business plans with key partners, including account mapping, co-marketing, and shared pipeline-generation activities.

• Build and operate MCM's deal registration process together with the Chief Revenue Officer, including rules of engagement, how credit is assigned between a partner and a direct rep, conflict resolution, and tracking in Salesforce. This process does not exist today and building it is a first-year deliverable.

• Evaluate which partnerships justify engineering investment and coordinate integration scoping between the partner's technical team and MCM Product. Bring a business case for the integration, not just a request.

• Open and maintain senior-level relationships inside partner organizations, including executive sponsor mapping and regular business reviews, so a partnership survives turnover on either side.

• Own the Zebra relationship, including expanding it beyond the initially approved scope and driving hardware attach alongside MCM's direct sales team.

• Build and own MCM's presence on cooperative purchasing and contract vehicles such as Sourcewell, GSA, NASPO, and state term contracts. MCM does not hold some of these today. This role owns the relationship and decides which vehicles to pursue; MCM's Contracts Manager owns pricing and contract terms.

• Renegotiate agreements with existing partners who resell MCM, working with the Contracts Manager on margin, terms, and minimums.

• Lay the groundwork for MCM reselling partner products beginning in 2027, including margin structure, who owns support, and how the offering is packaged and quoted.

• Stay up to date with relevant industry and job knowledge by attending conferences, participating in educational opportunities, reading professional publications, maintaining personal networks, and participating in professional organizations.

• Effectively communicate the value and features offered in the software solutions partners are selling, including the ability to perform introductory level demonstrations of the software at tradeshows or in partner sales meetings.

Requirements

• Demonstrated experience building and managing partner/reseller channels and enabling their sales teams.

• A track record of generating measurable partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, and of being held accountable for it.

• Strong interpersonal skills; good at establishing rapport, and building trust.

• Experience navigating complex, multi-party sales cycles involving both a partner organization and an end-customer.

• Ability to write clearly and communicate effectively via email and in person.

• A self-starter with the ability to solve problems independently.

• An effective multi-tasker, comfortable in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong emphasis on data integrity for pipeline accuracy, forecasting, and reporting.

• Values metrics and maintains strong organization skills.

• Ability to translate a technical integration request into a business case, and to run a joint call between two engineering teams without needing an engineer to lead it.

• Comfort building a program from nothing. Deal registration, partner tiering, and contract vehicle applications do not exist here yet.

Nice to Have's

• Direct experience in law enforcement, fire, or EMS, or technology sales experience specifically serving those agencies.

• Existing relationships with resellers, integrators, or channel partners active in the public safety market.

• Experience using Salesforce (training will be provided for candidates without prior experience).

• Experience with cooperative purchasing vehicles such as Sourcewell, GSA, NASPO, or state term contracts, including the application and renewal process.

• Experience structuring a reseller agreement from the vendor side, including margin, support ownership, and minimums.

Other Reasons to Join Us

• Health, Dental, and Vision insurance starting Day 1

• 401(k)

• Use what you need PTO policy

• Health Savings Account (HSA) option

• Flexible Spending Account (FSA) option

title: Senior / Principal Materials Scientist, AI Safety
location: Cambridge, MA USA; London, UK; San Francisco, CA USA
description:
Your Impact at LILA

We're building a talent-dense, high-agency AI safety team at Lila that will engage all core teams within the organization (science, model training, lab integration, etc.), to identify and mitigate risks from scientific superintelligence while retaining the core scientific discovery capabilities of the stack. The initial focus of this team will be to build and implement a bespoke safety strategy for Lila, tailored to its specific goals and deployment strategies. This will involve technical safety strategy development, broader ecosystem engagement, safety-focused evaluations, safety systems to mitigate risks, and a research agenda that explores longer-term needs such as oversight of superintelligent scientific systems.

We are seeking a materials scientist to map risk across the material sciences domain: you will connect deep materials expertise with dual-use risk assessment to help safeguard increasingly capable scientific AI. You will investigate how advances in materials research could change harmful capabilities, including established and emerging threats.

What You'll Be Building

  • Map misuse risks by connecting material properties, processing and functional performance (across a range of materials domains) to harmful applications, including emerging or overlooked uses of scientific advances.
  • Assess how physical feasibility, processing complexity, manufacturing requirements and actors' resources affect the plausibility and likelihood of misuse, including which constraints AI could change.
  • Distinguish established capabilities, plausible future developments and weakly supported hypotheses, revising assessments as evidence changes across models, tools and automated laboratories.
  • Identify gaps in expertise, commission targeted scientific input with the expert-program team, and integrate specialist findings into a coherent assessment of the risk landscape.
  • Translate dual-use judgments into policy boundaries, evaluation priorities and mitigation requirements that support beneficial materials research.
  • Work with threat modelers, evaluation researchers and engineering and experimental colleagues to assess capabilities, interpret red-team findings and evaluate safeguards.

What You'll Need to Succeed

  • Deep expertise (a PhD, or comparable experience) in materials science or a closely related discipline, with a strong grasp of the relationships between structure, properties, processing and applications. Relevant backgrounds include particulate, porous and formulated systems; and structural and functional materials, including thin films, electrochemical materials and metals and alloys.
  • Substantive experience assessing dual-use risks in a relevant area, with a strong understanding of harmful applications such as nuclear proliferation, radiological misuse, weapons-related capabilities (e.g. energetics) or other consequential materials risks.
  • Sound judgment about physical possibility, practical feasibility and uncertainty, together with the ability to investigate risks beyond your immediate specialism.
  • The ability to identify appropriate specialists, evaluate technical evidence and synthesize contributions across scientific and security disciplines.
  • Clear scientific communication, independent research judgment and an ability to collaborate across science, engineering and policy.

Bonus Points For

  • Prior experience applying materials or related physical-science expertise to AI safety through one or more of: threat analysis, evaluations or red teaming, or mitigation design.
  • Experience commissioning specialist research or assessing emerging technologies across disciplinary boundaries.
  • Experience with computational materials science, advanced manufacturing or automated synthesis and characterization.

Compensation

We offer competitive base compensation with bonus potential and generous early-stage equity. Your final offer will reflect your background, expertise, and expected impact.

U.S. Benefits. Full-time U.S. employees receive a comprehensive benefits program including medical, dental, and vision coverage; employer-paid life and disability insurance; flexible time off with generous company wide holidays; paid parental leave; an educational assistance program; commuter benefits, including bike share memberships for office based employees; and a company subsidized lunch program.

International Benefits. Full-time employees outside the U.S. receive a comprehensive benefits program tailored to their region. USD salary ranges apply only to U.S.-based positions; international salaries are set to local market.

Expected Base Salary Range
$268,000—$384,000 USD

About LILA

Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves.

LILA combines advanced AI models with proprietary AI Science Factory™ instruments into an operating system for science that executes the entire scientific method autonomously, accelerating discovery at unprecedented speed, scale, and impact across medicine, materials, and energy. Learn more at www.lila.ai.

Guided by our core values of truth, trust, curiosity, grit, and velocity, we move with startup speed while tackling problems of historic importance. If this sounds like an environment you'd love to work in, even if you don't meet every qualification listed above, we encourage you to apply.

We’re All In

Lila Sciences is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

Information you provide during your application process will be handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy.

A Note to Agencies

Lila Sciences does not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than candidates. The submission of unsolicited resumes by recruitment or staffing agencies to Lila Sciences or its employees is strictly prohibited unless contacted directly by Lila Science’s internal Talent Acquisition team. Any resume submitted by an agency in the absence of a signed agreement will automatically become the property of Lila Sciences, and Lila Sciences will not owe any referral or other fees with respect thereto.

About the Role

Are you a seasoned content strategist and publishing specialist passionate about home improvement, design, and lifestyle trends?

As Content Planning Manager, you will steer the end-to-end planning, production, and delivery of one of Australia & New Zealand’s most widely read customer magazines, and contribute to other exciting bespoke publications.

Reporting into and collaborating closely with the Content Director, you will develop creative concepts and guide the team that brings them to life on the page while ensuring strong strategic alignment with trade planning, supplier partnerships, and brand marketing priorities. You will also work hand-in-glove with our Content Integration & Planning, Brand, Social, and Media teams to ensure our print storytelling seamlessly amplifies across digital channels, retail media, and always-on campaigns.

  • Strategic Editorial Planning: Develop rich editorial calendars that tap into seasonal retail moments, DIY building trends, and customer interests, balancing commercial priorities with genuine reader value.

  • Commercial & Supplier Collaboration: Partner with suppliers, internal teams, and agency partners to facilitate sponsored content and advertising integration while upholding editorial integrity.
  • Quality Assurance & Compliance: Ensure all copy, visual assets, and layouts meet strict brand guidelines, advertising standards, editorial compliance, and Australian/NZ consumer laws.
  • Production Schedule Governance: Drive rigorous project timelines, managing proofs, approvals, and stakeholder sign-offs across multiple concurrent editions without missing a beat.

What We’re Looking For

  • Proven Publishing & Content Background: 5+ years of experience in magazine publishing, content marketing, or large-scale multi-channel content production.
  • Print & Production Savvy: Deep understanding of the magazine lifecycle, including flat-planning, editorial workflows, prepress, print production, and distribution.
  • Category Passion: A finger on the pulse of home improvement, DIY, gardening, outdoor living, and lifestyle trends across Australia and New Zealand.
  • Exceptional Project Management: Highly organised with rigorous attention to detail and a track record of delivering complex print and digital projects on time and within budget.
  • Stakeholder Influence: Polished communication and relationship-building skills, adept at navigating internal brand teams, retail media specialists, suppliers, and external agency partners.
  • Tool Proficiency: Working knowledge of content management systems (CMS), workflow management platforms, and modern publishing production software.
